Title: Reckless driver intentionally struck Palm Bay officer, sparked 2‑mile pursuit before being arrested, police say
description: A 25-year-old man was arrested in Palm Bay after allegedly intentionally crashing into a police vehicle and leading officers on a high-speed pursuit. According to police, Anthony Devon Nunnally struck a sergeant’s vehicle at a crash scene near Walden and Wyoming Drive SE and then fled. Officers pursued him for about two miles with lights and sirens active. During the chase, he reportedly drove at high speed with headlights off, lost control, became airborne, and crashed into a parked car. He resisted arrest after the crash and was tased before being taken into custody. A DUI investigation was conducted at hospital
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer, aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer, fleeing and eluding law enforcement, DUI with property damage, DUI with personal injury, refusal to submit to testing, resisting an officer without violence, leaving the scene of a crash with minor injuries, multiple counts of leaving the scene of a crash with property damage

Title: Lyft driver says ride from Pompano Beach turned into carjacking, pursuit in West Palm Beach
description: A Lyft ride in South Florida turned into a violent carjacking and police pursuit after a passenger allegedly took control of the driver’s vehicle. The driver picked up Delcan Murphy for a long trip from Broward County toward Jacksonville, stopping in West Palm Beach for gas. While the driver was inside a store, Murphy reportedly moved into the driver’s seat and drove off with the vehicle. The driver and his stepson tried to stop him and were injured during the struggle. They followed the vehicle while calling 911 until Murphy crashed into another car. He then attempted to flee on foot but was restrained until police arrived
Charges: Grand theft, property damage (additional charges may apply but not fully listed in report)

Title: Duo arrested in Marion after westside gunfire leads to high-speed police chase
description: Trevon Scales, a 19-year-old from Mount Gilead, Ohio, was arrested after a drug-related robbery attempt escalated into a shootout and high-speed police chase in Marion on February 22, 2026. Marion Police responded to reports of gunfire on Clinton Street and discovered evidence of a shootout. Officers observed a vehicle fleeing the area and initiated a pursuit. The chase ended when the vehicle crashed near Campbell Road and railroad tracks. Scales attempted to flee on foot but was captured. Investigators determined the group had traveled to Marion to commit a robbery during a drug transaction. Multiple firearms were recovered.
Charges: Aggravated Robbery , Fleeing and Eluding Law Enforcement

Title: Toledo man charged in high-speed chase with minors in vehicle
description: A 20-year-old Toledo man allegedly stole a vehicle and encouraged two minors to get inside before leading police on a high-speed chase. When officers attempted a traffic stop, he fled at speeds exceeding 100 mph. The pursuit ended on southbound I-75 near the North Detroit Avenue exit when he lost control and crashed. Both the driver and the juvenile passengers were injured, with one minor suffering a laceration requiring staples. Police also reported finding a screwdriver in his backpack, which they believe was used in the vehicle theft. He faces multiple criminal charges related to theft and fleeing law enforcement.
Charges: Failure to comply Theft Reckless operation Aiding and abetting minors

Title: Report: Deputies nab Santa Rosa County high-speed chase suspect thanks to his TikTok video
description: A Navarre teen was arrested after deputies linked him to multiple high-speed motorcycle pursuits through TikTok videos he posted online. Authorities say 18-year-old Derrick Walker was seen riding a black Kawasaki Ninja motorcycle that fled from deputies at extreme speeds, including a chase where he reached roughly 100 mph and performed traffic violations such as illegal U-turns at intersections. Investigators later found videos on his TikTok account that appeared to show the same chase, helping identify him. A search warrant led deputies to seize the motorcycle and gear matching the rider. Walker admitted to being the driver in the pursuit incidents.
Charges: Fleeing or eluding law enforcement (two counts); reckless driving; speeding 50+ mph over limit

Title: Chase reaches 100 mph; two cars hit in pursuit
description: A 20-year-old Youngstown man, Guilleremo Santos, was involved in a high-speed police pursuit in Boardman, Ohio, after officers attempted to stop him for speeding. He fled, leading police along Route 224 and Interstate 680 at speeds between 75 and 100 mph. During the chase, he struck two vehicles at South Avenue and Route 224. He continued onto I-680 and later exited at Shirley Road, turning onto East Indianola Avenue, where the vehicle became disabled due to a blown tire. He was then taken into custody. He faces multiple traffic-related charges stemming from reckless driving and hit-and-run allegations by police officers.
Charges: Failure to comply with signal or order of police, speeding, reckless operation, failure to control, hit-skip

Title: Man accused of leading Fort Myers police on chase through city after carjacking
description: A 19-year-old man, Kevin Matthew Resuche, was arrested after a carjacking incident escalated into a police chase through Fort Myers, Florida. Officers responded to reports of a man acting erratically in traffic, approaching vehicles, grabbing door handles, and attempting to enter occupied cars. The suspect allegedly stole a blue Nissan Sentra and fled eastbound on Colonial Boulevard. Police located the vehicle and attempted a traffic stop, but he refused to stop and led officers on a pursuit through city streets. The chase ended near Six Mile Cypress Parkway and Daniels Parkway due to heavy traffic, where he was taken into custody. He was later transported for medical evaluation before booking.
Charges: Robbery, carjacking, fleeing and eluding law enforcement with high-speed reckless driving

Title: Dashcam, bodycam video captures arrest of Jacksonville man following dramatic chase in Nassau County
description: Raymond Kenneth Jackson Jr., a 46-year-old Jacksonville man, was arrested in Yulee, Florida, after allegedly leading law enforcement on a high-speed pursuit that began when deputies located his vehicle following reports that he was wanted on outstanding warrants. Authorities say he was initially sought in connection with a domestic violence-related investigation and failed offender requirements. During the pursuit, deputies attempted to stop his white Infiniti sedan after he ran a red light and drove onto the shoulder. The chase escalated until officers boxed him in near a parking lot. Jackson’s vehicle collided with a K-9 patrol unit as he attempted to escape through a narrow gap, bringing the pursuit to an end. He was taken into custody at gunpoint without reported injuries.
Charges: Aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer, aggravated fleeing and eluding law enforcement

Title: Intoxicated man arrested after running from police in Bellefontaine
description: Police in Bellefontaine Ohio arrested Drew Williams 26 of Dublin after he became heavily intoxicated at a local bar and caused a disturbance Officers were called when his sister reported erratic behavior and him repeatedly exiting a vehicle When police arrived near Madriver Street and Patterson Avenue Williams was seen running from officers and attempting to evade arrest He ignored commands to stop and was pursued on foot After being restrained he resisted by dropping to the ground and striking his head against a patrol vehicle Officers noted alcohol odor He was booked into jail disorderly conduct obstruction resisting arrest
Charges: Disorderly conduct by intoxication, obstruction, resisting arrest

Title: Juvenile driving stolen Kia arrested after running from traffic stop, leaving gun behind: Police
description: A juvenile male was arrested in Springfield Township, Ohio, after police stopped a stolen Kia that had been reported stolen from Sharonville. During the traffic stop on June 8, 2026, the driver pulled into a parking lot, exited the vehicle, and fled on foot. Officers pursued him for approximately 15 minutes before apprehending him on Thunderbird Drive. Police reported that the suspect left a handgun inside the stolen vehicle before running. After his arrest, he was taken to Cincinnati Children’s Hospital as a precaution due to his age. Authorities then charged him in connection with the stolen vehicle and firearm possession offenses.
Charges: Receiving Stolen Property Carrying Concealed Weapons

Title: Chase travels through school lot in Warren, driver arrested for DUI: Report
description: Police in Warren, Ohio attempted to stop a vehicle driving without taillights shortly before midnight. The driver ignored the traffic stop and accelerated through multiple city streets at speeds far above the limit, committing several traffic violations including running stop signs. The pursuit continued until the vehicle entered the grounds of Jefferson School, driving over a curb, into a parking lot, and across a playground area. The driver later became stuck in a muddy field behind the school, ending the chase. Officers identified the driver as Ashley Cundall, who admitted to being intoxicated. She was arrested after failing field sobriety tests.
Charges: Failure to comply with a police officer (felony), driving under the influence (DUI), speed violations, additional misdemeanor traffic offenses

Title: Woman enters liquor store while drunk, strikes officer with vehicle in Sweetwater, report says
description: A woman was arrested in Sweetwater after allegedly entering a liquor store while intoxicated and then striking a police officer with her vehicle. According to authorities, an officer responded to a silent alarm at a liquor store where employees reported the woman was drunk and causing a disturbance. When the officer approached her vehicle and ordered her to stop, she refused commands and attempted to drive away. The vehicle struck the officer in the leg and shoulder, then hit a police cruiser while fleeing. She was eventually stopped after continued resistance and taken into custody following further noncompliance with officers.
Charges: Resisting an officer with violence; Battery on a law enforcement officer (and related driving/evading offenses implied by report)

Title: Two arrested after stolen vehicle found at St. Armand’s Circle
description: Police in Sarasota arrested a man after an out-of-state stolen vehicle was discovered at St. Armand’s Circle late at night. Officers said the driver, identified as Colin Amand, attempted to flee on foot after stopping at a dead-end street. He was quickly pursued and detained by police. A search of the vehicle revealed two handguns and a trafficking quantity of oxycodone, leading to additional felony charges. A passenger in the vehicle was also taken into custody and charged with trespassing. Authorities confirmed the vehicle had been reported stolen, and Amand is being held in jail on multiple felony offenses.
Charges: Felony motor vehicle theft, possession of firearm by convicted felon (2 counts), possession of firearm, resisting an officer without violence

Title: Gilchrist County deputies, K9 unit arrest burglary suspect after manhunt
description: Gilchrist County deputies arrested Alex Joshua Viers after a burglary and brief manhunt in the Trenton area. Authorities said Viers drove onto a property in southwest Gilchrist County and stole items including a chainsaw and gas cans from a shed. During the escape, he nearly struck the victim with his vehicle. The victim followed until Viers’ vehicle ran out of gas near County Roads 334 and 337, where a confrontation occurred. Viers allegedly stole the victim’s phone and fled on foot. Deputies established a perimeter and, with assistance from a K-9 unit, located and arrested him after a search operation.
Charges: Burglary, robbery, aggravated assault, theft, trespassing, resisting an officer without violence

Title: Gainesville man arrested for interfering with police, firefighters during Publix car fire
description: Gainesville police arrested Garry Cooper Jr. after a disturbance at a Publix parking lot where firefighters were responding to a car fire. Officials said Cooper arrived at the scene, claimed to be a trained EMT, and attempted to approach or enter the burning vehicle while emergency crews were working. First responders said the vehicle did not belong to him and he had no connection to it. When officers intervened, Cooper became disruptive and then physically resisted arrest, fighting with police. Firefighters assisted officers in restraining him before he was taken into custody. He was later booked into jail on multiple charges.
Charges: Battery on a first responder, interfering with a firefighter, resisting officers with violence

Title: Suspect in viral Hialeah takedown caught on video is a convicted felon with decades-long rap sheet
description: A convicted felon with a long criminal history was arrested in Hialeah after a chaotic police chase that ended in a dramatic takedown captured on video. Authorities said the suspect fled from officers during a traffic stop attempt and later drove a stolen gray Corvette through a Walgreens parking lot. When police tried to stop him again, he allegedly accelerated toward officers, lost control, and crashed between vehicles. He then exited the car and attempted to run but was quickly apprehended after resisting arrest. The incident involved multiple law enforcement agencies and stemmed from an ongoing manhunt related to vehicle and equipment theft cases.
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer with a motor vehicle; resisting arrest with violence; grand theft auto; dealing in stolen property

Title: Deputies arrest Gainesville man after electric scooter escape attempt
description: A Gainesville man was arrested after deputies responded to a disturbance at a BP gas station. According to the Alachua County Sheriff’s Office, the suspect was involved in an argument with another man and allegedly kicked him and his ex-girlfriend during the incident. When deputies arrived, the suspect attempted to flee the scene on an electric scooter. Deputies tried to stop him, but he continued riding until he lost control, went into a ditch, and fell off the scooter. He then resisted arrest before being taken into custody. Authorities said alcohol may have been involved and the situation stemmed from escalating public disorder.
Charges: Two counts of battery; resisting an officer without violence

Title: ‘The Voice’ contestant arrested for DUI in Bay County
description: Panama City Beach, Florida
Charges: DUI, driving on a suspended license, refusal to submit to breathalyzer test

Title: Wrong Lane, Wrong State: Atmore Man Arrested For DUI In Pensacola
description: A man from Atmore was arrested in Pensacola after deputies observed him driving in the wrong lane and reversing along Kenmore Road near Pensacola Boulevard. Law enforcement reported that the driver appeared disoriented and believed he was in another city. Officers noted bloodshot, glazed eyes and a visible alcoholic beverage can in the vehicle. The suspect allegedly refused field sobriety testing and initially refused a breath sample, later failing to properly cooperate. He was taken into custody on DUI-related charges. The incident occurred during a traffic stop initiated after unsafe and impaired driving behavior was observed by an Escambia County deputy.
Charges: DUI (alcohol or drugs); refusal to submit to DUI testing

Title: Watch: Grappler Device Stops Street Takeover In Hillsborough County
description: Hillsborough County deputies responded to a street takeover in the Town ‘N’ Country area where a driver was performing donuts and burnouts, shutting down Benjamin Road and Barry Road around 1:30 a.m. When law enforcement arrived, the driver attempted to flee, nearly striking pedestrians and driving into oncoming traffic. Deputies used a Grappler device to safely stop the vehicle by hooking its rear tire and bringing it to a controlled halt. The driver, Calixto Anaya, and a 17-year-old passenger were arrested. The incident involved reckless driving and drug possession and was linked to a coordinated illegal street racing event in traffic.
Charges: Reckless driving; felony fleeing to elude; unlawful racing during coordinated street takeover;firearm-related offense

Title: VIDEO: Florida motorcyclist crashes into car, harms K-9 during arrest, deputies say
description: A motorcyclist was arrested in Lee County after fleeing from a traffic stop and crashing into another vehicle during a high-speed pursuit. Deputies reported that Angelo Acree was riding erratically and had a bent license plate when they attempted to pull him over on Ben Hill Griffin Parkway. He initially stopped near a business but fled again, weaving through traffic before colliding with a Toyota and also striking a patrol vehicle. Acree then ran on foot into a wooded area, where a K-9 unit tracked him down. During the arrest, he resisted by grabbing and injuring the police dog.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding; obstruction; leaving the scene of a crash with property damage; harming a K-9

Title: Florida man hits officer with motorcycle, attempts to climb in cars at drive-thru: police
description: On March 23, 2026, Malachi Venerin was arrested in Port St. Lucie, Florida, after allegedly fleeing from a traffic stop on a motorcycle. Police said Venerin was traveling over 103 mph on SW Gatlin Boulevard when an officer attempted to stop him. During the pursuit, Venerin allegedly struck the officer with the motorcycle, crashed, and fled on foot. Officers later found him at a fast-food restaurant, where he reportedly attempted to enter vehicles in the drive-thru area. Police said he possessed a loaded firearm. He was taken into custody after officers used a taser.
Charges: Aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer Fleeing and eluding Possession of a concealed firearm in commission of felony Possession of a firearm under the age of 21 Resisting without violence Driving with a suspended license Driving motorcycle without endorsement Driving an unregistered vehicle

Title: Two separate fathers arrested for DUI with children in the car over the weekend
description: James King was arrested after deputies responded to a DUI incident involving his underaged son. The child reported that his father had been drinking heavily through the night and was driving erratically while taking him to church the following morning. The son noticed the dangerous driving and convinced his father to pull over before contacting authorities for help. Deputies located King in a parking lot near Aloma Avenue close to his residence. Authorities confirmed signs of severe intoxication, including a breathalyzer reading approximately four times the legal limit. The case involved endangerment of a minor and immediate law enforcement intervention.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under Influence), Child Neglect

Title: Hit-and-run suspect struck motorcyclist after running Winter Haven red light: deputies
description: Cresenciana Mazinis, a 55-year-old woman in Winter Haven, Florida, was involved in a hit-and-run crash on Sunday at the intersection of West Central Avenue and 2nd Street Northwest. Authorities said she was driving a Honda CRV at high speed when she ran a red light and failed to stop at two stop signs. Her vehicle struck a motorcycle that was entering the intersection, ejecting the rider and dragging him onto the hood before he fell to the ground. The motorcyclist suffered severe injuries and was airlifted to a hospital. Mazinis fled on foot but was later located and arrested nearby.
Charges: Reckless driving with serious bodily injury Leaving the scene of a crash Refusal to sign citations Violation of probation (prior 2024 case)

Title: Man accused of recklessly leaving scene of nightclub shooting, fleeing Orange County deputy
description: On May 7, 2026, in Orange County, Florida, deputies responded to a nightclub shooting at Le Palace on South Orange Blossom Trail when a suspect vehicle fled the scene. Miguel Antonio Umana Jr., 25, was identified as the driver and allegedly attempted to evade law enforcement during pursuit. Deputies reported he drove recklessly and ignored commands while fleeing southbound leading to two PIT maneuvers before the vehicle stopped. Umana was taken into custody after being medically evaluated. The incident occurred amid a violent nightclub shooting investigation involving multiple victims and resulted in charges including fleeing and eluding and reckless driving.
Charges: Fleeing/eluding law enforcement with lights and sirens active Reckless driving Driving with a suspended or revoked license

Title: Man dies at detention facility after crash, DUI arrest, Flagler County Sheriff's Office says
description: On approximately January 8, 2026, in Palm Coast, Florida, deputies responded to a single-vehicle crash at Corporate Drive North and Palm Coast Parkway involving a 54-year-old driver, Vadim Valenteychik. Authorities reported the vehicle struck bushes and a building after leaving the roadway. During the investigation, deputies observed signs of impairment, including a strong odor of alcohol and a large beer can inside the vehicle. Field sobriety exercises were stopped due to the driver’s instability. A breath test later showed a very high blood alcohol content. Valenteychik was arrested on DUI-related charges and taken to a hospital for medical clearance before being booked into custody.
Charges: DUI DUI with property damage Possession of open alcohol container in a vehicle

Title: Florida man riding e-bike arrested for DUI after refusing sobriety tests, police say
description: On February 11, 2026, in Winter Springs, Florida, police arrested a 34-year-old man, Kyle Blanton, after officers observed him riding an electric bicycle erratically on East State Road. According to police reports, he fell off the e-bike in a crosswalk and appeared unsteady. Officers noted signs of impairment, including slurred speech, watery eyes, and the odor of alcohol. The man reportedly laughed when questioned and admitted he was trying to show off. He refused field sobriety tests and later declined a breathalyzer at the correctional facility. Under Florida law, e-bikes can be treated as vehicles for DUI enforcement. He was taken into custody for DUI.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: Palm Coast man arrested for DUI after truck rollover
description: Deputies with the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office responded to a late-night crash on Seminole Woods Blvd in Palm Coast, Florida, involving a white 2017 GMC truck that overturned with heavy damage. Investigators determined that 26-year-old Allan Wilson was driving with a passenger when the vehicle rolled over, scattering debris and tools across the roadway. Wilson reportedly admitted, “I’m drunk, I was driving,” and showed clear signs of impairment, including unsteady balance and watery eyes. Breath tests measured 0.158 and 0.161 BAC. An empty liquor bottle and two firearms were found in the vehicle. No serious injuries were reported, and Wilson was arrested after the investigation.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under the Influence)

Title: Two separate fathers arrested for DUI with children in the car over the weekend
description: Andrew Soto was arrested after deputies observed him driving erratically at high speed with a small child properly secured in a car seat. Authorities reported that the vehicle was swerving and leaving the roadway, creating a dangerous situation for both the child and other motorists. Marion County Sheriff’s deputies intervened and took Soto into custody on suspicion of impaired driving. The incident also led to child neglect charges due to the risk posed to the minor passenger. Officials emphasized the seriousness of driving under the influence with children present and the potential for severe harm resulting from such behavior.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under Influence), Child Neglect

Title: DUI driver arrested after hitting guardrail and causing hit-and-runs on I-4
description: Eric Drewry was arrested in Volusia County, Florida, after allegedly driving under the influence on Interstate 4 and causing multiple hit-and-run collisions. Deputies say he struck a guardrail, continued driving with a blown tire, and damaged other vehicles before becoming immobilized near a construction zone in DeBary near Shell Road. Law enforcement reported signs of intoxication and confirmed a DUI arrest. During the arrest, Drewry resisted deputies before being taken into custody by the Volusia County Sheriff's Office. The incident involved reckless driving, property damage, and endangerment of other motorists on the highway. He now faces multiple criminal charges in court.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under Influence), Hit-and-Run, Resisting Arrest, Reckless Driving

Title: West Palm Beach man arrested for chasing stranger with knife after high-five on Clematis Street
description: Jeffrey Morant, 39, was arrested in West Palm Beach after a late-night incident on Clematis Street where he allegedly chased a man with a pocket knife. According to police, the victim had been walking along the street giving high-fives to passersby when Morant reacted aggressively after receiving one. Authorities say Morant became agitated, began yelling, and pursued the victim while armed with a knife. The victim ran to nearby officers for help, and Morant was detained at the scene. He reportedly claimed he felt “weird” after the interaction, but police arrested him based on witness accounts and video evidence.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon without intent to kill

Title: Deltona DUI crash results in arrest and multiple citations
description: John Kearney was arrested in Deltona, Florida after a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of Saxon Boulevard and Tivoli Drive. Deputies say he was driving under the influence when the collision occurred, causing injuries to three occupants of another vehicle. One victim suffered serious bodily injury, while two others sustained minor injuries. After the crash, Kearney was charged with DUI and additional violations, including refusal to submit to DUI testing. Authorities also issued multiple citations related to the crash. He was taken to a hospital for evaluation before being booked into jail following his medical clearance.
Charges: DUI resulting in serious bodily injury, refusal to submit to DUI testing, failure to yield, expired tag, lack of insurance

Title: Former Fruitland Park employee accused of 5th DUI
description: Annette Matters, a former Fruitland Park Recreation Department employee, was arrested after allegedly crashing into a fence and attempting to leave the scene. Police body camera footage later showed her arrest following the incident. Authorities reported that this was her fifth DUI-related arrest, indicating a repeated pattern of impaired driving behavior. The incident involved property damage and suspected intoxication at the time of the crash. The City of Fruitland Park confirmed she was no longer employed with the recreation department. Law enforcement emphasized the seriousness of repeat DUI offenses and the risks posed to public safety and property in such cases.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under Influence), Leaving the Scene of a Crash

Title: 3-year-old struck by Jeep on beach, driver arrested for DUI: officials
city and state: Volusia County (beach area near University Boulevard), Florida
description: Brock Adam Winkler was arrested in Volusia County, Florida after a beach incident where a 3-year-old child was struck by a Jeep in a low-speed collision. Witnesses reported that the child ran unexpectedly into traffic from the ocean area. Authorities conducted a DUI investigation after observing signs that Winkler had been drinking, including reports of empty alcohol containers near the scene. He remained at the location and cooperated with deputies during the initial response. Following field sobriety testing, he was arrested on DUI-related charges involving serious bodily injury, along with refusal to submit to a breath test. The investigation is ongoing.
Charges: DUI involving serious bodily injury, refusal to submit to breath test

Title: Deputies arrest driver accused of crashing into patrol cars, fleeing on I-4 in Osceola County
description: Rocci M. Berry Jr., 26, was arrested in Osceola County after deputies said he crashed into two patrol cars and fled the scene during a traffic encounter. According to investigators, Berry was initially found asleep inside a Tesla stopped at a traffic light on Poinciana Boulevard. When deputies attempted to intervene, he allegedly became violent, striking patrol vehicles before leading law enforcement on a pursuit. He later abandoned his vehicle on Interstate 4 and fled on foot. Deputies eventually located him at a residence in Kissimmee, where he again attempted to escape before being apprehended with assistance from a K-9 unit.
Charges: Aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer, fleeing and eluding, resisting arrest with violence

Title: DUI suspect leads Tavares police on slow-speed chase
description: Juan Arredondo was arrested in Tavares, Florida after deputies discovered him asleep behind the wheel of a vehicle blocking a roadway. When officers attempted to intervene, he failed to comply with lawful commands and subsequently drove away at a slow speed, leading police on a low-speed pursuit. The vehicle eventually stopped in a Wawa parking lot, where Arredondo refused to exit or remove his seatbelt. Officers reported signs of alcohol impairment, including the smell of alcohol and the presence of an open container in the vehicle. He was forcibly removed from the car and taken into custody after refusing sobriety and breath testing.
Charges: DUI, Resisting an Officer Without Violence, Fleeing and Eluding Law Enforcement

Title: Miami Police ID man who they say was caught on video fleeing stolen dump truck
description: Carlton Moss, a 42-year-old man, was arrested after allegedly stealing a dump truck in Miami, Florida. The truck had been left at a construction worksite and was later located using a GPS tracking device. Police and the owner found Moss sleeping inside the vehicle. When confronted, he exited the truck and fled on foot through neighborhoods and backyards. Officers searched the area with assistance from a helicopter and K-9 units. Moss was eventually found hiding in a backyard and taken into custody after being bitten by a police dog. He was transported to a hospital for treatment before booking.
Charges: Third-Degree Grand Theft Resisting an Officer Without Violence

Title: Okeechobee man arrested after driving 100 mph drunk on 'death trap' State Road 710, sheriff says
description: James Arthur Perry, 64, was arrested in Martin County, Florida after deputies observed him driving at a high rate of speed while impaired on State Road 710. Authorities reported that he was traveling approximately 100 mph in a 60 mph zone, towing a trailer, and crossing lanes in a no-passing area. A traffic stop was conducted, and officers initiated a DUI investigation after noticing signs of impairment. Breath samples taken hours after the arrest showed blood alcohol levels above the legal limit. The case occurred on a roadway previously described by officials as highly dangerous due to multiple serious crashes and fatalities.
Charges: DUI, Super Speeder Law violation, improper passing

Title: Sanford man charged after eluding police at 110 mph in Lake Mary
description: Sungchul Lim, a 27-year-old man, was arrested after allegedly leading law enforcement on a high-speed pursuit that began in Lake Mary, Florida. Authorities reported that Lim was driving approximately 110 mph in a 65 mph zone and failed to stop for a police officer attempting a traffic stop. Investigators said he tried to evade law enforcement before being apprehended in Sanford. After his arrest, Lim told detectives that he did not notice the officer’s emergency lights or hear the sirens because his mirrors were improperly positioned and the music in his vehicle was too loud. He was later detained.
Charges: Fleeing and Eluding Law Enforcement Excessive Speeding

Title: Domestic violence suspect arrested after fleeing through three counties
description: Korarise Hill, a 24-year-old man from Sanford, was arrested after a violent domestic violence incident that began in Palm Coast, Florida. According to investigators, he repeatedly assaulted a woman, strangled her until she lost consciousness, threatened to kill her with a firearm, and forced her to travel with him from Sanford to Palm Coast. The victim escaped by entering a gas station and seeking help from an employee, who called 911. When deputies approached Hill, he fled and led law enforcement on a high-speed chase through Flagler, Seminole, and Volusia counties before being apprehended and taken into custody.
Charges: Domestic violence-related offenses Aggravated battery/assault Strangulation Threatening victim with a firearm Fleeing and eluding law enforcement Multiple additional criminal charges filed

Title: Man arrested for false carjacking report and hospital escape in Celebration, deputies say
description: Bradley Knirschild was arrested by the Osceola County Sheriff’s Department after fleeing a traffic stop and later filing a false carjacking report. Following a DUI-related stop, he ran to an abandoned hotel while deputies searched the area. He later appeared at Celebration Hospital claiming he had been stabbed during a carjacking, but investigators determined the report was false and that his injuries occurred while fleeing police. After being arrested at the hospital, he escaped custody and ran into a stairwell, where he threatened to jump. Deputies negotiated with him successfully and returned him to custody without further incident.
Charges: Escape Battery on an officer Damaging government property False statement Probation violation Resisting arrest Driving with a suspended license

Title: Man arrested for stealing a fire truck out of the airport in Leesburg
description: Thomas Sisson, a 55-year-old man, was arrested after allegedly stealing a Leesburg Fire Department truck from the Leesburg International Airport. Authorities said he entered Station 63 through an open auto-bay door and found a fire department pickup truck with the keys inside. Believing the building was unoccupied, he started the vehicle and drove away from the property without authorization. A fire department lieutenant noticed the truck leaving and realized the driver was not an employee. Sisson later fled on foot and was suspected of attempting vehicle thefts at nearby dealerships before being apprehended and transported to jail.
Charges: Grand theft of a fire department vehicle Unauthorized use of a government vehicle Related theft offenses (specific charges not listed in article)

Title: Flagler teen faces charges after fleeing police during kidnapping investigation
description: A 15-year-old male was arrested in Flagler County during an investigation involving the alleged kidnapping and torture of an 11-year-old boy. Authorities said the teenager was accused of assisting 20-year-old Darnell Hairston in the crime. During a police stop, the juvenile fled the scene in a truck, leading deputies on a pursuit. The chase ended when the vehicle crashed, causing significant damage but no major injuries. Investigators arrested the teen and continued examining his role in the kidnapping case. The incident drew considerable attention in the community due to the serious nature of the allegations involving a child victim.
Charges: Involvement in kidnapping investigation Fleeing from police Potential reckless driving charges Other charges pending investigation

Title: Melbourne police capture escaped suspect after manhunt
description: Eric Jordan Jerry, a 25-year-old man, escaped police custody while being transported to Orlando Health in Melbourne, Florida, after claiming a medical issue that investigators later described as a ruse. Police say he removed his handcuffs, assaulted officers, and fled on foot before reaching the hospital, running into nearby woods. The incident triggered a large-scale manhunt involving SWAT teams, K-9 units, drones, and a sheriff’s helicopter. Authorities searched the hospital grounds and surrounding wooded areas for several hours. Jerry was later located and taken back into custody. Officials confirmed he now faces additional charges related to the escape.
Charges: Escape from Law Enforcement Custody  Battery on a Law Enforcement Officer  Original underlying arrest charges (not specified in article)

Title: Man robs Summerfield Dollar General days after release from jail, deputies say
description: Dexter Jackson, a Central Florida man with a prior armed robbery conviction, was arrested again in Marion County after allegedly robbing a Dollar General in Summerfield. Deputies say the incident occurred only days after his release from jail. He had previously been involved in a police pursuit in December where he fled from deputies and was later captured after a chase through wooded terrain. In the new case, authorities reported that Jackson committed another robbery shortly after being released on bond. Law enforcement tracked and apprehended him, returning him to custody for repeated violent and property-related offenses within a short period.
Charges: Armed Robbery  Fleeing and Eluding Law Enforcement  Additional charges related to theft (as reported in incident)

Title: Felony charges for woman who fled from troopers, hit tree in Leesburg
description: Carlise Gilleeny was arrested in Leesburg, Florida, after allegedly fleeing from Florida Highway Patrol troopers during a traffic stop. Authorities say she drove a silver Toyota Tacoma and later crashed into a tree at the end of a dead-end road. After abandoning the vehicle, she attempted to flee on foot but was located by law enforcement after a search involving the Lake County Sheriff’s Office. Investigators reported signs of impairment and additional violations during the incident. She was taken into custody by deputies and later charged in connection with reckless driving, DUI-related offenses, and resisting law enforcement.
Charges: Fleeing or Attempting to Elude Law Enforcement (Reckless)  DUI Resulting in Property Damage  Leaving the Scene of a Crash  Driving with Suspended or Revoked License  Refusal to Submit to DUI Test  Obstruction Without Violence

Title: Teen charged as adult in Flagler County kidnapping case
description: Junior Bishop, a 15-year-old juvenile charged as an adult, was arrested in Flagler County following a traffic stop on December 31, 2025. Deputies say Bishop was involved in a kidnapping-related investigation connected to a missing juvenile and a registered sex offender. During the stop, he allegedly fled by stealing a vehicle and was later taken into custody by the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office. Authorities stated Bishop was already on probation for a prior violent offense at the time of the incident. He now faces multiple serious felony charges, including aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer and grand theft of a motor vehicle.
Charges: Aggravated Battery on a Law Enforcement Officer  Grand Theft of a Motor Vehicle  Kidnapping-related felony charges (as part of investigation)  Violation of Probation (implied)

Title: CAUGHT ON CAMERA: Police arrest ‘Oscar the Grouch,’ after he fled officers during traffic stop
description: Police in Huber Heights, Ohio, conducted a traffic stop that escalated when the driver fled on foot after the vehicle came to a stop. Officers briefly lost sight of the suspect and established a perimeter in the area. A garbage truck worker later discovered the man hiding inside a trash bin while collecting waste and immediately alerted police. The suspect attempted to flee again but was quickly apprehended without any reported injuries. The incident involved a short foot pursuit and concealment attempt. No additional details were provided regarding motive, substances, or further criminal activity beyond resisting and fleeing law enforcement.
Charges: fleeing/eluding and resisting law enforcement

Title: “It was an ambush;” Man attacked while trying to be Good Samaritan on Florida highway
description: A 44-year-old man, Daniel Coman, was arrested in Orange County, Florida after violently attacking a Good Samaritan who stopped to help him on U.S. Highway 429. The victim, Hans Hamilton, found Coman lying near what appeared to be a crash scene and attempted to assist him. According to deputies, Coman suddenly assaulted the victim, striking him repeatedly and damaging his vehicle. The attack escalated into a prolonged beating before law enforcement arrived. Deputies say Coman later resisted arrest and assaulted officers as well. The victim suffered multiple injuries, including broken ribs and a brain bleed, requiring significant medical treatment and expenses.
Charges: Battery; assault of a law enforcement officer; resisting an officer with violence

Title: Protester identified following arrest outside Orlando ICE facility
description: A 23-year-old woman, Alexis Clark of Daytona Beach, was arrested outside an ICE facility in Orlando during a protest. Authorities say she struck an ICE agent’s vehicle and later confronted law enforcement officers as they responded to the scene. The situation escalated when officers moved in to detain her amid what officials described as rising tensions during the demonstration. Deputies charged her after she allegedly assaulted law enforcement and resisted arrest. Law enforcement emphasized that while peaceful protest is protected, violence and property damage are not. She was later released from jail pending her court proceedings scheduled for February.
Charges: Assault on a law enforcement officer; resisting arrest; property damage (vehicle striking incident)

Title: Loaded guns found during traffic stop: 19-year-old arrested in Orlando
description: A 19-year-old man, Sidney Rogers, was arrested in Orlando after police conducted a traffic stop and discovered two loaded firearms in his backpack. Officers with the Orlando Police Department were patrolling downtown when they recognized Rogers as a passenger in an SUV. During the stop near South Magnolia Avenue and East Pine Street, officers removed a backpack positioned between his legs and found a Draco-style AR pistol and an AM-15 style pistol, both loaded. Rogers was already wanted on a Lake County burglary warrant. He was taken into custody and later extradited to Lake County for the pending charges.
Charges: Carrying a concealed firearm; Lake County warrant for vehicle burglary

Title: Deputies arrest a Columbus man after reckless driving on US 33
description: Logan County Sheriff’s deputies arrested a Columbus man after multiple reports of reckless driving on US 33 near State Route 540. Witnesses reported a silver Ford Taurus without a license plate driving erratically, speeding up and slowing down, crossing lane lines, and partially leaving the roadway. The vehicle nearly went into the grass before deputies located it near County Road 57 and initiated a traffic stop. The driver, identified as Dorian Brown, showed signs of impairment and failed field sobriety tests. He initially denied drinking and stated he held a commercial driver’s license before being taken into custody.
Charges: Operating a Vehicle Impaired (OVI), Failure to use turn signal

Title: Bengals player headed to jail after pleading guilty in reckless driving case
description: Cincinnati Bengals cornerback Cam Taylor-Britt was sentenced to five days in jail after pleading guilty to reckless driving and driving without a valid license from two separate incidents. Police said he previously drove through downtown Cincinnati, ran red lights, crossed center lines, and engaged in dangerous driving behavior including speeding and burnouts. Officers testified he drove on the wrong side of the road and posed a risk to public safety. In court, the judge questioned his behavior and called the sentence “generous.” Taylor-Britt apologized, stating he regretted his actions. He was taken into custody immediately after the sentencing hearing.
Charges: Reckless driving, driving without a valid license

Title: 31-year-old man with 7 active warrants arrested after fleeing from traffic stop in Dayton
description: Dayton police arrested a 31-year-old man during a Violent Crime Reduction Operation after he fled from a traffic stop at a high rate of speed. Officers attempted to stop the vehicle on March 27, 2026, but the suspect fled and later abandoned the vehicle, escaping on foot behind a residence. Ohio State Highway Patrol aviation units assisted in tracking him during the pursuit. Officers eventually captured him. Police reported that the man was a convicted felon in possession of a loaded handgun and more than $18,000 in cash, and he also had seven active felony warrants at the time of arrest.
Charges: Multiple felony charges; unlawful possession of firearm by a felon; fleeing and eluding; outstanding warrants

Title: 5 arrested in burglary ring targeting Asian American business owners
description: West Chester police and the Southwest Ohio Burglary Task Force arrested five suspects connected to an alleged organized burglary ring targeting Asian American business owners. Detectives identified four male suspects preparing to burglarize a home in the Beckett Ridge neighborhood. During the arrests, some suspects fled, including vehicles involved in the incident. One suspect was arrested at the scene, another after fleeing on foot, and others after vehicle stops and a brief pursuit. A fifth female suspect was later arrested in Franklin County, Indiana. Authorities continue investigating the burglary operation.
Charges: Burglary-related charges

Title: Man sentenced to prison after 2 gun arrests in 4 months
description: Montand Mosley, 21, was sentenced to three years in prison after being arrested twice within four months on firearm-related charges in Youngstown, Ohio. Police arrested him in May after a traffic stop for running a stop sign led to a vehicle search where a loaded handgun was allegedly found. He was arrested again in August while on bail, after officers searched a vehicle and allegedly found another loaded firearm. Mosley pleaded guilty to two counts of being a felon in possession of a firearm. The court noted his prior juvenile conviction prevented him from legally possessing firearms.
Charges: Felon in possession of a firearm (two counts)

Title: Memphis man fighting for his life after being shot during police chase in Ohio
description: Jeffery Latson Jr., a Memphis man and semi-truck driver, led police on a dangerous pursuit after allegedly threatening people inside an IHOP during a disturbance call in Springfield Township, Ohio on February 28, 2026. Officers located his truck near a Walmart parking lot, where he refused to comply with commands to exit the vehicle. When officers attempted to block him in, he accelerated, striking and injuring a police officer before fleeing onto nearby roadways. The chase continued toward I-77 and was later transferred to other agencies. Officers ultimately opened fire when he attempted to flee again in Akron. He was hospitalized after the shooting.
Charges: Aggravated menacing; felonious assault on a law enforcement officer; unlawful fleeing and eluding

Title: Miami-Dade man arrested after kidnapping incident that ended in violent crash
description: Ronald Trayvon Kelly, a 29-year-old Miami-Dade man, was arrested after allegedly kidnapping a man and leading police on a brief but violent pursuit in Miami Gardens, Florida. Authorities say the victim was being held against his will inside Kelly’s red pickup truck and was able to call 911 while providing real-time location updates. Officers located the vehicle traveling at high speed through construction zones, where it nearly struck a worker. During the pursuit, Kelly reportedly ran stop signs, a red light, drove into oncoming traffic, and hit barricades. A PIT maneuver eventually caused the truck to crash and roll over before arrest.
Charges: Kidnapping; aggravated fleeing and eluding with injury

Title: GCSO: Car chase leads to arrest of ‘sexual predator’
description: Torey Ash, a designated sexual predator in Florida, was arrested after a police pursuit that ended in a crash in Gadsden County. Authorities say multiple law enforcement agencies were involved in the chase before Ash’s vehicle crashed at the intersection of North Bethel Street and Wallace Drive. After the crash, Ash exited the vehicle and attempted to flee on foot. Officers quickly pursued him and took him into custody in the 100 block of Wallace Drive without further incident. He was wanted on outstanding warrants related to sexual predator violations and additional offenses connected to fleeing and firearm possession charges.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding; DWLSR (driving while license suspended/revoked); possession of a firearm by a convicted felon; outstanding sexual predator violations

Title: Carjacking suspect arrested after chase, PIT maneuver in Escambia County
description: Parcardin Gandy, a 32-year-old man with multiple felony warrants, was arrested in Escambia County, Florida, after a carjacking-related incident that led to a police pursuit. Deputies say Gandy fled from law enforcement while driving a black Chevrolet Impala with an unassigned license tag. During the chase, he committed traffic violations before officers used a PIT maneuver to safely end the pursuit on Glendora Drive. After the crash, Gandy attempted to flee on foot but was quickly apprehended by deputies at the scene. A passenger in the vehicle was also detained due to outstanding warrants with another agency.
Charges: Aggravated fleeing and eluding; carjacking-related charges; unassigned tag violation; multiple felony warrants

Title: Florida man accused of fleeing at more than 115 mph with $8,800
city and state: Indian River County to St. Lucie County, Florida
description: Deangilo Williams, a 36-year-old Florida man from the Lakewood Park area, was arrested after a high-speed police pursuit that began in Indian River County and ended in St. Lucie County. Investigators say Williams fled a traffic stop and drove at speeds exceeding 115 mph while carrying approximately $8,800. During the encounter, he allegedly ran over a deputy’s foot while attempting to evade arrest. The pursuit involved reckless driving and continued across county lines before officers successfully stopped him. He was taken into custody after the chase and transported to jail following medical evaluation and processing by law enforcement authorities.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding a law enforcement officer; reckless driving; super speeder violation (over 100 mph); aggravated battery with a deadly weapon (two counts)

Title: Federal fugitive captured in Hialeah after tasing, multi-agency search
description: Authorities identified a 41-year-old federal fugitive, Yam Perera Nunez, who was arrested after a coordinated multi-agency search in Hialeah. Florida Highway Patrol attempted a traffic stop on Okeechobee Road, but the suspect refused to stop and initiated a pursuit. During the chase, he abandoned his vehicle in the Northwest 137th Avenue area and fled on foot. Law enforcement agencies, including Hialeah Police Department K-9 units, established a perimeter and searched the area. Officers later located him near a Walgreens at West 68th Street and 12th Avenue, where he was tased and taken into custody without further incident or injuries reported.
Charges: Aggravated assault, aggravated fleeing and eluding, battery, resisting arrest with violence, grand theft, federal charges

Title: Marianna man arrested after police chase
description: On February 2, 2026, Marianna Police Department officers attempted a traffic stop on a white Hyundai for equipment and registration violations in Marianna, Florida. The driver, identified as Frank White Jr., refused to stop and initiated a pursuit through residential streets, running stop signs and driving at high speed. The vehicle eventually stopped in the 4000 block of Roulhac Street, where White exited and fled on foot. During the foot chase, he attempted to enter a nearby residence and resisted arrest before being taken into custody. Officers recovered an 8.25-inch knife and suspected narcotics later identified as Alpha-PVP. No injuries were reported.
Charges: Aggravated fleeing or eluding a law enforcement officer Leaving the scene of a crash involving property damage Driving while license suspended or revoked with knowledge Resisting arrest without violence Felon in possession of a concealed weapon Possession of Alpha-PVP

Title: MDSO asks for public’s help after it says suspect almost ran over detectives
description: On May 5, 2026, Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office detectives attempted a traffic stop on a suspect vehicle in Miami, Florida near Southwest Fourth Avenue and Eighth Street close to I-95. The suspect, identified as Jimmy Altidor, allegedly placed his car in reverse and nearly struck two detectives while also colliding with their unmarked police vehicles. He then fled the scene, and the abandoned vehicle was later recovered. Authorities say Altidor continued fleeing on foot and has since been the subject of a multi-county search. Law enforcement issued a public request for information and described the incident as an intentional attempt to evade and endanger officers.
Charges: Aggravated assault on law enforcement officers Fleeing and eluding police Criminal mischief (vehicle damage) Resisting arrest with violence (expected/related charges)

Title: Boston man driving U-Haul truck flipped off deputies, sped through Florida Keys school zone, sheriff says
description: On January 6, 2026, Monroe County Sheriff’s Office deputies in the Florida Keys, Florida attempted to stop a U-Haul box truck reported for reckless driving along U.S. 1 near mile marker 95. The driver, identified as Idibek Jalilov, continued driving through a school zone near mile marker 90, where he allegedly made an obscene gesture toward deputies and committed multiple traffic violations including speeding and following too closely. Deputies activated emergency lights and sirens, but the driver refused to stop until approximately mile marker 85. He was later arrested and charged after the pursuit ended. No injuries were reported during the incident.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding law enforcement
