Title: Man arrested for speeding through St. Augustine preschool parking lot while fleeing police: ‘No regard’
description: On January 26, 2026, the St. Johns County Sheriff’s Office in St. Augustine, Florida attempted a traffic stop on a vehicle with a stolen license plate driven by Hector Suarez De La Barrera. Instead of stopping, the suspect fled police and drove through a preschool parking lot during dismissal time, creating a serious safety hazard for children and parents. Deputies reported he showed no regard for public safety while attempting to evade capture. The vehicle eventually stopped behind the preschool, after which the suspect exited and fled on foot. He was later tased and taken into custody without further incident.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding with disregard for public safety Resisting an officer without violence Theft (stolen license plate related)

Title: Florida woman arrested for intentionally driving over ducklings
description: A 64-year-old Florida woman, Beverly Sasberry, was arrested after investigators determined she intentionally drove over a group of ducklings on April 25, 2026, in Jacksonville, Florida. Witnesses reported seeing her use a red Honda Accord to run over the ducklings and allegedly turn the vehicle around multiple times to strike them again. The witnesses later confronted her, and she reportedly stated she killed the ducks because they made a mess in her yard. Surveillance video was provided to law enforcement, leading officers to identify and stop her vehicle. She was arrested and later released on bond after booking.
Charges: 11 felony counts of animal cruelty 1 count of reckless driving

Title: MDSO: Woman arrested on DUI charges after she struck deputy with car in Kendall
description: Janice Garcia, 28, of Miami, was arrested after striking a Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office deputy with her vehicle in Kendall, Florida, on April 11, 2026. According to investigators, the deputy was on patrol when Garcia’s vehicle, a blue Mazda, struck him as he was outside his patrol car in the 8500 block of Southwest 99th Court. The impact threw the deputy into the air, causing life-threatening injuries, including a concussion, multiple bodily injuries, and surgeries such as a skin graft and ankle repair. Authorities reported signs of impairment, including slurred speech and bloodshot eyes. Garcia later failed field sobriety tests and was charged after blood tests confirmed elevated alcohol levels.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under the Influence) DUI Causing Serious Bodily Injury

Title: Panama City man charged with reckless driving after damaging 50 graves at Oakland Cemetery
description: Willie Russ, a 48-year-old man from Panama City, was arrested after allegedly driving recklessly into Oakland Cemetery and damaging or destroying approximately 50 graves and tombstones. Police reported that Russ was operating a vehicle in the cemetery area late at night when he entered the grounds and continued driving instead of stopping, causing extensive damage. The City of Panama City’s Parks, Culture and Recreation Department began assessing the destruction and coordinating repairs. The incident resulted in significant property damage to burial sites and prompted a criminal investigation.
Charges: Reckless driving, criminal mischief

Title: ‘I need help:’ Son calls 911 on his mom over drunken speeding, Orlando police say
description: Katina Yvette Graham, a 52-year-old woman, was arrested in Orlando after police said she drove under the influence with a minor in the vehicle and reached speeds around 100 mph. According to an arrest affidavit, her child called 911 reporting that she was intoxicated and driving recklessly. Officers responded after the vehicle struck a curb and damaged tires. Police reported signs of impairment, including slurred speech and alcohol odor, and she failed field sobriety tests. Authorities also noted she had left another individual unattended in a car for an extended period before driving intoxicated.
Charges: DUI while accompanied by a minor, child abuse

Title: Struthers woman accused of recklessly driving while intoxicated with juvenile in vehicle
description: Delores Kitchen, a 45-year-old woman from Struthers, Ohio, was accused of recklessly driving while intoxicated with a juvenile passenger in her vehicle. Police reported that she sped, passed vehicles in no-passing zones, ran red lights, and reached speeds up to 65–70 mph while attempting to evade a traffic stop. Officers observed dangerous driving behavior including nearly colliding with another vehicle after crossing into oncoming traffic. After being stopped, she showed signs of impairment and admitted to drinking alcohol. A breath test reportedly showed a blood alcohol level above the legal limit.
Charges: OVI (operating a vehicle impaired), reckless operation, failure to comply with police signal, endangering children

Title: Woman charged with DUI after crashing into Fort Myers home
description: A woman was charged after crashing a vehicle into a home in Fort Myers, Florida, in the early morning hours. Deputies with the Lee County Sheriff’s Office said she was driving under the influence after returning from Fort Myers Beach when she fell asleep at the wheel. The vehicle left the roadway and struck a residential home, causing significant damage but no injuries to the occupants inside. The driver reportedly awoke after the crash and entered the home briefly while interacting with the residents. Authorities arrested her on DUI-related charges, including property damage and refusal to submit testing. The family was displaced temporarily.
Charges: DUI, DUI with property damage, refusal to submit testing

Title: Broward driver claims she’s ‘blind in both eyes’ after DUI hit-and-run injuring 3, deputies say
description: A 33-year-old woman, Karen Barrios, was arrested after allegedly causing a DUI-related crash in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Deputies say she failed to yield while exiting I-95 onto Marina Mile Boulevard, striking a Jeep carrying three people. The impact caused the Jeep to flip multiple times, injuring at least two occupants with cuts. Barrios allegedly fled the scene without helping victims and was later located in a parking lot in Dania Beach. Deputies reported signs of impairment, including slurred speech, glassy eyes, and balance issues. She also claimed vision and seizure-related medical conditions during the investigation.
Charges: DUI DUI causing property damage or injury (3 counts) Hit-and-run involving serious bodily injury

Title: Florida man causing havoc at airport admits to getting high and drunk after AA meeting
description: Bryan Parker, a 58-year-old man from Holly Hill, was arrested after authorities say he drove a Ford Mustang through a locked gate at Daytona Beach International Airport and entered restricted airfield areas. Deputies report he nearly struck a taxiing aircraft and then exited his vehicle, running toward multiple planes while appearing highly intoxicated. An airport worker intervened and helped detain him before he was arrested by law enforcement. Parker reportedly made statements indicating confusion and claimed he did not remember how he reached the airport. Officials said he admitted to using alcohol and drugs, including cocaine and marijuana, after an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting.
Charges: Attempted aircraft piracy Exposure of sexual organs (2 counts) Burglary of an unoccupied conveyance Trespass upon operational area of an airport Criminal mischief DUI crash with damage Refusal to submit to DUI testing DUI (third offense within 10 years)

Title: Man leaves jail after being accused of striking boy with car in Miami Gardens
description: Jalen Darius Forbes, a 23-year-old man from Miami Gardens, was arrested after police said he struck an 11-year-old boy with his car while attempting to bypass traffic in a school zone. Authorities report Forbes was driving at a high rate of speed and tried to maneuver around traffic when he drove onto the right of way, lost control of his Ford Fusion, and jumped a sidewalk before hitting the child. The boy was seriously injured and airlifted to a trauma center for treatment. Surveillance footage reportedly shows the vehicle speeding and then striking the child. Police arrested Forbes for reckless driving-related offenses.
Charges: Reckless driving Reckless driving causing serious bodily injury

Title: MDSO gives positive update on deputy badly injured after being hit by SUV
description: Lonnel Brinson Jr., a 28-year-old man, was involved in a serious crash in Doral, Florida, where a Miami-Dade Sheriff’s deputy was struck by an SUV while assisting a State Trooper with a traffic investigation on the Florida Turnpike. Authorities say the deputy was hit by the vehicle and launched into the air, sustaining serious injuries. Investigators report that Brinson admitted to using alcohol and marijuana before the crash. The injured deputy has since shown signs of recovery, including being awake and alert. Brinson was arrested and is facing charges related to reckless driving causing serious bodily injury.
Charges: Reckless driving causing serious bodily injury

Title: Driver accused of crashing into police car while trying to run over 2 men in Miami-Dade
description: Nathan Romero, a 32-year-old man from Kissimmee, was arrested in Miami Gardens, Florida, after authorities say he violently used his vehicle to attack multiple people during a confrontation on Interstate 95. Investigators report he drove a Toyota Corolla aggressively, reversing and then accelerating toward two men in what appeared to be an attempt to run them over. The victims were able to escape without being hit. Romero also struck a concrete wall, another vehicle, and a law enforcement sergeant’s unmarked car during the incident. Police say he exited his vehicle armed with a knife but ultimately dropped it after being confronted by an officer and surrendered. He was taken into custody and hospitalized before being booked into jail.
Charges: Aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer Aggravated battery with a deadly weapon (2 counts) Reckless driving with damage to property or person (warrant case)

Title: Man arrested after fleeing from cops in Lamborghini SUV, Miami Gardens police say
description: Kimani Kirk Simons, a 25-year-old man from Miramar, was arrested after fleeing from police in an orange Lamborghini SUV during a multi-agency pursuit across South Florida. Authorities say the vehicle was first flagged after fleeing from Miramar police, then tracked as it traveled through multiple areas including Miami Gardens. Officers attempted a traffic stop, but Simons allegedly refused to stop, drove at high speeds, and ran a red light while continuing to evade law enforcement. The pursuit ended when the SUV crashed into another vehicle in Miami Gardens. Simons and a passenger exited the vehicle, but he was quickly detained nearby by officers.
Charges: Aggravated fleeing or eluding police Leaving the scene of a crash without serious injury Resisting an officer without violence Reckless driving causing damage to property or a person

Title: Florida man accused of ramming home, leading deputies on wild chase
description: Deputies with the Lee County Sheriff's Office arrested FernandoJoseph Absalon after a violent incident in Fort Myers, Florida. Investigators said a domestic dispute escalated when Absalon allegedly used a truck to ram a neighboring vehicle and a modular home multiple times, causing significant property damage. He then drove to a residence linked to an active domestic violence injunction. When deputies attempted contact, he fled in his vehicle, driving recklessly through a neighborhood, striking a street sign and nearly hitting a patrol unit. The pursuit ended when deputies deployed a PIT maneuver, safely stopping the truck and taking him into custody.
Charges: Aggravated assault with intent to commit a felony, criminal mischief, fleeing and eluding law enforcement, hit-and-run involving property damage, multiple counts of violating a domestic violence injunction

Title: Man wanted for probation violation after fleeing Fort Myers police on scooter, crashing
description: Fort Myers police were involved in the arrest of Larry Simmons after a brief pursuit that began when officers observed him riding a scooter without lights on a busy roadway. When officers attempted a stop, Simmons tried to flee but lost control and crashed the scooter. He then attempted to run on foot, leading officers on a short chase before being apprehended. Simmons reportedly admitted he fled because he had an outstanding warrant in another county and did not want to return to jail. Authorities confirmed he was also wanted for a probation violation and had multiple outstanding legal issues.
Charges: Probation violation, outstanding warrant (Charlotte County), fleeing and eluding, additional related charges pending

Title: Video: Man accused of beating woman, forcing her to drive him flees Fla. LEOs at 120 mph before arrest
description: Flagler County deputies and Florida Highway Patrol troopers pursued a man after a violent domestic incident in which a woman reported being assaulted, threatened with a firearm, and forced to drive. The suspect fled from a gas station as deputies arrived, initiating a high-speed chase across multiple counties. During the pursuit, he drove recklessly, ran red lights, and reached speeds exceeding 120 mph on Interstate 95. Law enforcement used multiple PIT maneuvers in an attempt to stop the vehicle. The chase ended roadside when the suspect finally stopped and was taken into custody at gunpoint without further incident.
Charges: Domestic battery, false imprisonment, leaving the scene of a crash with property damage, fleeing or attempting to elude law enforcement with disregard for safety of persons or property

Title: Campbell man accused of fleeing police is indicted
description: Police attempted to stop a pickup truck after it ran a stop sign at Hillman Street and Ravenwood Avenue in Youngstown. The driver allegedly refused to stop, claiming he had no brakes, and continued driving through multiple intersections, sometimes in the wrong lane and through yards. The pursuit extended onto Interstate 680 where the vehicle traveled erratically before stopping near South Avenue. The driver, identified as James Mrofchak, fled on foot but was apprehended by officers after a brief struggle. He was taken to hospital for complaints of pain. An open container of alcohol was found in the vehicle there
Charges: Failure to comply with order or signal of a police officer, obstructing official business, escape

Title: ‘Help me!’: Suspect arrested after getting locked in van while trying to steal from it
description: Dean Young was arrested in Hialeah, Florida, after attempting to burglarize a landscaper’s van. According to police reports and witness video, Young entered the back of a parked work van while landscapers were working nearby. The vehicle owner remotely locked the van, unintentionally trapping Young inside. He was unable to escape and began yelling for help while damaging the interior as he tried to get out. Hialeah Police arrived shortly after and took him into custody without further incident. Authorities confirmed the landscaper had previously experienced theft, leading to the precaution of locking the vehicle remotely during work.
Charges: Attempted burglary, criminal mischief

Title: Man fires short-barreled AR-15-style rifle out window before crashing into fence, Volusia deputies say
description: Volusia County deputies arrested 34-year-old Justin Michael Hall after reports that shots were fired from a moving SUV in a residential area of Deltona. A 911 caller reported a white Chevy Tahoe driving through East Kicklighter Road and Sand Crane Lane while multiple rounds were discharged from inside the vehicle. Deputies later located the SUV and identified Hall as the driver. According to investigators, a short-barreled AR-15-style rifle was recovered from the vehicle. Hall allegedly had a high blood alcohol content, with breath test results around 0.19. He was arrested after crashing into a fence and mailboxes.
Charges: DUI Discharging a firearm from a vehicle Possession of a short-barreled rifle Tampering with evidence

Title: Video shows alleged drunk driver plowing through Florida Ironman race: "He's gonna kill someone"
description: During a Florida Ironman event, a driver allegedly entered the closed race course and repeatedly drove through areas where athletes were running and cycling, putting participants and spectators at serious risk. Law enforcement said officers were actively blocking roads for the event when the driver ignored attempts to stop him and continued through the course. A pursuit followed, and officers reported the vehicle nearly struck athletes multiple times. A PIT maneuver was eventually used to end the incident and bring the vehicle to a stop. The suspect was arrested and faces multiple felony and misdemeanor charges related to DUI and reckless driving.
Charges: Eight felony charges and multiple misdemeanors (including DUI and reckless driving)

Title: Teen driver arrested on DUI charges after crash injures victims in Neptune Beach
description: A 19-year-old driver was arrested in Neptune Beach after a high-speed rear-end collision that injured multiple victims. Police said the crash occurred when the suspect struck another vehicle from behind, causing it to veer off the road into a tree line. Emergency responders from Jacksonville Fire and Rescue extracted the injured occupants and transported them to a hospital for treatment. During the investigation, officers reported signs of impairment and initiated a DUI investigation. The driver was taken into custody at the scene. Authorities charged him in connection with impaired driving and traffic offenses related to the crash and resulting injuries.
Charges: DUI with property damage and personal injury; DUI under the influence of alcohol; possession of alcohol under 21; open container; careless driving; expired registration

Title: Miami man arrested after US-90 high-speed chase in Columbia County, deputies say
description: A 29-year-old Miami man, Robert Peterson Cyron, was arrested after a dangerous high-speed chase on US-90 in Columbia County, Florida. Deputies attempted to stop a brown Jeep after it ran a red light, but the driver fled instead of pulling over. The vehicle reportedly reached speeds of up to 108 mph, drove the wrong way on the roadway, and turned off its headlights while trying to evade law enforcement. The pursuit ended when deputies performed a PIT maneuver on CR-137, successfully stopping the vehicle. Authorities also reported the driver attempted to switch seats with a passenger to avoid responsibility.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding law enforcement; driving with a suspended license

Title: Jacksonville Parks & Rec director returns to work after being arrested for DUI
description: Jacksonville, Florida
Charges: DUI-related offenses; refusal to submit to a breathalyzer test

Title: Driver of BMW flees crash scene in Lake Worth, leaving 19-year-old with critical injuries
description: A 20-year-old man was arrested in Lake Worth, Florida, after fleeing a traffic stop and causing a violent crash that left a 19-year-old woman critically injured. Deputies with the Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office attempted to stop the BMW X4 driven by Travis Tavares Towns, but he refused to pull over and continued speeding. Shortly after, his vehicle struck a Toyota Camry at an intersection, causing severe injuries to the driver. Towns then fled the scene on foot without providing aid. A K-9 unit later tracked and arrested him. He was charged with resisting arrest and remains under investigation case.
Charges: Resisting arrest

Title: 85-year-old Florida man arrested for hitting 110 mph in street race against Corvette
description: An 85-year-old Florida man, Williams Bosworth, was accused of street racing in Leesburg after police reported he was driving a Nissan 350Z convertible at about 110 mph in a 45 mph zone while allegedly racing a red Chevrolet Corvette reaching approximately 125 mph. Officers conducted a traffic stop late at night on June 12 and detained Bosworth after observing high-speed driving behavior consistent with street racing. Bosworth denied racing and claimed he was only enjoying a drive in his favorite car. He was arrested along with the Corvette driver and charged under Florida’s super speeder law for excessive speeding charges
Charges: Street racing; dangerous excessive speeding

Title: Teen street racer arrested after leaving burnout marks on road
description: An 18-year-old Minneola resident was arrested in Clermont after deputies responded to multiple calls reporting reckless driving and street takeover activity near Ray Goodgame Parkway. Witnesses saw vehicles performing donuts and burnouts, leaving fresh tire marks and creating traffic disruptions close to a fire station area. Deputies reported hearing tire squealing and seeing smoke from burning rubber behind a warehouse. They observed a blue four-door car spinning its rear tires and sliding in travel lanes while spectators filmed the activity. The driver and a juvenile passenger were not wearing seatbelts. The vehicle was stopped and the driver was taken into custody.
Charges: Street racing / street takeover

Title: BMW driver arrested on DUI charge after weaving through traffic near Florida Turnpike
description: A 31-year-old Minneola man was arrested for DUI after officers in Groveland observed him driving a silver BMW erratically near U.S. Highway 27 and the Florida Turnpike. Dispatch had initially received reports of a reckless driver traveling northbound, weaving between lanes and driving below the speed limit. Officers later found the vehicle heading southbound and observed multiple lane violations, including crossing the fog line. When stopped, the driver showed clear signs of impairment including bloodshot eyes, slurred speech, and vomit on the vehicle. He attempted but refused field sobriety tests and later provided a breath sample of 0.173 BAC before being arrested.
Charges: DUI, refusal to submit blood alcohol test, refusal to sign citation, failure to maintain lane, impeding traffic

Title: Party chaos caught on camera as police push new tactic to scare spring breakers
description: Authorities in Bay County, Florida conducted a series of enforcement actions during spring break-related incidents involving street racing and disorderly parties. In one key event on February 28, 2026, deputies observed two vehicles engaged in a high-speed street racing incident, with one reaching approximately 107 mph in a 45 mph zone. The driver identified as Rodney Jackson was arrested after being stopped and taken into custody. The broader operation also involved multiple house party disruptions, arrests for assault and resisting officers, and the removal of intoxicated individuals. Law enforcement implemented strict measures, including curfews and alcohol restrictions, to control escalating spring break activity.
Charges: Street racing on roadway, super speeder (over 100 mph), disorderly conduct-related offenses (contextual spring break enforcement)

Title: Miami Gardens man arrested after fleeing Florida Keys deputies at 125 mph, sheriff says
description: Jefry Julian Chaucanes Vasquez, a 23-year-old man from Miami Gardens, was arrested after allegedly fleeing from Monroe County Sheriff's Office deputies during a traffic stop attempt in the Florida Keys. Deputies observed him driving a Mazda sedan at 90 mph on U.S. 1 near Mile Marker 80. When officers attempted to stop him, he accelerated and reached speeds of up to 125 mph while illegally passing other vehicles. Deputies deployed tire spikes near Mile Marker 83, successfully stopping the vehicle. Vasquez was taken into custody, and authorities reportedly found two THC vape devices in his possession during the arrest.
Charges: DUI (Driving Under the Influence) Fleeing and Eluding Possession of a Controlled Substance Without a Prescription Reckless Driving Dangerous/Excessive Speeding

Title: Man on dirt bike struck pedestrian while trying to flee from Miami officers, cops say
description: Chamari Pippins, 22, was arrested in Miami after police said he attempted to flee from officers while riding a Yamaha dirt bike in the Wynwood area. Officers were responding to a large group of off-road vehicles blocking traffic when they approached Pippins. According to the report, he accelerated in an attempt to escape, lost control of the dirt bike, and struck a pedestrian on the sidewalk before hitting a parked vehicle. The victim suffered injuries and was hospitalized. Police also reported that Pippins was found carrying a loaded Glock 45 handgun with an extended magazine during the arrest.
Charges: Aggravated Fleeing and Eluding Causing Injury Possession of a Weapon While Committing an Offense Resisting an Officer Without Violence Failure to Obey a Police Officer Failure to Have Vehicle Registration

Title: Suspected car thief arrested in Crestview after police chase
description: On April 18, 2026, a 22-year-old suspect, Isaac Jay Schlabach, was arrested in Crestview, Florida after a multi-county vehicle theft and police pursuit. Authorities said the stolen vehicle was reported from Duval County (Jacksonville) and tracked by the Walton County Sheriff’s Office as it entered Walton County. Deputies attempted a traffic stop near the Mossy Head exit, but the driver fled, initiating a chase into Okaloosa County. The pursuit ended when the suspect crashed into a fence off Brookmeade Drive in Crestview. He was taken into custody and booked into the Okaloosa County Jail on grand theft and fleeing charges.
Charges: Grand theft Fleeing and eluding

Suspect Name: Wesly Castor; J'Darius Rayrell Clermont; Jontrell Demond Jones; Charlie Savion Sturgis
Title: 4 armed robbery suspects nabbed after deputies use grappler on getaway SUV in Lee County
description: Four suspects were arrested after an armed robbery investigation in Lee County, Florida. Deputies responded to a reported robbery near 43rd Street West and Sunshine Boulevard North. The victim said a suspect entered his vehicle during a backpack sale, pulled out a handgun, and demanded property. Additional masked suspects arrived in a black Range Rover SUV and took more items. During the escape, suspects allegedly fired shots at the victim, who was not injured. The vehicle was later located by the Lee County Sheriff’s Office aviation team, and deputies used a grappler device to stop it. Stolen property and evidence were recovered.
Charges: Jontrell Demond Jones, J'Darius Rayrell Clermont, and Charlie Savion Sturgis: Robbery with a firearm Wesly Castor: Accessory after the fact

Title: Traffic stop reveals suspect after shots fired in Clermont, police say
description: Police responded to East Minneola Avenue and Disston Street in Clermont after reports that a person fired shots at another individual. Officers arrived and learned that the suspect, Justin Akeem Fedrick, had left the area before police arrived. No one was injured in the shooting. Authorities later obtained an arrest warrant. Around 4 p.m., officers conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle carrying Fedrick. He fled from the vehicle on foot but was captured and arrested by officers. Fedrick was taken into custody and charged following the reported shooting and subsequent attempt to evade police.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon Discharging a firearm in public Resisting arrest

Title: Driver suspected of DUI admits to having ‘a few’ at local tavern
description: John Robert Stiller, a 60-year-old man from Grand Island, was arrested for suspected DUI after a traffic stop in Fruitland Park. An officer observed Stiller’s white Nissan SUV traveling on U.S. Highway 27/441 with its tires crossing lane markings. During the stop, officers reported smelling alcohol, observing slurred speech, and noticing bloodshot, glassy eyes. Stiller told police he was returning home from Cheshire’s Hilltop Tavern and admitted having “a few” drinks. He performed field sobriety exercises but showed signs of impairment. Police found empty beer cans inside the vehicle, and he was arrested and booked into jail.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: Suspected drunk driver stopped with bottle of vodka hidden under towel
description: Brian Lan Ray, a 50-year-old Gainesville man, was arrested for suspected DUI after a traffic stop in Fruitland Park. Police said an officer observed Ray speeding in a red passenger car on U.S. Highway 27 near Griffin Avenue and later stopped him at U.S. Highway 27 and County Road 25A. Officers reported signs of impairment, including bloodshot eyes, alcohol odor, and poor performance during sobriety exercises. A nearly empty vodka bottle was found hidden under a towel inside the vehicle. Ray refused to provide a breath sample and was arrested for DUI-related charges.
Charges: DUI (second offense) and refusal to submit breath test (second offense)

Title: DUI suspect on the way home from work denies drinking on the job
description: Owen Egloff, a 20-year-old Fruitland Park man, was arrested for suspected DUI while driving home from his job as a cook at Cheshire’s Hilltop Tavern. Police stopped his gray Honda CRV on County Road 466A and Poinsettia Avenue after observing the vehicle traveling without rear lights activated. During the traffic stop, officers reported that Egloff had slurred speech and smelled of alcohol. He denied drinking while at work but agreed to perform field sobriety exercises. Police said he showed signs of impairment, including swaying and losing balance. He later refused to provide a breath sample and was arrested.
Charges: Fruitland Park, Florida

Title: Woman with license suspended for DUI speeds past officer
description: Jaleesa Nicole Bradford, a 33-year-old Tavares woman, was arrested after a traffic stop revealed she was driving with a suspended license. A Fruitland Park police officer stopped Bradford on Pine Ridge Dairy Road after observing her traveling 42 miles per hour in a 25-mile-per-hour zone. During the stop, officers checked her driver’s license and found it had been suspended due to previous DUI-related issues, an unpaid traffic fine, and a habitual traffic violator designation. Police records showed Bradford had prior convictions for driving with a suspended license. She was arrested and booked into the Lake County Jail.
Charges: Driving while license suspended (habitual traffic offender) and driving while license suspended with two prior convictions (most recent for DUI)

Title: Driver with license revoked for DUI arrested at entrance to The Villages
description: Hugo Edward Borja, a 50-year-old Wildwood man, was arrested after police found he was driving with a license revoked for DUI. An officer observed Borja’s white Ford Explorer near The Villages entrance and received a license plate reader alert showing the registered owner had a revoked license. Police stopped Borja near Pine Ridge and found he had a document stating he could drive only for business purposes, but officials said the hardship license had not been finalized. Borja told officers he had not completed the process because he lacked the money required. He was arrested for driving with a revoked license for DUI.
Charges: Driving while license revoked for DUI

Title: ‘May not survive:’ Drunk driver gets angry after striking bystander, Palm Bay police say
description: Daniel Andrew Davis, 61, was arrested after police said he struck a pedestrian while driving under the influence in Palm Bay. Officers reported seeing Davis leave a bar parking lot and later observed his vehicle drifting out of its lane. Police said Davis hit a pedestrian who was standing near another vehicle, causing serious injuries including a broken leg and possible internal injuries. Investigators said Davis appeared more concerned about damage to his own vehicle than the injured person. Officers reported signs of impairment, including an alcohol odor, unsteady movement, and Davis admitting he consumed four or five beers before driving.
Charges: DUI with an underage person in the vehicle; DUI with serious bodily injury

Title: Driver’s irrational responses lead to DUI arrest during crash investigation
description: Jessica Lauren Ruiz, a 40-year-old Fruitland Park woman, was arrested for driving under the influence after a crash investigation in Leesburg. Police responded to a crash at Picciola Road and Citrus Boulevard and noticed signs that Ruiz may have been impaired. Officers reported that she had bloodshot, watery eyes, slurred speech, and an odor of alcohol. During questioning, Ruiz allegedly gave slow, irrational, and incomplete responses. She refused to participate in field sobriety exercises and declined a breath test. Police arrested her after the investigation and transported her to Lake County Jail, where she was later released on bond.
Charges: DUI (accident/property damage or minor injury); refusal to submit to DUI breath or urine test

Title: DUI suspect and companion arrested after traffic stop in The Villages
description: Heather Christina Clark, 52, was arrested after a traffic stop in The Villages for suspected driving under the influence. A Lady Lake police officer stopped her tan Chevrolet pickup truck after noticing a suspicious white light from the rear of the vehicle. During the stop, officers observed signs of alcohol impairment and reported that Clark performed poorly during field sobriety exercises. She provided breath samples showing alcohol levels of .044 and .043. Clark was arrested for DUI and booked into the Lake County Jail before being released on bond.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: Leesburg woman suspected of DUI arrested after leaving Mexican restuarant
description: Kristina Elias, 34, was arrested for suspected DUI after a traffic stop in Leesburg. A police officer observed her black Chevrolet SUV crossing over the double-yellow line and swerving between lanes on Griffin Road. During the stop, officers noticed an odor of alcohol and signs of impairment. Elias admitted drinking two margaritas at Luna Azul before driving home. She performed poorly during field sobriety exercises and later provided breath samples showing alcohol levels of 0.224 and 0.210. She was arrested and booked into Lake County Jail before being released on bond.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: Underage drinker veers off the road after clubbing in Orlando
description: Zachary Paul Young, 20, was arrested for DUI after officers found him slumped over the steering wheel of a running vehicle on the side of a roadway in Okahumpka. Police determined he had veered off the road without striking another vehicle. Officers observed signs of impairment, including slurred speech, bloodshot eyes, alcohol odor, and poor balance. An empty bottle of Malibu rum was found in the vehicle. Young admitted being at a club in Orlando earlier. He failed field sobriety exercises and provided breath samples of 0.106 and 0.109.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: Suspected drunk driver wearing club band stopped at Circle K
description: Demetrius Antonion Bradford, 40, was arrested for suspected DUI after being stopped at a Circle K in Leesburg. A Leesburg police officer observed Bradford speeding in a black Dodge Charger at 62 mph in a 45 mph zone before conducting a traffic stop. During the interaction, officers noticed bloodshot eyes, an alcohol odor, and signs of impairment. Bradford admitted drinking at a club earlier and was wearing a club wristband. He showed poor balance during field sobriety exercises and later refused to provide a breath test.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI) Refusal to submit to DUI testing

Title: Lake City man leads deputies on high-speed chase ending in crash
description: Samuel E. Watson, 48, was involved in a high-speed police pursuit in Lake City, Florida. Deputies reported that they identified a pickup truck leaving a Wendy’s parking lot on State Road 47 that matched a vehicle description from a previous fleeing incident. When deputies attempted a traffic stop, Watson allegedly drove away, entered oncoming traffic, and reached speeds over 100 mph. The pursuit continued onto County Road 240, where he lost control of the vehicle and it overturned. Watson was taken into custody.
Charges: Aggravated fleeing, driving under the influence, driving with a suspended license

Title: Gadsden Co. man who fled arrest attempt and disappeared into woods taken into custody
description: Kedrick Debron fled from deputies in Gadsden County, Florida, after law enforcement attempted to arrest him on outstanding warrants. Deputies arrived at his home near River Road to take him into custody, but Debron ran toward nearby woods. A deputy attempted to use a taser, but the effort was unsuccessful due to Debron’s thick clothing. Authorities searched the area with assistance from multiple agencies, including the U.S. Marshals Task Force, Havana Police Department, and Leon County Sheriff’s Office K-9 Unit. Debron was later located and taken into custody.
Charges: Felony fleeing and eluding, driving while license suspended or revoked, resisting without violence (pending)

According to authorities, an officer activated lights and sirens and ordered him to stop, but Angus allegedly drove around the officer and sped off. He then reportedly traveled northbound in the southbound lanes of Collins Avenue to avoid capture. Later that day, officers located his motorcycle parked near North Bay Road and found Angus walking nearby in a condo parking lot, where he was taken into custody. He was charged with fleeing police at high speed.
Charges: Fleeing police at high speed

Title: BSO deputy accused of fleeing traffic stop, resisting arrest in Miramar
description: A Broward Sheriff’s Office detention deputy was arrested after police said he fled a traffic stop in Miramar. Officers reported observing him driving a Toyota pickup truck at a high rate of speed before initiating the stop near the 12000 block of Saint Andrews Place around 11:45 p.m. Sunday. The suspect allegedly exited his vehicle and ran from officers, climbing stairs toward his apartment and continuing to evade commands. During the pursuit, an officer fell and suffered a head injury. The suspect later barricaded himself inside his apartment before eventually turning himself in at a BSO facility. He declined to be interviewed.
Charges: Two counts of resisting an officer without violence

description: Miramar Police said officers attempted a traffic stop on a truck of interest, but the driver, Jayden Aransevia, refused to comply and fled. The pursuit moved through multiple areas and involved several agencies, including Miami Gardens Police and Florida Highway Patrol. During the chase, the suspect allegedly struck a Miami Gardens Police vehicle. The pursuit ended in Miami Lakes, where the driver abandoned the vehicle and attempted to escape on foot. Witnesses saw him jump into a lake and hide under a dock before trying to flee again. Officers entered a nearby home and used a Taser to apprehend him safely.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding, resisting an officer, battery on a law enforcement officer, plus three active warrants

Title: Alleged DUI suspects linked to shots fired and hit-and-run in Sidney
description: Two men, James C. Parker and James P. Richards, were arrested in Sidney, Ohio, after an investigation linked them to incidents involving shots fired and a hit-and-run. Deputies with the Shelby County Sheriff's Office responded to reports of gunfire at a residence on Fair Road and a crash involving a mailbox on Kuther Road within minutes of each other. Witness information helped identify a suspect vehicle. Both men were later detained after leaving a home under surveillance. Officials said they had been drinking while armed and allegedly fired shots from a moving vehicle, narrowly missing a resident inside a home.
Charges: Parker: Improperly discharging firearm into habitation, having weapons under disability, driving under suspension; Richards: Improper handling of firearms in a motor vehicle

Title: Naples road rage crash with $5K in damage ends in driver's arrest on multiple charges
description: Naples police arrested Fort Myers man David Shelton after a road rage incident that began as a minor bumper contact between two vehicles. Investigators said Shelton followed the other driver to record a license plate and then drove aggressively behind the victim. Police reported he drove recklessly, including traveling the wrong way on a roadway and intentionally backing his Toyota Tundra into the victim’s sedan while the driver tried to escape. The victim said he did not initially notice the crash but later feared for his life due to Shelton’s behavior. The crash caused about $5,000 in damage and led to an arrest.
Charges: Criminal mischief with property damage over $1,000; reckless driving with property damage; driving while license suspended (second offense)

Title: Davie police: 19-year-old duo stole from 16 cars, fled in stolen car, crashed
description: Two 19-year-old men, Armaun Livingston and Jamarcus Rollins, were arrested in Davie, Florida, after police linked them to a string of car break-ins involving about 16 vehicles. Officers located the suspects in a stolen Hyundai Elantra and attempted a traffic stop. The pair fled, crashed into parked cars, and ran on foot before being captured by officers and a K-9 unit. Investigators say Livingston has an extensive auto theft history while Rollins has prior burglary cases. Both face dozens of charges including grand theft auto, burglary of vehicles, fleeing and eluding, and resisting arrest, among others in this specific case
Charges: Grand theft auto, unarmed burglary of unoccupied conveyance (16 counts), grand theft (6 counts), petit theft (4 counts), criminal mischief, resisting arrest, aggravated fleeing with damage, leaving the scene of a crash, failure to stop and remain, speeding 50+ mph over limit

Title: Hit-and-run suspect who injured deputy in Fort Lauderdale arrested, BSO says
description: A Broward Sheriff’s Office deputy was injured after being struck during a hit-and-run crash in Fort Lauderdale. According to authorities, the incident occurred near West Broward Boulevard and Northwest 11th Avenue when a collision happened involving the deputy and another driver. After the crash, the driver fled the scene without stopping to render aid or report the incident. The deputy was transported to a nearby hospital and later released with non-life-threatening injuries. Law enforcement located the suspect, identified as Sean Alexis, in Plantation later that same night. He was taken into custody and booked into the Broward County Main Jail.
Charges: Failure to stop/remain at crash involving serious injuries, leaving the scene of a crash involving property damage, driving with a suspended license

Title: "Because I'm driving drunk": Man accused of DUI, driving on sidewalk, hitting sign in Cape Coral
city and state: Cape Coral and Fort Myers, Florida, USA
description: A man identified as Tyler Kenneth Procopio was arrested after a DUI-related incident that began in Cape Coral and ended in Fort Myers. Police say he drove a Toyota RAV4 onto a sidewalk near Dixie Roadhouse, nearly striking two officers, and continued driving despite attempts to stop him. He struck a sign and traveled through city streets, crossing the Cape Coral Bridge into Fort Myers. Officers initiated a traffic stop after observing reckless behavior. When questioned, he admitted he was driving drunk. Authorities reported signs of intoxication including slurred speech and alcohol odor. He was taken into custody by deputies.
Charges: DUI, hit-and-run with damage to property

Title: Fort Myers driver blows double the legal limit after swerving on San Carlos Blvd, deputies say
description: A motorist identified as Herry Juniar Arfian was arrested in Fort Myers after Lee County deputies observed his blue Volvo S60 driving erratically near San Carlos Boulevard and Pine Ridge Road. The vehicle was seen stopping abruptly and swerving into the opposite lane while accelerating and braking unpredictably. A traffic stop was initiated and deputies noted signs of impairment including bloodshot eyes slurred speech and a strong odor of alcohol. Field sobriety exercises indicated severe impairment. A breath test at the jail recorded BAC levels of 0.166 and 0.174. He was booked for driving under the influence with elevated BAC
Charges: Driving under the influence

Title: Deputy who stopped woman hours before deadly wrong-way crash on I-75 identified
description: A Collier County deputy stopped a woman identified as Genise Taylor for speeding along U.S. Route 41 in the early morning hours of March 18, 2026. After the traffic stop, she was released and later met friends. Investigators say she later drove onto Interstate 75 near Golden Gate Parkway and entered the highway in the wrong direction. At about 4:18 a.m., she collided head-on with two vehicles in a deadly crash that killed a 96-year-old driver. Toxicology reports showed a blood alcohol level of 0.213, nearly three times the legal limit. Authorities are investigating the circumstances of the initial stop.
Charges: DUI, wrong-way driving causing fatal crash (investigation/charges related to homicide pending)

Title: Video shows Corvette hitting police cruiser while fleeing traffic stop in Miami Beach
description: Surveillance video shows a 26-year-old man, Anthony Banks, in a white Corvette being stopped by Miami Beach Police for loud music. During the traffic stop, the driver tells the officer he will reverse, but instead flees and strikes a police cruiser while escaping. The incident occurred in the 100th block of 9th Street near Collins Avenue. The suspect was later arrested while taking the same vehicle to a car wash. His license was suspended. He faces charges including reckless driving, leaving the scene of an accident, and driving without a valid license. No injuries were reported in the collision incident.
Charges: Reckless driving, leaving the scene of an accident, driving without a valid license

Title: Central Florida man arrested after impersonating lawyer at traffic stop, deputies say
description: Derek Schaufus, a 30-year-old Palm Bay man, was arrested after allegedly impersonating a lawyer during a traffic stop on Interstate 95 in Brevard County. Deputies said the stop occurred around 3 a.m. in April when a controlled substance was found in the vehicle. After the driver was read Miranda rights, Schaufus arrived on scene dressed in a suit, claimed to be the driver’s attorney, and attempted to intervene in the investigation. He allegedly stated he was bar-certified but provided no proof. Officers confirmed he was not a licensed attorney and arrested him for obstruction and practicing law without a license.
Charges: Obstruction by a disguised person Practicing law without a license

Title: Teen accused of wrong-way DUI hit-and-run crash on Cape Coral Bridge with child in car
description: 19-year-old driver, Ashley Hernandez-Gonzalez, was arrested in Lee County, Florida, after deputies said she drove under the influence and traveled the wrong way across the Cape Coral Bridge following a hit-and-run crash. Authorities say she first collided with another vehicle near Fort Myers then continued driving against traffic striking a concrete barrier and guardrail while crossing the bridge. The vehicle eventually stopped near Cape Coral Parkway East and Southeast 17th Place. Two passengers including a child were inside. Breath tests showed a blood alcohol level nearly three times legal limit. No injuries were reported and she was taken into custody
Charges: DUI, hit-and-run, wrong-way driving, reckless driving, child endangerment (possible), leaving the scene of a crash

Title: Driver arrested after deputies clock 137 mph in Crestview; passenger held on drug charge
description: A high-speed traffic stop in Crestview, Florida led to arrests after deputies clocked a vehicle traveling 137 mph in a 65 mph zone on State Road 85. The driver, identified as 20-year-old Jim Mitchell of Pensacola, was stopped and charged with excessive speeding exceeding 100 mph over the limit. His passenger, 25-year-old Akeem Malik Finlay, was also arrested after deputies discovered a controlled substance without a prescription. Authorities further noted that Finlay was placed on an ICE hold during the investigation. The stop was conducted by the Okaloosa County Sheriff’s Office following dangerous driving behavior observed on the highway.
Charges: Jim Mitchell: Excessive speed (100+ mph over limit); Akeem Malik Finlay: Possession of controlled substance without prescription, ICE hold

Title: Escambia County traffic stop uncovers spice stash and stolen gun, deputies say
description: A man in Escambia County, Florida, was arrested after deputies conducted a traffic stop that led to the discovery of illegal drugs and a stolen firearm. According to the Escambia County Sheriff’s Office, deputies attempted to stop a vehicle on Hansen Boulevard after it was seen leaving a known area of concern. The driver allegedly tried to evade deputies by pulling into a residential yard before being taken into custody. A search of the situation resulted in the recovery of “spice” (synthetic cannabinoids) and a firearm reported stolen. The suspect was arrested and charged with drug distribution and weapons-related offenses.
Charges: Possession of spice with intent to distribute and possession of a stolen firearm

Title: Police stop driver in Altamonte Springs for using remote-controlled license plate cover
description: A driver in Altamonte Springs, Florida, was stopped by police after officers noticed a vehicle with an obscured license plate. During the traffic stop on Ronald Reagan Boulevard, conducted on January 8, 2026, officers discovered a remote-controlled device installed inside the car that allowed the driver to conceal the license plate at the push of a button. The device violates Florida law that bans any alteration or obstruction of license plates under Florida Statute 320.262, effective October 2025. The driver was issued a criminal citation and the device was seized as evidence. The case is scheduled for court proceedings hearings.
Charges: Criminal citation for use of a device to obscure a license plate under Florida Statute 320.262

Title: MDSO: Suspect rams multiple police vehicles, crashes after high-speed chase
description: Alexander Navarette, a 22-year-old Miami Lakes resident, was involved in a high-speed police pursuit in northern Miami-Dade County after officers attempted to stop a silver Infiniti G37 connected to a possible burglary. During the chase, he allegedly rammed a Hialeah Police Department vehicle, causing the officer to lose control, and later struck a Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office unit, forcing it into a guardrail. He continued fleeing at speeds exceeding 125 mph before crashing near North Miami Beach. Deputies then removed him from the vehicle after he resisted commands. Three passengers were also detained, and loaded firearms were recovered from the car.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding; aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer using a deadly weapon causing bodily harm; display or use of a firearm while committing a felony; resisting arrest with violence; reckless driving; excessive speeding causing threat to person or property

Title: Boca Raton Man Charged Under ‘Super Speeder’ Law After Yamato Road Traffic Stop
description: A 21-year-old driver was stopped by Boca Raton Police on Yamato Road after allegedly speeding and weaving through heavy traffic. Officers reported the Infiniti G37 was clocked at about 98 mph in an area with active traffic movement. The driver, identified as Pedro Henrique Dama Oliveira, reportedly told police he believed he was driving around 85 mph and claimed his speedometer was malfunctioning. He also said he was late for work. Authorities charged him under Florida’s “Super Speeder” law, which makes extreme speeding a criminal offense. He was later released from the Palm Beach County Jail after posting a $500 bond.
Charges: Super Speeder law (criminal speeding)

Title: 1 arrested, officer pulled through Dayton streets during traffic stop before crash
description: A Dayton Police officer attempted a traffic stop on a vehicle near East Third and North Keowee Streets around 11 p.m. for illegal window tint. After the vehicle stopped, officers discovered expired tags and learned the driver had an extensive criminal history involving firearms. During contact, the driver allegedly re-entered the vehicle and drove off while the officer was partially engaged with him, dragging the officer through multiple streets. The vehicle eventually crashed near East Third and Beckel Streets. The driver was arrested and taken to a hospital. Marijuana, suspected narcotics, and a loaded firearm were recovered from the vehicle.
Charges: weapons violations, and fleeing/obstructing law enforcement

Title: Brevard authorities recapture man who slipped handcuffs and fled during hospital stop
description: Eric Jordon Jerry, a 24-year-old man in Brevard County, Florida, was initially taken into custody on an outstanding warrant by Melbourne Police Department officers. While being transported to the Brevard County Jail, he requested medical attention and was taken to a hospital. During the hospital stop, he allegedly assaulted officers and managed to remove his handcuffs before fleeing on foot. Officers pursued him into a wooded area near the hospital but lost sight of him during the initial search. A large-scale search involving K-9 units, drones, and aviation support was launched. He was later recaptured at a residence in Palm Bay.
Charges: Escape; battery on a law enforcement officer; resisting with violence; resisting without violence

Title: Bodycam shows Hialeah Police lieutenant's DUI arrest after crash with trash truck
description: A Hialeah Police lieutenant, Erik Martin, was arrested after being involved in a crash with a Waste Management trash truck in Miami-Dade County. Body camera footage from responding deputies showed Martin displaying signs of impairment, including bloodshot eyes, slurred speech, and the smell of alcohol. He was reportedly unsteady and became belligerent with officers. Martin refused field sobriety exercises and declined to provide a blood sample. He was taken to a hospital but resisted entering for treatment. After evaluation at the scene, he was booked into jail on DUI-related charges. The incident occurred while he was off duty.
Charges: DUI; DUI with damage to property or person; refusal to perform field sobriety exercises; refusal to submit to blood testing

Title: Man charged with DUI after crashing into cruiser during investigation in NW Miami-Dade, report says
description: On April 2026, Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office deputies arrested 53-year-old Yovany Izquierdo after he crashed into a marked deputy’s cruiser during an active traffic crash investigation in Northwest Miami-Dade, Florida. Deputies were blocking traffic at the scene of a fatal crash when Izquierdo drove a red pickup truck westbound and failed to stop, colliding with the patrol vehicle. Officers reported signs of impairment, including bloodshot watery eyes, slurred speech, and the odor of alcohol. Field sobriety tests indicated impairment. He was taken into custody at the scene. No additional injuries were reported from the collision with the deputy’s vehicle.
Charges: Driving Under the Influence (DUI), DUI/Damage to Property or a Person

Title: Tampa Police Officer arrested after excessive speeding, reckless driving: TPD
description: Jason Brown, an off-duty Tampa Police Department officer, was arrested after driving at excessive speeds and recklessly weaving through traffic on Interstate 75 near Big Bend Road. Authorities said he was traveling over 100 mph in his personal vehicle when Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office deputies conducted the stop and took him into custody. The incident occurred early Sunday morning and was later confirmed by Tampa Police Department officials, who stated Brown was already under an internal investigation at the time. The department said the new arrest would be added to the ongoing review of his conduct and professional standards.
Charges: Excessive speeding; reckless driving

Title: St. Pete man arrested after 100 mph DUI crash injures 4, including 2 children: CPD
description: Mario Rizk, a 28-year-old man from St. Petersburg, was arrested after a high-speed DUI crash on U.S. 19 in Clearwater. Police said he was driving about 100 mph when he struck the rear of another vehicle, then collided with a second disabled vehicle on the roadside. The crash injured four people, including two children, though injuries were not life-threatening. Investigators determined alcohol impairment contributed to the crash. Rizk was arrested at the scene and taken into custody following the collision. Authorities emphasized reckless driving and impaired operation as key factors in the incident, which caused a major roadway shutdown during investigation.
Charges: DUI causing serious bodily injury; reckless driving causing serious bodily injury

Deputies from the Pinellas County Sheriff’s Office responded after the victim was found lying on the curb with life-threatening injuries. The suspect vehicle, a 2019 Cadillac Escalade, was later located in a hotel parking lot in Tierra Verde. The driver, identified as Margaret Barah Gardner, showed signs of impairment and failed field sobriety tests. She was taken into custody after investigation at the scene. The victim was transported to the hospital in critical condition following the crash.
Charges: Driving Under the Influence (DUI), refusal to submit to testing, leaving the scene of a crash with serious bodily injury

Title: Affidavits: New Jersey man arrested with 'super speeder,' DUI charges in Pinellas County
description: A 43-year-old New Jersey man was arrested in Pinellas Park after police observed him driving approximately 113 mph in a 55 mph zone on U.S. 19. Authorities also noted signs of impairment during the stop. Records showed the suspect’s driver’s license had been suspended for prior traffic charges and had expired in 2012. The arrest occurred in the afternoon after 2:30 p.m., and he was booked into the Pinellas County Jail on multiple traffic and DUI-related charges.
Charges: Dangerous excessive speeding, DUI, refusal to submit to testing, driving with suspended/revoked license, driving with expired license over six months

Title: Clearwater man arrested after alleged racing, excessive speeding and DUI: Affidavits
description: Clearwater police arrested 48-year-old Marcus Denson after officers observed him racing another vehicle at 115 mph in a 55 mph zone on U.S. 19 near Whitney Road in Clearwater, Florida during the early hours of May 4, 2026. He was charged with racing on a highway, dangerous excessive speeding, and driving under the influence. The second vehicle involved was not stopped. Denson had no prior DUI convictions and was booked into jail following arrest.
Charges: Racing on a highway; dangerous excessive speeding; driving under the influence (DUI)

description: On March 6, 2026, in Clearwater, Florida, police say 30-year-old Jim Gavin Landis caused a serious crash while driving northbound on Belcher Road at a high rate of speed. Officers reported signs of impairment including strong alcohol odor, slurred speech, bloodshot eyes, and inability to stand. He refused sobriety and chemical tests. Arrested and charged with leaving the scene of a crash involving injury, DUI, and refusal after prior refusal.
Charges: Leaving the scene of a crash involving injury, driving under the influence, refusal to submit to testing after prior refusal, driving without a license

Title: Florida mom accused of driving drunk at 120 mph with child in back seat
description: A woman in Jacksonville, Florida, was arrested after authorities said she drove 120 mph on Interstate 10 with her 3-year-old child in the back seat. The driver admitted drinking a couple of glasses of wine and acknowledged marijuana was inside the vehicle. Investigators found multiple alcohol bottles and what appeared to be a freshly lit marijuana joint. The woman was arrested for DUI and violating Florida's Super Speeder law. Authorities also learned she had left her 10-year-old child home alone.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI), violating Florida's Super Speeder law

Title: Man busted in Surfside after brief chase following gun-toting road rage incident, cops say
description: On January 11, 2026, Curtis Odell Wade Jr., 64, was arrested after a road rage incident that began in Haulover, continued through Bal Harbour, and ended in Surfside, Florida. They stopped his vehicle and asked why he was driving on the wrong side of the road. Saphia stated he was taking a friend home after leaving a sports bar and stopping at McDonald's. Deputies reported smelling a strong odor of alcohol and noticing slurred speech. He allegedly failed field sobriety tests and was arrested for driving under the influence. Authorities also stated that he refused to submit to a breathalyzer test after his arrest.
Charges: DUI Refusal to submit to DUI testing

Title: Driver arrested for DUI after Collier County deputy's vehicle was hit during traffic stop
description: A routine traffic stop conducted by deputies in Collier County, Florida, turned dangerous shortly before midnight on Wednesday when a vehicle driven by Jan Renan struck the rear of a deputy's patrol vehicle. The deputies and the driver involved in the original traffic stop quickly moved out of the way to avoid injury. The Florida Highway Patrol responded to the crash and determined that Renan was driving under the influence. He was arrested at the scene. Authorities reported that there were two occupants in Renan's vehicle. No injuries were reported, and everyone involved was able to leave the incident safely.
Charges: Driving Under the Influence (DUI)

Title: iHeartMemphis Arrested for Burglary After Fleeing From Cops in Florida
description: Richard Maurice Colbert, known as rapper iHeartMemphis, was arrested in Plantation, Florida, after allegedly fleeing from police during a burglary-related incident. Officers say he placed traffic cones, tree branches, and cinder blocks in a roadway and refused to remove them, leading to confrontation. When police attempted to detain him, he fled on foot, jumping fences and running through backyards while allegedly trying to enter homes. He was later found and detained at a nearby residence. Authorities reported he suffered a leg laceration and was evaluated at a hospital. He faces burglary, resisting arrest, obstruction, and additional threat charges pending court.
Charges: 3 felony counts of burglary Obstructing a public roadway Resisting officers without violence Written/electronic threats to kill (additional charge)

Title: Teen arrested after trying to flee deputies on e-bike, officials say
description: A 14-year-old boy in Orange County, Florida, was arrested after allegedly riding an electric bicycle recklessly through a residential neighborhood and fleeing from deputies during a traffic stop. Authorities responded to reports of dangerous riding in the area of Black Quill Drive and Porter Road. When a deputy attempted to stop him, the teen reportedly fled on the e-bike. Law enforcement later apprehended him and transported him to the Juvenile Assessment Center. The Orange County Sheriff’s Office charged him with fleeing and attempting to elude a law enforcement officer, and he also received a citation for reckless driving.
Charges: Fleeing and attempting to elude a law enforcement officer Reckless driving (citation)

Title: WATCH: 2 Tampa teens arrested after crashing stolen car, fleeing, deputies say
description: Two Tampa teenagers were arrested after stealing a car and fleeing from Hillsborough County deputies in Florida. According to the sheriff’s office, the stolen vehicle was first spotted near Camden Field Parkway and South 78th Street before the teens drove off at high speed through residential areas. The Hillsborough aviation unit tracked the vehicle from above as it continued to evade law enforcement. The chase ended when the car crashed into a fence, after which both suspects ran on foot. Deputies quickly located and arrested both juveniles, one hiding at a nearby residence and the other found in a front yard.
Charges: Grand theft motor vehicle Fleeing and eluding Reckless driving with property damage No valid driver’s license Criminal mischief Trespassing Resisting an officer without violence Violation of probation  Passenger (16-year-old):  Trespassing in an occupied structure Trespassing on property other than structure Resisting an officer without violence

Title: ‘Grandma’ Arrested On Fleeing And Eluding Charges
description: Joyce Wagner, an 84-year-old woman from Lima, Ohio, was arrested and booked into the Auglaize County Jail on charges related to a traffic incident. Authorities say she was charged with exchange of accident information and fleeing and eluding law enforcement after allegedly failing to stop for a police signal. Under Ohio law, fleeing and eluding involves willfully avoiding a police officer’s attempt to conduct a stop, and penalties can vary depending on the severity of the circumstances. Wagner was held on a $25,000 bond following her arrest. The case highlights that fleeing and eluding charges can apply even in low-speed or minor incidents.
Charges: Exchange of accident information; fleeing and eluding

Title: Licking County prisoner captured after fleeing law enforcement
description: Calvin Jenkins, a 21-year-old prisoner, fled from Licking County deputies while being transported for a probation revocation hearing in Newark, Ohio. Authorities said he ran from officers near West Main Street, prompting a brief search and a public alert. Newark police later located and captured him around noon the same day. His escape caused precautionary lockdown measures at nearby schools, which were later lifted once he was in custody. Court records show Jenkins had been appearing for a probation violation hearing, after which his suspended jail sentence was reinstated. He now faces additional potential felony escape-related charges following the incident.
Charges: Probation violation; potential felony escape charges (pending):Fleeing

Title: Braceville woman sentenced after DUI arrest involving child passenger
description: Betheny Conde, a 46-year-old woman from Braceville, Ohio, was arrested after allegedly driving under the influence with a 9-year-old child in her vehicle. The child reportedly called 911 to report that Conde was impaired while driving. Police tracked the vehicle and initiated a stop after it traveled through multiple intersections before coming to a halt in Warren. Officers reported that Conde failed sobriety tests and refused to take a breathalyzer test. She later pleaded guilty to endangering children and operating a vehicle under the influence. The court sentenced her to jail time, probation, and ordered no contact with the child involved.
Charges: Child endangerment; Driving under the influence (DUI/OVI)

Title: Video shows arrest of FedEx truck burglar stymied by traffic on MacArthur, cops say
description: Shajuan Jones, 26, of Memphis, Tennessee, was arrested after allegedly stealing several packages from a FedEx truck on South Beach in Miami Beach, Florida. Police said he attempted to flee in a vehicle but became stuck in traffic on the MacArthur Causeway, where officers arrested him at gunpoint. During the pursuit, authorities said Jones threw a firearm from the vehicle. Officers recovered the weapon and also found drugs, including OxyContin and approximately 150 grams of marijuana, inside the vehicle. The stolen vehicle, firearm, and narcotics were seized as evidence. Jones was booked into jail and remained in custody.
Charges: Burglary of an unoccupied conveyance while armed; Fleeing or eluding police; Tampering with physical evidence

Title: Two Cubans arrested for luxury car theft in Miami Beach
description: Roberto Macaya González, 36, and Maykel Álvarez, 46, were arrested after authorities accused them of stealing luxury vehicles from a condominium in Miami Beach, Florida. Investigators said surveillance footage showed the suspects entering the property before a white Ferrari and a black Rolls-Royce Phantom were stolen. The following day, an officer located the Ferrari and attempted to stop the driver, who fled before abandoning the vehicle. Authorities also linked the suspects to an attempted motorcycle theft and the theft of a Genesis GV70 SUV. Both men were arrested and charged with multiple offenses related to vehicle theft and other crimes.
Charges: Roberto Macaya González:  Grand theft Burglary of an occupied structure Grand theft of a vehicle Attempted grand theft of a vehicle Criminal damage Trafficking in stolen property Fleeing and eluding a police officer  Maykel Álvarez:  Grand theft Burglary of an occupied structure Grand theft of a vehicle Attempted grand theft of a vehicle Criminal damage Trafficking in stolen property Knowingly driving with a suspended license

Title: South Florida K-9 shot in shoulder while attempting to apprehend fleeing suspect
description: Christian Q. Bouie, 30, was arrested after allegedly shooting a police K-9 during a burglary investigation in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Officers responded to a reported burglary and established a perimeter around the area. When Bouie attempted to flee, a Broward Sheriff's Office K-9 named Appie, a 4-year-old Belgian Malinois, was deployed to apprehend him. Authorities said Bouie shot the dog in the shoulder before another K-9 helped officers take him into custody. Investigators recovered a firearm at the scene. Appie was transported for veterinary treatment, remained in stable condition, and was scheduled to undergo surgery following the incident.
Charges: Use of a deadly weapon on a police animal Interfering with law enforcement officers with violence Possession of a weapon by a convicted felon Resisting officers without violence Fleeing

Title: 16-year-old girl hits HCSO patrol vehicle while fleeing with stolen car: Deputies
description: On April 12, 2026 in Town 'n' Country Florida a 16-year-old girl was arrested after allegedly stealing a vehicle and fleeing from Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office deputies. According to officials deputies attempted a traffic stop after the vehicle was reported stolen near Sheldon Road and West Hillsborough Avenue. The suspect continued to evade law enforcement and struck a marked patrol vehicle while attempting to escape. She was taken into custody after the crash. Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office reported that she was charged with grand theft motor vehicle fleeing to elude resisting an officer without violence and possession of drug paraphernalia
Charges: Grand theft motor vehicle, fleeing to elude, resisting an officer without violence

Title: WATCH: Florida man steals charity donation box, flees from officers, police say
description: On May 6, 2026, in Daytona Beach, Florida, a 21-year-old man, Denzel Fogle, was arrested after stealing a donation box from a restaurant on the Daytona Beach Boardwalk Surveillance footage showed him taking the box and exiting the business When confronted by an officer outside he fled on foot Officers pursued him into a nearby parking lot where he was quickly caught and handcuffed During the arrest the suspect made statements admitting the theft He was charged by the Daytona Beach Police Department with petit theft and resisting an officer without violence following the brief foot pursuit and investigation case
Charges: Petit theft, resisting an officer without violence Fleeing or eluding police

Title: St. Petersburg Man Arrested After Stolen Vehicle Crash, Attempted Escape and Multiple Charges
description: Deputies with the Pinellas County Sheriff’s Office tracked a stolen Volkswagen Atlas in Pinellas County after it was reported out of Pinellas Park. The vehicle was seen driving recklessly at high speeds while attempting to evade law enforcement, including aviation units assisting in surveillance. Multiple stop stick attempts were made but failed to stop the suspect. The pursuit ended when the driver crashed near 46th Avenue North and 66th Street North in St. Petersburg, causing damage to multiple vehicles and injuring another driver. The suspect fled on foot, stole a bicycle during escape, and was later captured by deputies.
Charges: Leaving the scene of a crash involving injury, burglary, driving while license suspended as habitual offender, leaving the scene of a crash involving property damage, reckless driving, resisting an officer without violence
