Title: OCSO: Florida man weaves through traffic in RV while fleeing law enforcement
description: Louis Anthony Robles, 45, was arrested after allegedly fleeing from Osceola County deputies while driving a recreational vehicle. Authorities said he refused to stop, drove recklessly, and weaved through traffic while attempting to evade law enforcement. During the pursuit, Robles struck two other vehicles before deputies brought the chase to an end. Investigators charged him with multiple offenses, including DUI, reckless driving, leaving the scene of an accident with injuries, resisting an officer, and drug-related offenses. He was taken into custody without further incident. The pursuit created a dangerous situation for other motorists, but deputies successfully apprehended him.
Charges: Driving while license revoked (habitual traffic offender); Fleeing to elude with lights and sirens; Reckless driving; DUI (damage to property); Leaving the scene of an accident with injuries; Resisting a law enforcement officer without violence; Possession of drug paraphernalia; Possession of a controlled substance

Title: Lady Lake Police Arrest Driver Under Florida’s New ‘Super Speeder’ Law after 95-mph Stop
description: A 20-year-old man, David Estevan Quiroga-Salazar, was arrested after Lady Lake police observed him driving a black Ford Mustang at 95 mph in a posted 40 mph zone on County Road 466. Officers said the roadway was wet from earlier rain, and the excessive speed created a danger to the driver, his four passengers, and other motorists. After the traffic stop, he reportedly admitted he was speeding, stating that peer pressure from his passengers influenced him to test the vehicle's performance. He was taken into custody and charged under Florida's new Super Speeder law and for reckless driving.
Charges: Reckless driving Criminal citation for dangerous speed under Florida's "Super Speeder" law

Title: 3 men arrested after 150+ mph high-speed chase as 1 accused of DUI in Collier County
description: Deputies in Collier County, Florida, attempted to stop a vehicle after detecting it traveling 153 mph in a 45 mph zone on SR-82. The driver fled before stopping in the middle of a residential street, where three occupants ran into a nearby garage. Deputies located and arrested all three men. The driver allegedly showed signs of alcohol impairment and refused DUI testing. A search of the vehicle uncovered an Uzi-style pistol reportedly belonging to one passenger. Residents described the pursuit as chaotic and dangerous. No injuries or fatalities were reported, and authorities emphasized the importance of responsible driving following the incident.
Charges: Christopher Camargo Guido:  Fleeing and eluding Resisting an officer without violence Reckless driving Speeding over 50 mph above the posted limit DUI Refusal to submit to DUI testing  Roberto Estrada Ramirez:  Resisting an officer without violence  Alvaro Ramos Martinez:  Resisting an officer without violence

Title: Dashcam: Minn. officer arrests cop accused of driving with BAC over 3x the legal limit
description: A Bloomington Police Department dash camera captured the arrest of a 61-year-old part-time Chatfield Police Department officer accused of driving under the influence. Officers responded after the man reportedly crashed his vehicle while speeding. Video shows him exiting the vehicle unsteadily while still wearing his police uniform, badge, and firearm. A Bloomington officer assisted him as he struggled to walk toward the patrol car. Authorities stated his blood alcohol content measured 0.28, more than three times the legal limit. The incident occurred after he had reportedly worked a shift earlier that day. No injuries to the public were reported.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: ScootCoupe driver arrested after accident
description: Randi Bestel, a 35-year-old Minnesota resident, was arrested after crashing a three-wheeled ScootCoupe near the intersection of Gulf Drive and Palmetto Avenue in Anna Maria, Florida. Deputies responded to the crash and observed signs of impairment, including glassy eyes, droopy eyelids, and the odor of alcohol. Bestel admitted she had consumed a margarita earlier in the day. After field sobriety tests, she was arrested and transported to the Holmes Beach Police Department, where she provided a breath sample of 0.179, more than twice the legal limit. She was later booked into the Manatee County Jail.
Charges: DUI Damage to Property or Person, Careless Driving

Title: Man likely to be charged in North Dakota and Minnesota after fleeing troopers, Moorhead Police
description: Mohammed Ali Ahmed, an 18-year-old man, was arrested after fleeing from law enforcement during a traffic stop involving the North Dakota Highway Patrol and Moorhead Police. Officers attempted to stop a vehicle for speeding and for having no license plate. The driver failed to stop, leading police on a pursuit that ended when the vehicle crashed into a fence at the Southside Soccer Complex in Moorhead. After the crash, Ahmed exited the vehicle and was taken into custody. Authorities confirmed the vehicle had also been involved in an earlier attempted stop by North Dakota troopers. The case is being processed for felony fleeing and reckless driving charges in both North Dakota and Minnesota.
Charges: Felony Fleeing, Reckless Driving

Title: Frazee man arrested following crash
description: On May 3, 2026, in Hobart Township, Otter Tail County, Minnesota, a crash involving a vehicle that rolled near East Wymer Lake Road injured a passenger. Deputies responded after a report of a crash near a slough east side of the road southwest of Frazee. The vehicle was initially found unoccupied, and investigators later identified the driver as Spencer David Dylan Jacobs, age 28 of Frazee. A male passenger suffered serious but non-life-threatening injuries and was treated at a hospital. Jacobs was arrested and charged with criminal vehicular operation, driving after revocation, and reckless driving. Alcohol is suspected contributing factor.
Charges: Criminal vehicular operation; driving after revocation; reckless driving

Title: Man arrested after short pursuit Tuesday night in Meeker County
description: On May 20, 2026, in Darwin, Meeker County, Minnesota, a deputy with the Meeker County Sheriff's Office attempted to contact the driver of a parked vehicle near St. John’s Catholic Cemetery after a suspicious vehicle report. The driver fled, prompting a short pursuit. The chase ended when the suspect stopped the vehicle and continued fleeing on foot. Deputies caught and arrested the suspect, a 35-year-old man from Darwin, without further incident. The vehicle had been reported stolen from Wright County. Man was booked into Meeker County Jail on charges including fleeing a peace officer, receiving stolen property, and reckless driving.
Charges: Fleeing a peace officer; receiving stolen property; reckless driving

Title: Minneapolis Man Arrested After 90 MPH Pursuit Ends in Rollover Crash
description: On April 2, 2026, in Minneapolis, Minnesota, Robbinsdale police attempted a traffic stop on a 20-year-old driver who was operating a stolen 2016 Infiniti Q50 at high speed. The vehicle was reportedly seen traveling about 90 mph in a 20 mph zone on Victory Memorial Parkway. The driver failed to stop, leading officers on a pursuit through north Minneapolis, across the Mississippi River, and into northeast Minneapolis. The chase ended when the suspect lost control and rolled the vehicle near the 4300 block of Marshall Street Northeast by the Minneapolis Water Treatment Plant. The driver exited the vehicle and was compliant with officers. He was arrested and taken to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
Charges: Fleeing police; possession of stolen property; reckless driving; driving without a valid license; speeding

Title: Fergus Falls man arrested after stolen vehicle chase in Otter Tail County
Link of article: Fergus Falls man arrested after stolen vehicle chase in Otter Tail County
description: Deputies in Otter Tail County responded to a report of a stolen vehicle near New York Mills and later located the suspect vehicle. The driver, identified as Rene Torres, allegedly attempted to flee when officers tried to stop him, initiating a pursuit. Law enforcement used tire deflation devices and a PIT maneuver to bring the chase to an end. The pursuit ended without further incident, and Torres was taken into custody. Authorities say the case involved motor vehicle theft and additional offenses tied to fleeing law enforcement. He was booked into the Otter Tail County Detention Facility following his arrest.
Charges: Motor vehicle theft, fleeing in a motor vehicle, third-degree burglary

Title: Driver With Revoked License Accused of Fleeing Police Through Rochester Neighborhood
description: Police in Rochester, Minnesota pursued a vehicle driven by a 56-year-old man with a revoked license after an officer noticed an inoperable headlight during a traffic stop attempt in northeast Rochester. The driver allegedly accelerated, fleeing through residential streets at speeds up to 85 mph in a 30 mph zone. The pursuit was terminated due to safety concerns. Officers later located the vehicle parked near the Olmsted County Government Center, where the suspect was arrested. He was taken for medical clearance before jail booking and faces charges related to fleeing and driving after revocation of his license. No injuries reported
Charges: Felony fleeing police; misdemeanor driving after revocation of license

Title: Man Charged After Bloomington SUV Theft, Fraud, Police Chase
description: A 26-year-old man from Minneapolis was charged after allegedly stealing an SUV from an apartment parking garage in Bloomington and using a stolen financial card at multiple stores across the Twin Cities. Authorities say he later led police on a high-speed pursuit after the theft and fraud incidents. The case began when the vehicle owner reported the SUV missing from a residential garage. Investigators linked the suspect to both the vehicle theft and unauthorized transactions at retail locations. The following day, police attempted to apprehend him during a chase involving the stolen SUV. He now faces multiple felony charges related to theft and fraud.
Charges: Theft of a motor vehicle; receiving stolen property; financial transaction card fraud (all felony charges)

Title: Rochester man arrested after causing significant damage to squad car
description: A Rochester-area man was arrested after a police pursuit involving a stolen pickup truck in Olmsted County, Minnesota. Deputies identified the driver during patrol and attempted to stop the vehicle, but the suspect fled toward neighboring counties. During the chase, the suspect drove into a cul-de-sac and then allegedly rammed a squad car, causing significant damage and deploying airbags. A deputy sustained minor injuries. Authorities later took the suspect into custody and discovered methamphetamine on him. The suspect had an outstanding felony warrant and now faces multiple charges related to fleeing police, vehicle theft, assault on a squad car, and drug possession.
Charges: Fleeing a police officer; vehicle theft; warrant-related felony charges

Title: Cleveland police identify suspect arrested after gunfire, chase and crashes injure 5 officers
description: Police in Cleveland, Ohio identified 24-year-old Brian Branch as the suspect in a violent incident that began with a shooting investigation at a local store and escalated into gunfire directed at officers. During the response, officers located the suspect vehicle and attempted to conduct a stop, but Branch allegedly fled and fired multiple rounds at police. The pursuit continued across the city, with additional shots reportedly fired at officers during the chase, injuring several through gunfire, shrapnel, and crashes. The chase ended when the suspect crashed in Shaker Heights and was arrested after attempting to flee on foot.
Charges: Multiple counts of felonious assault (additional charges pending)

Title: Police: Two men arrested in Franklin after leading officers on chase across I-75 in stolen vehicle
description: Police in Franklin, Ohio arrested two men after a stolen vehicle chase on Interstate 75. Officers attempted a traffic stop on a black Dodge Charger known to be stolen, but the driver fled, initiating a pursuit on the highway. Police later used a PIT maneuver to stop the vehicle, bringing the chase to an end. Both occupants were taken into custody without further incident. Investigators also discovered that both individuals had active warrants in unrelated serious cases, including homicide and aggravated robbery charges from another county. The incident remains under investigation, and both suspects are scheduled for arraignment in court.
Charges: Armone Kinney: receiving stolen property, failure to comply with police Shaquan Barker: receiving stolen property

Title: VIDEO: 27-year-old man arrested after short vehicle pursuit, crash, and foot chase in Westlake
description: Police in Westlake, Ohio arrested 27-year-old Anthony Gresham after a brief vehicle pursuit that began during a law enforcement traffic interdiction near Crocker Park. Officers attempted a stop after identifying a vehicle with a suspended registration and visible damage. The driver fled, leading officers on a short chase before losing control and driving into a snow-covered area. Gresham then ran on foot across residential yards and a frozen pond before being captured by officers in a nearby backyard. Police reported recovering a loaded firearm, suspected marijuana, and drug paraphernalia from the vehicle. Additional felony charges are pending review.
Charges: Felony failure to comply; weapons while under disability; resisting arrest; improper handling of firearm; carrying concealed weapon

Title: Assault suspect crashes in Proctor after chase with police along Highway 2
description: Authorities in St. Louis County, Minnesota say a 39-year-old man fled a traffic stop near Saginaw, triggering a police pursuit along Highway 2 that ended in Proctor on March 10, 2026. The chase began after officers attempted to stop a vehicle linked to an alleged assault investigation from Hibbing. During the pursuit, the suspect reportedly threw a powdery substance from the vehicle. The chase ended when the vehicle crashed into two cars. The suspect fled on foot but was tracked into nearby woods, where deputies used a Taser to subdue and arrest him. He was booked into jail pending felony charges.
Charges: assault, fleeing

Title: Suspect identified after assault, high-speed chase through St. Louis County
description: On March 9, 2026, in St. Louis County, Minnesota, a deputy located a vehicle wanted in connection with a prior assault investigation involving Hibbing police. When law enforcement attempted a traffic stop near Saginaw, the driver fled, initiating a high-speed pursuit that continued approximately 13 miles toward Proctor. During the chase, the suspect allegedly threw a powdery substance from the vehicle. The pursuit ended when the suspect crashed into two other vehicles near Highway 2 and Boundary Avenue. He then fled on foot into nearby woods but was later apprehended after officers used a taser. The suspect was taken into custody and booked into the St. Louis County Jail.
Charges: Assault (related prior incident); fleeing law enforcement; additional charges pending or unspecified in report

Title: Fugitive in Southeast MN Manslaughter Case Arrested After Chase Across Frozen Minnesota Lake
description: Authorities in Albert Lea, Minnesota arrested 22-year-old Nickalos DeWayne Taylor after a supervised release violation investigation led to a pursuit involving Minnesota Department of Corrections agents. Officers attempted a traffic stop when Taylor exited a vehicle and fled on foot. The chase continued across Fountain Lake, where Taylor ran onto the frozen surface before being surrounded by law enforcement. He was taken into custody without further incident. Taylor had previously been convicted in a 2020 southeast Minnesota manslaughter case connected to a robbery that resulted in the death of a 75-year-old man and was serving supervised release at the time.
Charges: Supervised release violation,Fleeing police

Title: 20-year-old arrested after high-speed, multiple county police chase
description: On March 12, 2026, in Pipestone County, Minnesota, a deputy attempted to stop a GMC 3500 for a traffic violation. The driver failed to stop, initiating a high-speed pursuit that extended across multiple counties in Minnesota and South Dakota, including Lincoln, Tyler, and Brookings Counties. The chase reached speeds of approximately 95 mph and covered around 80 miles. Law enforcement eventually used a precision intervention technique to stop the vehicle in rural Lincoln County. The driver, identified as 20-year-old Tayton Matthew Brinkmeyer, was arrested and booked into jail following the pursuit.
Charges: Felony fleeing a peace officer in a motor vehicle; driving while impaired

Title: 2 arrested following chase turned multi-vehicle crash
description: A stolen black sedan led police on a chase through Miamisburg after running a red light and striking two vehicles at an intersection on First Street. After the crash, the driver exited the car and fled on foot toward a nearby river. Franklin police officers followed and located the suspect after he entered the water. Miamisburg police assisted in pulling him from the river and taking him into custody. A female passenger in the vehicle complied with officers at the scene. The driver was hospitalized for precautionary treatment and is expected to face charges including failure to comply and obstructing official business.
Charges: Failure to comply Obstructing official business Driving under suspension (reported) Additional warrant-related charges

Title: Man arrested after high-speed chase, crash near Park Rapids
city and state: Park Rapids area, Hubbard County, Minnesota
description: Authorities in Hubbard County, Minnesota say a deputy attempted to stop a vehicle driven by Dareine McCormick on April 30, 2026 near Park Rapids after his license was canceled. McCormick fled at high speed, leading deputies on a 16-mile pursuit reaching over 100 mph across rural roads. The chase ended when he lost control, struck trees, and his vehicle caught fire. He fled on foot but was quickly arrested by deputies. Investigators found methamphetamine the vehicle and obtained a warrant for a blood sample, which he refused. He was booked into jail multiple felony charges including fleeing and drug offenses.
Charges: First-degree DUI refusal to test; fifth-degree controlled substance; fleeing a peace officer

Title: Man arrested for threatening probation officer, high-speed chase in Renville County
description: Authorities in Renville County, Minnesota say a 64-year-old man led deputies on a high-speed pursuit after allegedly threatening his probation officer. Deputies attempted to arrest Thomas McDonald after locating his vehicle, but he fled, triggering a 13-mile chase across rural roads. The pursuit ended in Franklin when deputies deployed tire deflation devices to stop the vehicle. McDonald refused to exit the car and was taken into custody with assistance from multiple law enforcement agencies and a K-9 unit. He was later treated for a dog bite before being booked into jail. The incident stemmed from a reported probation violation threat.
Charges: Threatening to kill probation officer; fleeing law enforcement (pursuit arrest)

Title: Two men arrested after high-speed motorcycle chase on Iron Range
description: Police in Gilbert, Minnesota attempted to stop two sport motorcycles during an evening patrol after the riders were observed speeding. The motorcycles fled and initiated a high-speed pursuit, reaching speeds of over 140 miles per hour across the Iron Range region. Officers from Gilbert and nearby Eveleth agencies coordinated during the chase. Due to the extreme speeds and public safety concerns, law enforcement terminated the pursuit. Investigators later located the motorcycles after identifying them and searching a residence in Eveleth, where both bikes were recovered. Two men were arrested and taken into custody pending charges related to fleeing police and traffic violations.
Charges: Fleeing a police officer; additional traffic-related offenses pending formal charges

Title: Rochester man faces charges after Eden Prairie police chase
description: On Jan 9, 2026 in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, police responded to a report of theft in progress at a retail store. Officers identified suspect vehicle, red Chevrolet Malibu driven by Nathan Eugene Hart, and attempted traffic stop. The driver fled, leading officers on high-speed pursuit through city streets and highways, with speeds exceeding 90 mph and multiple traffic violations. The chase continued onto Interstate 494 and Highway 169 before being terminated near Valley View Road and Bryant Lake Drive using PIT maneuver. Hart was arrested at scene. Drugs and paraphernalia were found in vehicle without further incident and injuries reported
Charges: Fleeing a peace officer in a motor vehicle, two counts of fifth-degree controlled substance possession, and gross misdemeanor driving while impaired

Title: Two Pittsburgh men arrested and charged after drug investigation and police chase in Ohio
description: Two Pittsburgh men were arrested following a drug-related police investigation in East Palestine, Ohio, that escalated into a chase and crash. Officers say the driver, Micah Barnes, intentionally rammed multiple police cruisers during the incident before fleeing the scene. After the crash, both occupants exited the vehicle and attempted to run from police. One suspect, Jaiden Curtis-Tillman, was quickly taken into custody, while Barnes initially escaped. A large multi-agency search was launched involving several law enforcement units, including drone support. Barnes was later located and arrested. Both men are now facing charges connected to assault, drugs, and resisting arrest.
Charges: Barnes: assault on a peace officer, failure to comply, possessing weapons under disability, possession of criminal tools Curtis-Tillman: obstructing official business

Title: Man arrested after police chase and crashing into vehicle in Perry
description: A 40-year-old man led Massillon Police on a vehicle chase after officers attempted to serve him with a felony arrest warrant in Perry Township. He fled in a Lincoln Navigator, driving through residential areas and briefly losing police before continuing northbound. During the pursuit, he rear-ended a Dodge Avenger on Jackson Avenue NW, injuring a 20-year-old woman with minor, non-life-threatening injuries. The suspect abandoned the vehicle in Jackson Township, prompting a perimeter search with K-9 and drone units. He was later located and arrested in Perry Township without further incident. He had outstanding warrants and was also facing new charges.
Charges: Failure to comply with order or signal of police officer (felony), obstructing official business, menacing by stalking (warrant), misdemeanor assault (prior complaint), additional warrant-related offenses

Title: Four arrested after high speed chase in and around Willmar Tuesday
description: Deputies with the Kandiyohi County Sheriff's Office located a vehicle reported stolen near 1st Street South and Willmar Avenue SE. When deputies initiated a traffic stop in the Cash Wise parking lot, the driver briefly stopped but then accelerated away after refusing commands. Three passengers exited during the pursuit and fled on foot before being apprehended and arrested. The driver continued fleeing until a deputy successfully used a PIT maneuver to stop the vehicle. The driver was arrested without further incident and booked into the Kandiyohi County Jail. The Willmar Police Department assisted throughout the incident and subsequent arrests.
Charges: Felony fleeing a peace officer in a motor vehicle Receiving stolen property Driving after revocation Reckless driving

Title: International Falls man arrested after motorcycle pursuit
description: Police in International Falls attempted to stop a motorcycle for an equipment violation near Sixth Street and 13th Avenue around 9:20 p.m. The rider ignored emergency lights and sirens and fled at high speed. The pursuit continued outside city limits, reaching speeds of about 110 mph while traveling along Highway 11/71 and County Road 10. The suspect eventually pulled over and surrendered to officers. Following the arrest, a search warrant led to the recovery of approximately 22.5 grams of methamphetamine and a handgun. The suspect was taken into custody and charged with felony fleeing, DWI, and drug and weapon offenses.
Charges: Felony fleeing a peace officer in a motor vehicle DWI Second-degree possession of methamphetamine Firearm-related offenses (implied from recovery)

Title: Two Drivers Arrested for DUI During Super Bowl Weekend Despite Flagler County Sheriff’s Warnings
description: Fouzia Coopman, 56, was arrested in Palm Coast, Florida, during increased DUI enforcement over Super Bowl weekend. Deputies said they observed Coopman’s Tesla fail to move over for a law enforcement vehicle conducting a traffic stop. During the subsequent stop, deputies reported signs of impairment, including bloodshot eyes, slurred speech, and a strong odor of alcohol. Authorities said she had difficulty providing vehicle documents and failed to complete field sobriety exercises. Coopman was arrested after refusing to submit to a breath test at the detention facility. She was charged with DUI-related offenses and later released on bond.
Charges: DUI, refusal to submit to DUI testing

Title: Man arrested, charged in Neptune Beach road rage shooting
description: Fabio Ladino, 43, was arrested in connection with a road rage shooting incident in Neptune Beach, Florida. Police said officers responded on January 10, 2026, after receiving reports of a firearm being discharged from a moving vehicle during a road rage incident. Investigators also identified a similar incident in Jacksonville Beach involving a matching vehicle. Authorities located the suspected vehicle at a Neptune Beach residence and executed search warrants. Officers recovered a spent shell casing from the vehicle. Following the investigation, Ladino was arrested and booked into the Duval County Jail on firearm, resisting, and marijuana possession charges.
Charges: Discharging a firearm from a vehicle within 1,000 feet of another person; resisting an officer without violence

Title: Florida pair accused of fleeing traffic stop, tossing drugs and gun from vehicle
description: Katheryne Tellez, 33, was arrested in Plant City, Florida, after deputies said she fled from a traffic stop with a passenger in the vehicle. According to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office, deputies attempted a stop near Short Road and Pless Road. Authorities said Tellez drove toward a deputy’s vehicle, forcing the deputy to avoid a collision, then continued fleeing and ignored traffic signals. During the pursuit, a backpack containing narcotics and a firearm was allegedly thrown from the vehicle. Deputies used a Grappler device to stop the vehicle and took both suspects into custody.
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer with a deadly weapon, driving with a revoked license, possession of a firearm by a convicted felon, fleeing and attempting to elude a law enforcement officer

Title: Woman with suspended Ohio license arrested at busy shopping plaza in The Villages
description: Petergay Paige Edwards, 23, was arrested after allegedly damaging a vehicle parked at a bowling alley parking lot in Gainesville. An Alachua County Sheriff’s Deputy responded to Splitz after a victim reported multiple deep scratches, dents, and damage to the vehicle. The victim suspected Edwards due to an ongoing conflict between them. Deputies conducted a traffic stop on Edwards and reported finding paint chips and dust on her key that matched the victim’s vehicle. Authorities said Edwards later admitted to scratching the vehicle.
Charges: Felony property damage

Title: 2 men dart across Hwy 100 to escape police after pursuit crash: Video
description: A 27-year-old Minneapolis man was arrested after a police pursuit involving a stolen vehicle that ended in a crash on Highway 100 in Golden Valley, Minnesota. The incident began in Bloomington when officers responded to reports of a stolen vehicle and a possible attempted break-in. Police attempted a traffic stop, but the driver fled, leading to a chase. After the vehicle crashed, two men exited and ran across Highway 100 into a wooded area. A police K-9 helped locate one suspect, while the other was found hiding in water. Both suspects were taken into custody.
Charges: Fleeing Police Possession/Use of Stolen Vehicle Burglary-related investigation Vehicle theft-related charges

Title: Man arrested on DUI charge after driving truck into Lake Alice
description: Angelo Rodriguez, 27, was arrested after police found him inside a pickup truck partially submerged in Lake Alice in Gainesville, Florida. Authorities said Rodriguez was located in the driver’s seat of a silver Toyota Tundra after officers responded to the incident. The vehicle had damaged a shoreline railing and entered the lake from Village Road. Officers reported Rodriguez showed signs of impairment and smelled of alcohol. A blood test reportedly showed an alcohol level of 0.278 g/100 ml, more than three times the legal limit. Rodriguez was charged with DUI with property damage and driving without a license after previous suspensions.
Charges: Driving under the influence with property damage; Knowingly driving without a license, third or subsequent offense

Title: Pair in Cadillac arrested at shopping plaza in The Villages
description: James Allen Kennedy and Amanda Marie Cappola were arrested after a traffic stop involving a Cadillac at a shopping plaza in The Villages. Police said Kennedy was driving with his high beams on and could not provide a driver’s license, registration, or insurance documents. A records check showed his license was suspended. A K-9 unit alerted on the vehicle, leading to a search. Officers allegedly found fentanyl and hypodermic needles concealed on Cappola. Both suspects were taken into custody, with Kennedy facing a driving offense and Cappola facing drug possession charges.
Charges: Driving while license suspended (felony)

Title: Intoxicated Man Arrested on Camera After Crashing Out in Gainesville
description: Lucas Scott Lehman, 20, was arrested in Gainesville after police accused him of driving under the influence and damaging property in a crash. Authorities reported Lehman struck a tree and caused approximately $500 in damage. During the investigation, Lehman performed poorly on field sobriety tests and allegedly told officers he consumed two shots of Crown and Patron mixed before the crash. He was arrested for causing damage to property while driving under the influence and released on bond. Records also show Lehman had previous pending criminal traffic cases and a prior pretrial intervention agreement related to misdemeanor battery charges.
Charges: Causing damage to property while driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: 16-year-old girl hits deputy patrol car trying to flee: HCSO
description: A 16-year-old female, Angelisa Ugarte, was arrested by the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office after deputies attempted to stop a stolen vehicle. Authorities said deputies responded to a report of a stolen vehicle near Sheldon Road and West Hillsborough Avenue. When deputies tried to conduct a stop, Ugarte allegedly fled from officers and later struck a marked patrol vehicle while attempting to escape. She was taken into custody and charged with multiple offenses, including grand theft motor vehicle, fleeing to elude, resisting an officer without violence, and possession of drug paraphernalia. No further details about injuries or damages were reported.
Charges: Grand theft motor vehicle, fleeing to elude, resisting an officer without violence

Title: Traffic stop leads to drug arrest, child neglect charges
description: Ashley Marie Sheppard, 35, was arrested in Bell, Florida, after a traffic stop led deputies to discover methamphetamine and alleged child neglect concerns. According to the Gilchrist County Sheriff’s Office, deputies stopped Sheppard for an expired vehicle registration. During the stop, they determined she was driving with a suspended license and developed suspicion that narcotics were inside the vehicle. A search reportedly found methamphetamine in her bag. Deputies also discovered a 2-year-old child in the back seat and reported unsafe and unsanitary conditions. Sheppard was arrested and the child was placed with the Florida Department of Children and Families.
Charges: Felony child neglect, possession of a controlled substance (methamphetamine), driving while license suspended

Title: Daube arrested twice in multiple counties for OVI
description: Cierra Daube, 37, was arrested twice within hours after separate traffic stops in Urbana and Bellefontaine, Ohio, for alleged impaired driving. The first stop occurred after officers learned her driver’s license was canceled and observed signs of impairment. Officers found an open alcohol container and later discovered a bag containing cocaine inside the vehicle. After release to a sober driver, Daube was reportedly stopped again in Bellefontaine while driving the same vehicle and showed signs of impairment. She failed sobriety tests during both incidents and was transported to the Logan County Jail.
Charges: Operating a vehicle impaired (OVI), related traffic offenses

Title: Bond set for woman accused of spraying mace in face of Reading police officers
description: Jame D. Savell was arrested after an incident involving multiple Reading police officers in Reading, Ohio. According to court documents, Savell was in physical control of her vehicle while allegedly under the influence of alcohol and refused officers’ commands to exit the vehicle. Police said she sprayed mace into the faces of two officers and attempted to spray another. Authorities also alleged that she struck an officer in the face with a closed fist. During the incident, an officer fell and suffered a dislocated shoulder along with abrasions. Savell was charged with multiple assault and resisting offenses.
Charges: Felonious assault, assault, attempted assault, resisting arrest

Title: Wanted woman with suspended license stopped for cracked windshield
description: Glendina Jo Flores, 54, was arrested after a traffic stop in Summerfield when a deputy observed her driving a vehicle with a cracked windshield. During the stop, authorities discovered Flores had an active warrant for failure to appear in court related to previous charges, including possession of cocaine, providing a false name or identification to law enforcement, and driving while license suspended. A driving history check showed her license had been suspended twice in 2025. Flores was taken into custody and transported to Marion County Jail.
Charges: Driving while license suspended Failure to appear warrant Previous charges connected to warrant, giving false name or ID to law enforcement

Title: Alachua County woman charged after striking patrol vehicle and fleeing with children in car, deputies say
description: Michelle Bartholomew, 25, was arrested in Alachua County, Florida, after allegedly striking a patrol vehicle and fleeing from deputies while two young children were inside her vehicle. Deputies responded to reports of a woman in a white vehicle attempting to hit a man. When officers approached, Bartholomew allegedly accelerated toward them, struck a patrol vehicle, and attempted to hit another deputy’s vehicle. She then fled, running red lights and exceeding speed limits. Deputies ended the pursuit due to concerns for the children’s safety. Later, Bartholomew was found with the children and taken into custody after resisting. Her vehicle reportedly lacked car seats.
Charges: Two counts of aggravated battery on law enforcement Two counts of child abuse without great bodily harm Aggravated assault on law enforcement Aggravated fleeing and eluding

Title: Wanted woman with suspended license stopped for cracked windshield
description: Sally Nichole Rice, 35, was arrested after a traffic stop at La Plaza Grande shopping plaza in The Villages. A Lady Lake Police officer reportedly stopped Rice after noticing a vehicle with a loosely hanging tag. A records check showed the vehicle tag issue and that Rice’s Ohio driver’s license was suspended with an “ID Card Only” status. Police said Rice admitted she could not obtain a Florida driver’s license because of the Ohio suspension. She was arrested and later released after posting bond.
Charges: Driving while license suspended with knowledge No driver’s license

Title: Drunk driver causes crash in Alachua; blood alcohol 3 times legal limit, officers say
description: Ricky Walker, a 64-year-old Gainesville man, was arrested after police said he caused a crash while driving under the influence in Alachua, Florida. Officers responded to a crash on U.S. Highway 441 and determined Walker crossed the center line, striking another vehicle traveling in the opposite direction. Both vehicles were totaled, but no serious injuries were reported. Police said Walker appeared intoxicated and failed field sobriety exercises. His blood alcohol test results were reported as 0.26 and 0.25, which is more than three times the legal limit. Walker was arrested and booked into jail on a DUI charge.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)

Title: MN police officer arrested in Bloomington for suspected DWI
description: Kenneth Ronald Gallion, a 61-year-old part-time Chatfield police officer from Rochester, was arrested in Bloomington after allegedly speeding and crashing his vehicle around midnight. He was reportedly in full police uniform at the time of the incident. Bloomington police administered a breath test that showed a blood alcohol concentration of 0.28, more than three times Minnesota's legal limit of 0.08. Following the arrest, the Chatfield City Council held an emergency meeting and terminated his employment. Court records indicate Gallion faces multiple impaired driving charges as well as a charge for carrying a pistol while intoxicated. No injuries or fatalities were reported.
Charges: Two counts of Driving While Intoxicated (DWI) Carrying a pistol while intoxicated

Title: Mother of 16 hit by DUI driver during Daytona Bike Week leaves hospital
description: On March 4, 2026, Shantell Williams was riding her Harley-Davidson motorcycle after leaving a gas station in Daytona Beach when she was struck by a vehicle driven by Lanieja Sturgis. The collision occurred less than a minute after Williams left the station, throwing her about 20 feet from the impact. Police investigated the crash and reported that Sturgis failed a field sobriety test and that officers detected the smell of alcohol on her breath. She was arrested and charged with DUI-related offenses. Williams suffered severe injuries, including a shattered pelvis, broken breastbone, and fractures in both arms, requiring surgeries and rehabilitation.
Charges: Driving under the influence (DUI)(Three count)

Title: Ocala man arrested after I-75 pursuit that temporarily closed two lanes on interstate
description: John Todd Reed, a 38-year-old Ocala man, was arrested after allegedly fleeing from law enforcement during a pursuit that began in Sarasota and continued into Alachua County, Florida. Authorities said Reed was driving a black Jeep Cherokee at speeds over 100 mph while weaving through traffic and using roadway shoulders. Multiple attempts to stop the vehicle were unsuccessful before Alachua County deputies deployed stop sticks on I-75. Reed lost control and crashed into a guardrail, causing temporary lane closures. After being taken into custody, a search of the vehicle reportedly found firearms, ammunition, magazines, and a plate carrier.
Charges: Reckless driving; Fleeing with lights and sirens active

Title: Margate Crime Blotter: Road Rage Incident Ends with Gun Brandished at Driver
description: Malachi Henry was identified as a suspect involved in a fleeing and resisting incident in the State Road 7 area of Margate, Florida. According to the report, he and another suspect allegedly fled from officers on dirt bikes, struck a police vehicle, and dragged an officer approximately 10 yards before being apprehended. Officers used tasers during the arrest. Henry was taken into custody and faces charges related to the pursuit, resistance, and traffic offenses. The report does not indicate any firearm, drug, or murder involvement in this case. The incident occurred during police activity in Margate involving unlawful vehicle flight.
Charges: Resisting, fleeing, hit-and-run, and traffic charges

Title: Leesburg teen plunges into Lake Eustis in bid to avoid arrest
description: Bre’Azanea Na’Shay Tolbert, 18, of Leesburg, Florida, was arrested after allegedly fleeing from a traffic stop and attempting to avoid capture by hiding in Lake Eustis. Police stopped her vehicle for speeding and discovered she did not have a valid driver’s license. Officers reported smelling marijuana from the vehicle. Tolbert allegedly ran from the traffic stop and was later found submerged in water while wearing a ski mask. Authorities said she had an active probation violation warrant related to previous charges. A vehicle search reportedly found marijuana and alcohol. She was taken into custody and booked without bond.
Charges: No driver's license (never had one); resisting without violence

Title: Martin County deputies bust alleged baby formula bandits who traveled from Miami
description: Three female suspects from Miami were accused of stealing baby formula from multiple Publix stores in Martin County, Florida, on March 17, 2026. Surveillance footage allegedly showed the suspects entering stores, taking formula containers, placing them into bags, and leaving without payment. Deputies reported losses of more than $1,400 from two stores. A Florida Highway Patrol trooper later stopped their vehicle on Interstate 95 and found 262 cans of formula valued at about $8,000. Investigators stated the suspects allegedly planned to sell the stolen formula and believe the case may involve a larger organized retail theft operation.
Charges: Retail theft over $750 involving multiple thefts

Title: Leeburg woman with beer and vodka in car arrested on DUI charge
description: Kristine Marie Rodites was arrested in Leesburg, Florida, after officers conducted a traffic stop on her vehicle for making a prohibited right turn at a red light. During the stop, officers observed signs of impairment, including slurred speech, glossy eyes, and difficulty maintaining balance. A K-9 unit responded, and Rodites performed poorly during field sobriety exercises. Officers found an open beer in the vehicle and a vodka bottle in the passenger area. Breath tests showed alcohol levels above the legal limit. She was arrested and transported to jail for DUI and driving with a suspended or revoked license.
Charges: Driving Under the Influence (DUI) Driving While License Suspended or Revoked

Title: ‘You’re going to have to kill me’: Avon Park woman accused of crashing into patrol car, assaulting deputy
description: Tori Leshawn Ki Hester, 20, was arrested in Avon Park, Florida, after authorities accused her of fleeing from traffic stops, crashing into a patrol vehicle, and resisting arrest. Deputies reported that Hester’s Toyota Camry had previously fled two attempted stops before an officer located her at a store. During the attempted stop, police said she reversed into a patrol car and later tried to escape on foot. Deputies stated she resisted being handcuffed and attempted to leave a patrol vehicle, requiring a taser deployment. Hester was charged with multiple offenses, including assaulting law enforcement and drug-related possession charges.
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer; felony criminal mischief; resisting arrest; attempted escape; driving with a suspended license

Title: Washington Township arrests Marshall for OVI
description: Wendy Marshall was arrested in Washington Township, Ohio, after officers conducted a traffic stop for speeding on State Route 366 near Allen Drive. Officers observed Marshall traveling 47 miles per hour in a 35-mile-per-hour zone. During their interaction, officers noticed signs of impairment, and Marshall admitted to consuming alcoholic beverages before driving. She agreed to perform field sobriety tests, which resulted in her arrest for Operating a Vehicle Impaired (OVI). At the Logan County Jail, she provided a breath test result of .155, which is nearly twice the legal limit. She was charged and taken into custody.
Charges: Two counts of Operating a Vehicle Impaired (OVI) Speeding

Title: Pregnant woman leads officers on chase with 2 kids in car: Police
description: Britney Smith, 26, was arrested after police said she led officers on a vehicle chase in Youngstown while two children were inside the car. Officers reportedly attempted a traffic stop after observing a failure to use a turn signal, but Smith allegedly failed to stop and drove away at high speed. Police said the vehicle nearly struck other vehicles before leaving the roadway and crashing into a building. Officers found two children in the backseat who were not properly restrained. Smith told police she fled because she lacked a driver’s license, insurance, and had expired registration.
Charges: Fleeing and eluding (failure to comply with order or signal of a police officer) Endangering children Traffic charge

Title: Do something': West Palm man arrested in alleged road rage shooting inside community
description: Tierany Jaden Robinson, 23, was arrested following an alleged road rage shooting inside the Sunset Isles community near West Palm Beach, Florida. Investigators said Robinson aggressively tailgated another driver before both vehicles stopped and the drivers argued. During the confrontation, Robinson allegedly told the victim to "do something," retrieved a handgun, and fired at least three rounds toward the victim's vehicle. One bullet struck the vehicle, and investigators recovered shell casings and other evidence at the scene. Surveillance footage, license plate reader data, GPS records, and a photo lineup were used to identify Robinson as the alleged shooter.
Charges: Shooting into an occupied vehicle Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon Discharging a firearm in public

Title: High-speed chase in Collier County ends with woman facing DUI and drug possession charges
description: Laken Badley was arrested in Collier County, Florida, following a five-mile police pursuit that began after deputies attempted a traffic stop at Kings Lake Square shopping center. Deputies reported that Badley failed to stop and continued driving through multiple areas, reaching speeds over 70 mph in a 45 mph zone. During the pursuit, she allegedly refused commands to exit the vehicle and continued driving after stopping at a traffic light. After being stopped at an apartment complex, deputies detected the smell of alcohol and conducted sobriety testing. Jail staff later found THC reportedly in her possession.
Charges: DUI Fleeing and Eluding Police Drug Possession

Title: Woman arrested for stealing lawn equipment across parts of Hollywood
description: Deanna Lewis, 30, was arrested in Hollywood, Florida, after deputies accused her of stealing lawn equipment from a truck. According to the Broward Sheriff’s Office, drone footage allegedly showed Lewis taking the equipment from the back of a vehicle and placing it inside her car. Shortly afterward, deputies conducted a traffic stop and arrested her. Authorities said the vehicle she was driving had also been connected to other lawn equipment burglaries reported in the previous year. Lewis was charged with burglary and petit theft following the investigation into the stolen property.
Charges: Burglary, petit theft

Title: Duo arrested following road rage fueled attack with a golf club
description: Clarence Lyons, 37, and Patience Jentzen, 31, were arrested following an alleged road rage-related assault in Robbinsdale, Minnesota. Police said the incident began when a man stopped behind two vehicles involved in a road rage situation and attempted to calm the conflict. Investigators said Lyons and Jentzen exited their vehicle and confronted the man. Lyons allegedly attacked the victim with a golf club, and Jentzen allegedly took the victim’s car keys and also participated in the assault. The victim suffered injuries to his head and face. Both suspects were arrested and face assault-related charges connected to the incident.
Charges: Clarence Lyons: Second-degree assault Patience Jentzen: Second-degree assault; aggravated robbery

Title: Man arrested after leading deputies on chase, allegedly ramming cruiser in Clark County
description: Matthew Violet, 54, of Dayton, Ohio, was arrested after allegedly leading Clark County deputies on a vehicle pursuit. The incident began when a patrol unit observed a vehicle traveling 60 mph in a 35 mph zone near West Columbia and Water streets. Deputies pursued Violet for approximately 16 minutes before boxing in his vehicle on Sheridan Avenue near South Belmont Street. Authorities said Violet repeatedly rammed a patrol vehicle while attempting to escape. He was taken for medical evaluation before being booked into the Clark County Jail. Officials reported that no deputies were injured during the pursuit.
Charges: Felonious assault Failure to comply with an order or signal of a police officer Vandalism Obstructing official business

Title: Man accused of robbing Wadsworth store, forcing worker into cooler arrested after chase: Police
description: David Jimison Jr., 52, was arrested after police said he robbed a convenience store in Wadsworth, Ohio, at knifepoint and later led officers on a vehicle pursuit. Police responded to the Minit Mart on College Street after an employee reported that a man entered the store, displayed a knife, demanded money, and forced the employee into a cooler before leaving. Hours later, officers located Jimison in a vehicle and attempted a traffic stop. Police said he fled, leading to a pursuit that ended at his residence on West Street, where he was taken into custody.
Charges: Aggravated robbery Kidnapping Failure to comply

Title: Police: Driver charged with OVI, accused of hitting 5 cars during chase
description: Osmar Perez was arrested after Cincinnati police accused him of driving under the influence and hitting five vehicles during a pursuit. Police said Perez was leaving a brewery in Delhi Township when investigators tracked him using drone footage. Authorities alleged that he was driving erratically, did not have a valid driver’s license, and continued operating the vehicle before officers stopped him on Purcell Avenue. Perez was taken into custody and charged with multiple misdemeanors related to impaired driving and operating without a license. A judge set his bond at $30,000 following the arrest.
Charges: Operating a vehicle under the influence of alcohol/drugs (OVI) Operating a motor vehicle without a license Additional misdemeanor charges related to crashes

Title: Watch: Law enforcement chases erratic Columbus driver who jumped off concrete wall
description: Taeon Randle, 23, was arrested after leading Ohio State Highway Patrol troopers and Columbus police officers on a vehicle and foot pursuit in Columbus. Troopers initially attempted a traffic stop after observing Randle fail to stop at a stop sign near Oaklawn Street and Huy Road. Police said Randle continued driving an Infiniti, driving erratically during the pursuit. After stopping near Easton Way, Randle exited the vehicle and fled on foot, including jumping over a concrete wall before running away from officers. He was later arrested near a Speedway gas station. Authorities found the vehicle was stolen and discovered narcotics inside.
Charges: Felony fleeing and eluding Receiving stolen property Four traffic violations

Title: Ohio man accused of threatening authorities, charged in multi-state police chase
description: Casey O’Brien, a 35-year-old man from Springfield, Ohio, was arrested after allegedly making threats against law enforcement on social media and leading officers on a multi-state police chase. Authorities said O’Brien was believed to be armed and threatened officers if they attempted contact. Troopers and deputies attempted a traffic stop near State Route 7 and County Road 403 in Proctorville, Ohio, but he allegedly fled. The pursuit continued into Huntington, West Virginia, where police stopped him and took him into custody. Officers found firearms and ammunition inside the vehicle.
Charges: Fleeing (criminal charges being pursued) Additional charges pending

Title: Youngstown police use spike strips to stop SUV during high-speed chase Thursday: Report
description: Brad Walker, 32, was arrested after allegedly leading police on a high-speed chase in an SUV through Youngstown, Ohio. Police said officers observed Walker driving at high speed and attempted a traffic stop, but he fled after emergency lights and sirens were activated. The pursuit continued through several areas of the city, reaching speeds of about 90 mph. An officer deployed spike strips on an Interstate 680 exit ramp, causing the SUV to stop. Police found a loaded .40-caliber semiautomatic handgun with an extended magazine inside the vehicle. Walker was prohibited from possessing firearms due to a prior drug conviction.
Charges: Felon in possession of a firearm Failure to comply with the order or signal of a police officer Improper handling of a firearm in a motor vehicle

Title: Toledo man arrested following second TPD chase Thursday
description: Rashaun Young, 19, was arrested after allegedly leading Toledo Police officers on a high-speed pursuit following a traffic violation stop attempt. Police said the pursuit began near Collingwood Boulevard and Winthrop Avenue and continued through city streets, highways, and residential areas. Authorities reported that Young reached speeds of 90–100 mph, ran multiple red lights, and eventually crashed into oncoming traffic at Detroit Avenue and Sunset Boulevard. No serious injuries were reported. After his arrest, police said Young resisted officers during handcuffing. A vehicle search allegedly uncovered firearms and cocaine.
Charges: Failure to comply with police orders Having weapons under disability Improper handling of firearms in a motor vehicle Resisting arrest

Title: 120 MPH Pursuit Out of Chillicothe Ends After Drug Trafficking Suspect Runs Out of Gas
description: Terrance "TC" Collins Sr. was arrested after allegedly leading Chillicothe Police and the Ohio State Highway Patrol on a 13-mile high-speed pursuit during an ongoing drug trafficking investigation. Officers attempted a traffic stop after observing illegal window tint, but Collins fled, reaching speeds exceeding 120 mph. During the pursuit, he struck an occupied City of Chillicothe utility truck before continuing onto US-35. The chase ended when his Chevrolet Silverado ran out of gas on the Vigo Road exit ramp. Officers took him into custody without further incident and seized two cell phones as part of the ongoing investigation.
Charges: Failure to comply (fleeing and eluding) Leaving the scene of an accident Window tint violations

Title: Man, 24, indicted following police chase
description: Elijah M. Smith, 24, was indicted following a police chase in Youngstown, Ohio, after officers attempted to stop him based on law-enforcement database alerts related to alleged criminal activity. Police said Smith refused commands, drove away, and led officers on a pursuit through the East, North, and South sides of the city. The chase ended when Smith crashed the vehicle on South and Dickson avenues and fled on foot. Officers used a stun gun during the arrest after Smith allegedly resisted. He was treated at a hospital before being taken to jail.
Charges: Violation of a protection order Trespass into a habitation when a person is present or likely to be present Failure to comply with the order or signal of a police officer Unauthorized use of a vehicle Failure to stop after an accident Resisting arrest Obstructing official business Driving under suspension

Suspect Name: Demarcus Gilmer, Jessie Gilmer, Anton Caldwell, Odarrius Brown
Title: 4 charged in gas station robbery after arrest in high-speed police pursuit
description: On May 25, 2026, a robbery occurred at a Circle K gas station on Lewis Avenue in Toledo, Ohio. Four male suspects were arrested after a high-speed police pursuit that traveled into Michigan and returned to Ohio. Law enforcement agencies involved included Toledo Police, Washington Township Police, and the Ohio State Highway Patrol. Court documents stated that the suspects were connected to the robbery and later indicted. The investigation resulted in multiple criminal charges related to the alleged armed robbery and evidence tampering.
Charges: Aggravated robbery with a deadly weapon; Tampering with Evidence; Odarrius Brown also charged with Failure to Comply

Title: Police identify suspects in chase involving stolen SUV, multiple crashes
description: On March 30, 2026, police pursued a stolen Cadillac Escalade through Holland and Toledo, Ohio. Holland police began the chase after the vehicle struck another vehicle on Airport Highway. Toledo police later joined the pursuit, during which the stolen SUV reportedly crashed into multiple vehicles at several locations. The driver, Gregory Anderson, 48, was taken into custody after crashing at Front Street and Euclid Avenue. Passenger Angela Whittecar, 47, was also arrested after allegedly attempting to flee on foot. Both suspects faced criminal charges related to the stolen vehicle and their actions during the police response.
Charges: Gregory Anderson: Receiving stolen property, resisting arrest, obstructing official business, failure to comply with an order or signal of a police officer, and other related charges. Angela Whittecar: Resisting arrest and obstructing official business.

Title: BWC: Carjacking suspect fires shots at Ohio officers, prompting OIS after nearly hour-long pursuit
description: On January 6, 2026, Cleveland police officers and Cuyahoga County deputies pursued Reuben Bell, 38, after he was accused of multiple carjackings across Cleveland-area communities. During the pursuit, Bell allegedly continued fleeing even after officers deployed spike strips to disable the vehicle. Authorities later used a PIT maneuver to stop the car. After the vehicle stopped, Bell allegedly fired multiple shots at officers, who returned gunfire and wounded him. Bell was taken to a hospital in critical condition before being charged. No officers or deputies were injured during the incident. The case involved an officer-involved shooting investigation.
Charges: Three counts of felonious assault against a peace officer Additional charges expected

Title: Toledo man accused of 100+ mph pursuit, foot chase and gun violation
description: Jayden Gibson, a 21-year-old Toledo man, was arrested after allegedly leading police on a high-speed vehicle pursuit on March 30, 2026. Police said the chase reached speeds exceeding 100 miles per hour. During the pursuit, Gibson allegedly drove through red lights, over sidewalks, and across residential yards before abandoning the vehicle and fleeing on foot. Authorities also alleged that he was illegally carrying a firearm during the incident. He was later apprehended and indicted on June 2. Gibson pleaded not guilty on June 17, and his bond was set at $20,000. He was scheduled to return to court on July 15.
Charges: Failure to Comply Tampering with Evidence

Title: Charges dismissed against man accused of leading city police on chase
description: Calvin Shelton, 36, was arrested after allegedly leading Youngstown police on a vehicle pursuit on May 7, 2026, on the city's South Side. He was initially charged with failure to comply with the order or signal of a police officer, a third-degree felony. Reports indicated that a helicopter was used during the search to help locate and apprehend him after the pursuit. On May 14, 2026, during a preliminary hearing in municipal court, the charge was dismissed. Court records did not provide a reason for the dismissal. The article did not report any injuries, additional offenses, or other details related to the pursuit.
Charges: Failure to comply with the order or signal of a police officer

Title: Three arrested following police chase in Toledo and Michigan
description: Toledo police attempted to stop a stolen Dodge Challenger at approximately 1:00 a.m. on April 23, 2026. The driver refused to stop, leading officers from the Toledo Police Department and Washington Township into a pursuit that crossed into Michigan before returning to Ohio. The chase ended on the I-75 Exit 206 ramp after the vehicle struck a concrete traffic island. The driver, Christopher Fought, fled on foot but was quickly apprehended. Two passengers also fled and were taken into custody. Police confirmed the vehicle was stolen. The investigation remained ongoing, and additional details had not yet been released.
Charges: Failure to comply,fleeing

Title: BODYCAM VIDEO | Man captured after Portage County K-9 chase; suspected in vehicle theft
description: Daniel Summers was arrested after Portage County deputies responded to reports of a suspicious vehicle near Sandy Lake Road on March 18, 2026. Authorities said a caller reported that Summers abandoned the vehicle and allegedly attempted to steal another vehicle while armed with a gun. Deputies located him in Rootstown Township, where he fled on foot. A Portage County K-9 unit pursued and apprehended him. Investigators determined the abandoned vehicle had been reported stolen from Tallmadge, and the vehicle keys were reportedly found in Summers’ possession. Summers was charged in Ravenna Municipal Court with several offenses related to the incident.
Charges: Criminal damaging Resisting arrest Receiving stolen property Obstructing official business
