The teen fell, rolled onto his back, and pointed a firearm at the deputy, who then fired several shots. The teen suffered a graze wound to the ankle and was hospitalized in stable condition. A stolen firearm was recovered, and multiple teens faced charges related to firearms and resisting officers.
Charges: Minor possessing a firearm, resisting an officer, tampering with evidence, assault on an officer

Title: 1 dead after officer-involved shooting in St. Pete: SPPD
description: Officers responded to a residence in St. Petersburg after a report of an attempted suicide. Police found 37-year-old Kasey Sedlock inside the home holding a knife and asking officers to shoot him. Officers attempted to stop him using tasers, causing him to drop the knife temporarily. According to authorities, Sedlock continued reaching for the knife, then grabbed it again and charged toward officers. One officer fired four shots, striking Sedlock. He was taken to a hospital where he was pronounced dead. The incident is being investigated by the Pinellas County Use of Deadly Force Task Force.
Charges: No charges reported

Title: Tampa Police Make Arrest in Fatal Shooting on West Main Street
description: On June 21, 2026, Tampa Police officers responding to a large gathering near West Main Street and North Albany Avenue heard gunshots and found 29-year-old Kevondre Thomas suffering from critical injuries. Thomas was taken to a hospital, where he later died. Investigators said surveillance footage showed Roosevelt Harmon arguing with Thomas before Harmon allegedly pulled out a firearm and shot him. A witness also identified Harmon as the shooter. Harmon was arrested on July 7, 2026, in Palm Beach County by the U.S. Marshals Fugitive Task Force. Police continue the investigation into the fatal shooting.
Charges: Murder in the First-Degree Premeditated Firearm Felon in Possession of a Firearm

Title: Man charged with murder after calling 911 in Lauderhill shooting, cops say
description: Anthony Johnson, 35, was charged with first-degree premeditated murder after a fatal shooting in Lauderhill, Florida. Police said officers responded to the 900 block of Northwest 34th Terrace after Johnson called 911. When officers arrived, they found 35-year-old Reginald Merisma suffering from a gunshot wound in a driveway, and he was pronounced dead at the scene. Investigators said surveillance video showed Johnson approaching Merisma and firing multiple shots before shooting him in the head. Police said Johnson remained at the scene after the shooting and was arrested based on probable cause. A motive was not immediately released.
Charges: First-degree premeditated murder

Title: Woman armed with knife shot killed by Orange County deputies, sheriff says
description: Deputies responded at about 1:00 p.m. on June 3, 2026, after a neighbor reported a woman screaming outside a home on Tivoli Drive in Orange County, Florida. When deputies knocked on the door, 59-year-old Rosalia Hodges came outside holding a large knife. Deputies backed away and repeatedly ordered her to drop the knife, but she refused. According to Sheriff John Mina, Hodges repeatedly threatened to kill the deputies while advancing toward them. Three deputies fired their weapons, striking her. She was transported to a hospital, where she was pronounced dead. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the shooting.
Charges: suspect deceased

Title: Suspect in Vero Beach deputy-involved shooting was on run from Colo. sex assault warrant
description: On March 2, 2026, members of a U.S. Marshals Task Force located fugitive Dr. Thomas Steffens near 12th Street and Commerce Avenue in Vero Beach, Florida. Steffens was wanted on Colorado warrants for sexual assault and assault offenses. Authorities conducted a tactical vehicle intervention after tracking him from a restaurant. Deputies ordered him to exit the vehicle, but he refused and opened fire, striking a U.S. Marshal in the leg and damaging law enforcement vehicles. Five officers returned fire, wounding Steffens. After about ten minutes, deputies used pepper balls and a drone before taking him into custody. He survived the shooting.
Charges: Two counts of sexual assault (Colorado) Second-degree assault (Colorado) Third-degree assault (Colorado) Attempted murder of law enforcement officers (Florida, pending) Possible federal charges for threats against federal agents

Title: Man shot and killed by Miami Gardens officer; FDLE leading investigation
description: On January 23, 2026, just before 4:00 p.m., Miami Gardens police responded to a home near Northwest 182nd Street and 35th Avenue after reports involving a person in crisis. Officers encountered an armed man and believed another individual at the scene was in immediate danger. During the confrontation, one or two officers fired their weapons, striking the man. He died at the scene. Neighbors reported hearing multiple gunshots, and police secured the area while investigators processed the scene. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement assumed responsibility for investigating the officer-involved shooting, which is standard procedure in Florida. The investigation remains ongoing.
Charges: suspect deceased

Title: ‘I would have killed them all': Fla. sheriff says suspect who wounded deputy ran out of ammo
description: On March 2, 2026, Volusia County deputies responded to a residence on Candler Drive in Deltona after a woman reported that a man had damaged her vehicle. When deputies arrived to investigate, the suspect allegedly opened fire from the home, striking Deputy Jose Rivera in the arm and leg. Authorities said the suspect fired 12 rounds and later stated he intended to kill the deputies if he had not run out of ammunition. Deputies provided medical aid, transported Rivera to a hospital, and arrested the suspect. Rivera survived. The suspect was reportedly held without bond while facing attempted murder charges.
Charges: Two counts of attempted murder of a law enforcement officer with a firearm

Title: Male killed by an off-duty Osceola deputy at Kissimmee Walmart was a 16-year-old, sheriff's office says
description: On February 19, 2026, an off-duty Osceola County Sheriff’s deputy shot and killed a 16-year-old male inside a Walmart on Cypress Parkway in Kissimmee, Florida. According to the sheriff’s office, the teenager was suspected of theft and was with two other individuals when loss prevention officers and the deputy attempted to stop them. Authorities said the teen ran through the store while holding a firearm, and the deputy fired at him. The teenager was pronounced dead. The other two individuals fled. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the shooting, and the deputy involved was placed on administrative leave.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Claimed to be armed,' Florida man dies in hospital days after Longwood Circle K officer shooting
description: On January 13, 2026, Longwood police responded to a Circle K gas station at 1001 West State Road 434 after a 911 caller reported a man with a gun threatening to harm himself. Officers attempted to de-escalate the situation, but police said the man repeatedly claimed he was armed and acted in a threatening manner. According to authorities, the man pulled his hand from his waistband and appeared to simulate drawing a firearm. An officer fired multiple shots, striking him. He was taken to a hospital for surgery but later died from complications. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement investigated the shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: New video shows Fort Lauderdale officers fatally shooting armed man who opened fire
description: Fort Lauderdale police officers fatally shot 43-year-old Luis Felipe Londono Ospina after authorities said he arrived at a disturbance scene armed with a handgun and fired multiple rounds while approaching officers. Police stated that officers ordered him to drop the weapon, but he continued firing. When Ospina lowered his gun toward officers, three officers opened fire, striking him multiple times. He was transported to Broward Health Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the officer-involved shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Police: 1 arrested after shooting leaves senior amputee dead at Sunrise apartment complex
description: On June 10, 2026, Sunrise Police responded to reports of gunfire at an apartment complex on Sunrise Lakes Boulevard. Officers found 70-year-old Winston Murphy, an amputee who used a wheelchair, dead at the scene. Police identified Kanhai Wilson as the suspect and said he fled after the shooting. Wilson was later apprehended in Dania Beach with assistance from the Broward Sheriff’s Office. Investigators said the suspect vehicle, a purple Chevrolet sedan, was connected to the case. Authorities stated the incident was isolated and there was no ongoing threat to the public.
Charges: Murder with a dangerous, depraved mind without premeditation Fleeing and eluding Resisting arrest

Title: Bodycam was off when deputies fatally shot stabbing suspect, LCSO says as family demands answers
description: On April 12, 2026, Lake County Sheriff’s deputies responded to a 911 call reporting a stabbing in the Montclair area of Leesburg. Deputies encountered Timotheus Reed, 38, who was identified as the stabbing suspect. A deputy fired one shot, striking Reed in the abdomen. Reed was transported to Orlando Regional Medical Center, where he later died. The deputy’s body camera was not activated during the shooting, and the footage released only showed the aftermath. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating whether the deputy’s actions complied with use-of-force laws.
Charges: Alleged stabbing suspect (no charges reported before death)

Title: VIDEO: Florida officers shoot, kill man accused of breaking into multiple homes, pointing gun at victims, officers say
description: On May 4, 2026, Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office officers responded to reports of multiple armed home burglaries on Rigel Road. Authorities said Brandon Kaphers kicked in the doors of several townhomes, entered the residences, and pointed a handgun at victims. After locating him between parked vehicles, officers identified him as the suspect. Police said Kaphers walked toward officers and pointed his firearm at them twice despite repeated commands to drop the weapon. Four officers then fired, striking him. Officers provided emergency medical aid before transporting him to a hospital, where he later died. The incident remains under investigation.
Charges: Armed burglary Home invasion Aggravated assault with a firearm (based on reported actions; no formal charges filed before death)

Title: 2 teens arrested in Manatee County after Tampa shooting injures 2 others
description: Police responded to reports of a domestic dispute at an apartment complex on Egrets Nest Drive in Jacksonville on January 5, 2026. Witnesses reported that a married couple had been arguing and that the man had briefly left before returning with a firearm. Officers separated the couple and spoke with the woman before approaching the man. As officers attempted to speak with him, he pulled a handgun from his waistband. Two officers immediately fired, striking him. He was transported to a local hospital, where he later died from his injuries. The State Attorney’s Office and the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office investigated the shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Man shot five times by deputies after domestic violence call in Englewood
description: Charlotte County deputies responded to a domestic violence call after a woman reported that Kevin Blevins threatened to kill her and himself. She removed one firearm from him but said he still had access to several others before escaping and calling 911 from nearby woods. Deputies confronted Blevins as he exited his home carrying a loaded Glock 30 .45 caliber handgun. Despite repeated commands to drop the weapon, authorities said he attempted to shoot a deputy. Deputies fired six rounds, striking Blevins five times. No deputies or assisting officers were injured. The incident remains under investigation.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Armed suspect killed by Charlotte County deputy on Barker Avenue
description: Charlotte County Sheriff's Office deputies responded to a report of an armed man at a residence on Barker Avenue after people inside safely escaped the home. According to investigators, the suspect exited the residence carrying a firearm and refused repeated commands to drop the weapon. A deputy then fired at the suspect. Deputies immediately provided CPR, but the man died at the scene. Neighbors reported hearing several gunshots and seeing a woman flee the area before law enforcement arrived. Authorities secured the neighborhood while investigators processed the scene. The incident stemmed from a reported domestic situation and remained under investigation.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Okeechobee County shooting leaves suspect dead; deputies unharmed
description: Okeechobee County deputies responded to an armed individual incident in the Four Seasons area on Northeast Eighth Avenue. A responding sergeant requested assistance from the Sheriff’s Office Crisis Negotiation Team to help safely resolve the situation. Deputies later encountered an armed person behind the property and issued multiple commands to drop the firearm. According to the sheriff’s office, the individual did not comply and confronted deputies, leading two deputies to fire their weapons. The suspect was killed during the encounter. No deputies or other law enforcement personnel were injured. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: New video surfaces of deadly Clay County shooting; use of deadly force questioned
description: Clay County deputies responded to a home in Oakleaf Plantation while assisting the Department of Children and Families with an investigation. The encounter escalated when a man allegedly knocked down a fence and threw what appeared to be a knife. Deputies reported that the man was armed with two knives and had an out-of-state warrant. Officers issued commands for him to drop the weapon before gunfire occurred, resulting in his death. Neighbors questioned the use of deadly force, stating the man may have been experiencing a mental health crisis. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement and State Attorney’s Office are investigating.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Florida deputy kills man who drove into him after fatally shooting 2 people, sheriff says
description: Authorities said Charles McCloud Jr. allegedly began a violent crime spree in Pahokee by fatally shooting two people at one location. He then reportedly fired shots at another residence and wounded a man at a nearby convenience store. As a Palm Beach County Sheriff's deputy secured the second crime scene, McCloud allegedly drove his SUV into the deputy, dragging him about 40 feet. Investigators said McCloud exited the vehicle and attempted to shoot the injured deputy. The deputy returned fire, killing McCloud, while a second deputy also fired. The injured deputy was hospitalized with serious injuries. Multiple agencies are investigating.
Charges: None announced (suspect deceased)

Title: Police: 3 charged in NYE shooting for firing 30 rounds in midnight celebration, deputies say
description: On January 1, 2026, Volusia County deputies responded after reports of celebratory gunfire in a residential neighborhood in DeLand. Investigators said Axel Gomez fired more than 30 rounds during a New Year's celebration. At least five bullets struck a nearby occupied home, including one that traveled through a bedroom wall and landed beneath a pillow where two adults and their 7-year-old child were sleeping. No one was injured. Witnesses reported seeing Gomez firing while two others participated. Deputies arrested Gomez and charged two companions with reckless firearm discharge. Authorities said the group claimed they did not know their actions were illegal.
Charges: Shooting into an occupied dwelling (Axel Gomez)

Title: 26-year-old Medina woman arrested after man shot in the head
description: On May 10, 2026, Medina Police responded to a domestic disturbance call in the 200 block of Abbeville Road at approximately 9:33 p.m. Officers were informed that a person may have been shot. Upon arrival, they found a man suffering from an apparent gunshot wound to the head. Officers and bystanders provided medical assistance until paramedics arrived. The victim was transported by the Medina Life Support Team for treatment. Police secured the scene, arrested Faith Thrasher, and continued investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting. Detectives processed evidence and interviewed the suspect and witnesses.
Charges: Felonious assault

Title: Parma Heights woman accused of shooting man in chest, cutting ankle monitor, arrested again
description: North Olmsted, Ohio
Charges: Attempted murder, felonious assault, domestic violence, tampering with evidence

Title: Woman accused of breaking in, shooting at ex-husband as he slept
description: On April 26, 2026, Amanda Heller allegedly entered her ex-husband’s home in Williams County, Ohio, while armed with a firearm. According to authorities, she threatened to kill him while he was lying in bed and fired two rounds inside the residence. The incident was reported as a domestic violence-related shooting. Heller was later indicted on multiple charges connected to the alleged break-in and gunfire. The case involves allegations of attempted murder, burglary, domestic violence, and improper discharge of a weapon. No police-involved shooting occurred, and the investigation proceeded through the court system after charges were filed.
Charges: Attempted murder, burglary, domestic violence, improper discharge of a weapon

Title: Sheriff identifies 5 killed in Florida gated community, including suspected shooter
description: On February 10, 2026, deputies responded to a report of a shooting in the Amberlea neighborhood of Sarasota, Florida. Authorities found a man in the front yard receiving CPR from neighbors, but he was pronounced dead. Inside the home, deputies discovered four additional deceased individuals, including suspected shooter Russell Kot. Investigators determined Kot died from self-inflicted wounds. Authorities believe the incident was connected to a previous double homicide in Fort Lauderdale. The investigation remained active, with no confirmed motive released. Detectives reviewed vehicle records and surveillance footage as part of the ongoing investigation.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Woman arrested for felonious assault in connection to Warren shooting
description: Brianna Nichols was arrested in Warren, Ohio, after police responded to a reported shooting at a home on Highland Avenue SW. Authorities said she allegedly shot her boyfriend during a domestic dispute after stating he was coming after her. The victim suffered multiple gunshot wounds and was transported to a hospital for treatment. Police found a revolver near a vehicle in the garage. Nichols was booked into Trumbull County Jail on felonious assault charges. The investigation remained ongoing with Warren Police seeking additional information from witnesses. Neighbors reported frequent arguments at the residence before the incident occurred on Friday afternoon.
Charges: Felonious assault

Title: Brunswick Police arrest woman accused of attempted murder who cut off her ankle monitor
description: Michelle Farkas was arrested in connection with an attempted murder case involving a shooting in North Olmsted, Ohio. Police said the incident occurred at a home on Butternut Ridge Road, where officers found a man suffering from a gunshot wound to the chest. Witnesses reported hearing arguing, yelling, and gunshots before seeing Farkas near the injured man. Investigators said Farkas was previously released on bond for the case but later cut off her ankle monitor. Brunswick Police located and arrested her at a business after using surveillance cameras to find the suspect vehicle. She was charged with attempted murder and felonious assault.
Charges: Attempted murder and felonious assault

Title: Woman killed, another under arrest in Walnut Hills shooting
description: Jasmine Blake was arrested and charged with murder after a shooting in the Walnut Hills neighborhood of Cincinnati, Ohio. Police responded to a report of gunfire on May Street and found 33-year-old Diamond Rice suffering from a gunshot wound. Officers attempted life-saving measures, but Rice was pronounced dead at the scene. According to court records, investigators allege Blake used a handgun to shoot Rice during an argument. Blake was taken into custody and booked into the Hamilton County Justice Center without bond. The case remains under investigation based on crime scene evidence, witness statements, and 911 call information.
Charges: Murder

Title: Woman arrested after shooting on Wheeling St. Saturday night
description: Cecelia Ellis was arrested after a shooting on North Wheeling Street in Toledo, Ohio. Police responded shortly before midnight to reports of a person being shot. Officers arrived and found a 45-year-old man suffering from a gunshot wound to the stomach. Ellis, 30, was also at the scene and was taken into custody. According to court records, Ellis admitted to shooting the man in the abdomen. The victim was transported to St. Vincent’s Hospital for treatment. Ellis was charged in connection with the shooting, and the investigation was handled by Toledo police.
Charges: Felonious assault

Title: Police identify woman shot, killed at Avondale apartment complex
description: Jesse Wilson was arrested and charged with aggravated murder after a fatal shooting at an apartment complex in Avondale, Cincinnati, Ohio. Police responded to the 700 block of Ridgeway Avenue around 6:30 a.m. and found a woman suffering from a gunshot wound. Cincinnati fire personnel arrived and pronounced the victim dead at the scene. The victim was identified as 36-year-old Jessica Hardy. Later that day, police announced that Wilson, 65, had been arrested in connection with the shooting. The investigation was handled by Cincinnati police, and the suspect faces aggravated murder charges in the death of Hardy.
Charges: Aggravated murder

Title: Woman shot in Ohio during alleged domestic dispute, husband arrested
description: Danny J. Mosley was arrested after a domestic-related shooting in the Fairfield Beach area of Thornville, Ohio. Deputies responded to a 911 call reporting that a man had shot his wife. Officers from the Fairfield County Sheriff’s Office and the Ohio Department of Natural Resources arrived at a residence on Hawthorn Road and found an adult woman in the front yard with a gunshot wound. The victim was transported to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Mosley was taken into custody at the scene without incident. Investigators continued reviewing the case for possible additional charges.
Charges: Danny J. Mosley was arrested after a domestic-related shooting in the Fairfield Beach area of Thornville, Ohio. Deputies responded to a 911 call reporting that a man had shot his wife. Officers from the Fairfield County Sheriff’s Office and the Ohio Department of Natural Resources arrived at a residence on Hawthorn Road and found an adult woman in the front yard with a gunshot wound. The victim was transported to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Mosley was taken into custody at the scene without incident. Investigators continued reviewing the case for possible additional charges.

Title: Mother admitted to shooting her 12-year-old son in the head, authorities say
description: Briasha Stroud pleaded guilty to attempted murder after authorities said she shot her 12-year-old son in the head at a home in Deer Park, Cincinnati, Ohio. The shooting occurred on January 26, 2025, after police received a 911 call reporting that a woman had shot her son and was overdosing. Officers arrived and found Stroud and the child suffering from gunshot wounds inside a garage. The child survived but suffered catastrophic, life-changing injuries, according to prosecutors. Stroud was indicted on attempted murder and felonious assault charges and remains in custody awaiting sentencing.
Charges: Attempted murder and two counts of felonious assault

Title: Ohio man charged with homicide in wife's shooting death, police say
description: Caleb Flynn, a 39-year-old man, was arrested after an investigation into the shooting death of his wife, Ashley Flynn, in Tipp City, Ohio. Police responded to the couple’s home after a report of a burglary in progress involving a person who had been shot. Ashley Flynn, 37, was found with gunshot wounds and pronounced dead at the scene. Investigators initially believed the incident involved an intruder, but after a weeklong investigation, authorities determined probable cause existed to charge Caleb Flynn. Multiple agencies assisted in the investigation, including the FBI and Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation.
Charges: Homicide, two counts of felonious assault, two counts of tampering with evidence

Title: Records: Woman shoots man after attempting to hit him with car in University District Kroger parking lot
description: Teanya Swanson was charged after a shooting in the parking lot of a Kroger store in Columbus, Ohio. Police said Swanson nearly struck a man with her vehicle during an altercation in the University District parking lot. Witnesses reported the man fired a gun at Swanson’s vehicle as it left the area. The man was later found with a gunshot wound to the upper body and was hospitalized in stable condition. Court records stated the dispute involved a breakup attempt and continued confrontation. Swanson was arrested at her home and admitted pointing a firearm at the victim.
Charges: Felonious assault

Title: Downtown Pensacola shooting suspect denied bond; surveillance video shows moments before and during the shooting
description: Nicholas Safford, 26, was charged with attempted first-degree premeditated murder following a July 5 shooting in downtown Pensacola that left 19-year-old Phillip Sheppard Jr. dead and six others injured, including Safford. Investigators said an argument involving girls and references to deceased or imprisoned gang members escalated into violence. Surveillance video allegedly shows Safford receiving a firearm from a 16-year-old, raising it toward a crowd, and triggering an exchange of gunfire. Authorities later recovered the firearm after Safford's girlfriend surrendered it to police. Investigators determined Safford did not fire the fatal shot that killed Sheppard. He was denied bond.
Charges: Attempted first-degree premeditated murder

Title: ***Update - State Attorney's Office Releases Results of Investigation into Officer-Involved Shooting; Shooting Justified***Detectives Investigate Pinellas Park Police Department Officer Involved Shooting (26-029)
description: On March 31, 2026, Pinellas Park Police officers responded to reports that Ryan Lecompte had threatened a person with a rifle. Officers attempted to communicate with him, but he remained barricaded inside his residence. A SWAT team was deployed after hours of unsuccessful negotiations. During the operation, a drone observed Lecompte holding and raising a loaded Mossberg 500 20-gauge shotgun toward officers. Corporal Wesley Ducheney and Officer Ryan Poletz fired four rounds, striking Lecompte. He was transported to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The State Attorney later determined the officers' use of deadly force was legally justified.
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer

Title: ‘Selected randomly’: Gunman killed lumber store employee, shot 2 Gainesville officers, chief says
description: On January 14, 2026, Justin Dewayne Long entered Imeca Lumber & Hardware in Gainesville and fatally shot employee Eduardo Pardo Rodriguez, who police said appeared to have been randomly selected. Gainesville Police officers responded quickly after reports of gunfire and located Long attempting to flee in a vehicle. As officers tried to stop him, Long exited the vehicle and opened fire, wounding Sgt. Rob Kennedy and Officer Jessie Herringshaw. Additional officers arrived and returned fire, striking Long. He was transported to UF Health Shands, where he died from his injuries. Both wounded officers were treated and later released from the hospital.
Charges: Murder (fatal shooting of Eduardo Pardo Rodriguez)

Title: Armed suspect killed by deputies after fatal shooting in Port Charlotte
description: Matthew Ryan Cross was identified as the suspect in a fatal shooting that began on Malone Avenue in Port Charlotte on March 30, 2026. One victim was shot and killed at the initial scene before Cross fled, prompting a large manhunt involving the Charlotte County Sheriff's Office and North Port Police. Deputies later located him near Kenilworth Boulevard after reports of gunfire. Authorities said Cross pointed a gun at his own head and then aimed it at officers. Multiple officers fired, killing him. The investigation included several active crime scenes, temporary school lockdowns, and continued review of the officers' actions.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Police identify man killed in Panama City shooting; suspect could face additional charges
description: Preston Roulhac was accused of fatally shooting 23-year-old Lucas Daughtry inside a residence on West 21st Street in Panama City during a domestic dispute involving his former girlfriend. Police said Roulhac used an AK-47 to shoot the victim multiple times and also attempted to shoot his ex-girlfriend as she escaped. After fleeing in a vehicle, he led law enforcement on a pursuit before crashing his car into a ditch. He then fled on foot into a wooded area but was captured after an extensive manhunt. He was arrested and booked into the Bay County Jail without bond.
Charges: Murder while engaged in burglary Attempted murder Fleeing and eluding police Additional charges possible

Title: Manhunt for suspect in fatal shooting leads to delay in opening gates at Players Championship
description: Christian Barrios, 32, was identified as the suspect in a double fatal shooting near TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. Authorities said Barrios shot two people multiple times in a Walgreens parking lot during what was described as a domestic violence situation. After the shooting, he fled onto the TPC Sawgrass property, causing a delay in opening gates for The Players Championship as law enforcement searched the area. Barrios later stole a vehicle, led authorities on a pursuit, crashed in Nassau County, and fled on foot before being captured. Both victims were transported to a hospital, where they died.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Employee arrested in shooting that injured father and 11-year-old daughter at Florida McDonald's
description: Ralph N-Kosi Blue III, 18, was arrested in connection with a shooting outside a McDonald’s in Hallandale Beach, Florida. Police said Blue, an employee at the restaurant, allegedly opened fire during a dispute with individuals who confronted him when he arrived for work. The shooting injured a father and his 11-year-old daughter, who were innocent bystanders sitting in a parked vehicle. Two younger children inside the vehicle were not injured. Blue was taken into custody at a Broward County home and faces multiple charges. Police said the investigation remains ongoing to identify any additional people involved.
Charges: Two counts of aggravated battery Two counts of aggravated assault

Title: ‘Armed and dangerous’ Perry shooting suspect turned himself in, police say
description: Ulysses Woodfaulk Jr., 48, was arrested in connection with a deadly shooting at Choo Choos Convenience in Perry, Florida. Police said Woodfaulk was wanted for first-degree murder after allegedly shooting Austin Wilkinson during an argument that escalated between Woodfaulk, Wilkinson, and another person. Authorities said Woodfaulk left the scene with a handgun after the shooting. After a search and investigation, detectives contacted people close to Woodfaulk and encouraged him to surrender. He later met with a detective at the jail and turned himself in. Police noted Woodfaulk had a prior violent history, including battery on law enforcement.
Charges: First-degree murder

Title: Suspect in Riviera Beach mass shooting: voices told me to kill demons
description: Terrell Gibson, 20, was identified as the suspect in a mass shooting in Riviera Beach, Florida. Police said the shooting began inside the Azure Estates community, where Gibson allegedly opened fire after claiming he was hearing voices telling him to kill people. Investigators said Gibson shot multiple victims, killing one person and injuring four others. Police said he later attempted to flee, shot additional victims during an attempted vehicle theft, and successfully took an SUV before leaving the area. Gibson was arrested in St. Lucie County and is being held without bond while facing multiple serious charges.
Charges: First-degree murder Attempted first-degree murder Additional charges related to shooting and carjacking

Title: Police identify man armed with knife who was shot, killed by West Chester officer
description: On June 4, 2026, West Chester police responded to an apartment complex on Zinnia Court after a report of a woman screaming for help. Officers entered the apartment due to safety concerns and encountered Lorenzo Miller, who was reportedly holding a knife to the woman’s neck. During the encounter, an officer fired one shot, striking Miller. Officers and first responders provided CPR, but Miller died at the scene. Police later identified him as 39 years old. The woman was rescued and taken to a hospital. The investigation was transferred to state investigators.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: BWC: Man shoots at Ohio deputy during traffic stop, flees in vehicle before continuing to shoot at cops
description: On March 30, 2026, a man was involved in multiple shootings with law enforcement in Harrison County, Ohio. The incident began during a traffic stop when the suspect pulled a firearm and shot at a deputy, who was not injured. The suspect fled in a vehicle and later exchanged gunfire with pursuing officers before escaping into woods. After a multi-agency manhunt, authorities located him in Green Township. During an attempted arrest, the suspect ignored commands and displayed a firearm, leading officers to shoot him. The suspect died from his injuries. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is investigating.
Charges: Attempted first-degree murder

Title: Police officers cleared of wrongdoing in 2 separate shootings in Butler County
description: On April 17, 2026, Middletown police officers attempted to arrest 22-year-old Donald Madden near Charles Street and Columbia Avenue due to multiple outstanding warrants. The warrants were connected to an earlier incident where Madden allegedly pointed a gun at officers and fled. During the arrest attempt, police said Madden fired at officers, who returned fire and struck him. Madden was taken into custody, and no officers were injured. The Butler County Prosecutor’s Office reviewed the incident, and a grand jury declined to indict the officers involved. Officials determined the officers’ actions were legally justified.
Charges: Outstanding warrants related to alleged gun-related offenses (specific charges not provided)

Title: Sweetwater police shoot, kill man armed with knife after 911 call about "domestic altercation" with pregnant wife, police say
description: Sweetwater police officers responded to a 911 call reporting a domestic altercation at a residence on SW 7th Terrace. When officers arrived, they found a woman and a man who was armed with a knife. Police said the man was involved in a confrontation with officers, which resulted in officers firing their weapons. The man was struck and pronounced dead at the scene. The victim’s wife, who was five months pregnant, was reportedly injured and taken to a hospital. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is leading the investigation into the police shooting, with additional review by Miami-Dade authorities.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: A man carrying a knife was shot by 3 rookie JSO officers. It was their first night on the job without a veteran officer
description: Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office officers responded to a domestic disturbance call involving Jose Cabrera, 62, in the Dinsmore area. Police said Cabrera had threatened his wife and later went to a family member’s home on Fox Tail Lane. Officers found him sitting in his vehicle and asked him to exit. According to police, Cabrera grabbed a knife and aggressively approached officers while making statements that they would have to shoot him. Three JSO officers fired their weapons, striking Cabrera. He was taken into custody and transported to a hospital, where he later died. The State Attorney’s Office is investigating.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Man, 54, in stable condition after hurt in Orange City officer shooting outside bank
description: Michael Alan Smith, 54, was involved in an officer-involved shooting outside a Truist Bank in Orange City, Florida. Police responded after reports of a bleeding man who witnesses said was stabbing himself and carrying a weapon. During the encounter, officers gave Smith commands and attempted to de-escalate the situation. Authorities said Smith ignored commands, later pulled out a firearm, and entered the bank area where employees and customers were present. An Orange City police officer fired at Smith, striking and injuring him. Smith was transported to a hospital and was reported to be in stable condition. The FDLE is investigating.
Charges: assualting an officer

Title: ‘I should have killed you': Man ambushes, stabs Fla. deputy multiple times
description: A Marion County deputy responded to a suspicious person call in Dunnellon, Florida, on May 13, 2026. When the deputy exited his cruiser, the suspect allegedly attacked him with a knife and stabbed him multiple times in the chest. The deputy’s ballistic vest protected him from serious injury. Other deputies arrived and arrested the suspect without further incident. The suspect later made threatening statements while in custody. The deputy suffered minor injuries and survived. The suspect was charged with attempted murder of a law enforcement officer, providing a false name to law enforcement, and resisting without violence.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer; providing a false name to law enforcement; resisting without violence

Title: ‘My mom is dead': Woman armed with knife during crisis fatally shot by deputy in NW Miami-Dade
description: Deputies from the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office responded to a crisis call at Northwest 55th Avenue and Northwest 190th Street involving a woman harming herself with a knife. Deputies attempted to communicate and de-escalate the situation. During the encounter, the woman was armed with a knife and had multiple self-inflicted injuries. Authorities stated she was tased and a deputy fired a service weapon, striking her. Karen Ivette Gomez was transported to a hospital by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue, where she died from her injuries. No deputies were injured. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement investigated the deputy-involved shooting.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Man shot by Osceola County deputy, sheriff’s office says
description: Deputies responded to Marcos Circle after family members called 911 regarding Nicholas Doyley, who was experiencing a mental health crisis. Deputies were informed that Doyley may have been armed, but authorities had not confirmed whether he had a weapon at the time of the incident. The sheriff’s office stated the situation rapidly developed into an altercation shortly after deputies arrived. Shots were fired during the confrontation, and Doyley was transported by air to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. No deputies or other individuals were injured. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement investigated the deputy-involved shooting. Doyley was later charged.
Charges: Battery on a law enforcement officer; resisting an officer

Title: Suspect shot by Hillsborough deputy after firing at least 3 bullets into patrol car: HCSO
description: Deputies responded to a domestic incident at a home off Manor Cove Circle in Riverview. Authorities said Antonio Jelks fled the residence after firing a gunshot inside the home, where no one was injured. When deputies arrived, Jelks allegedly approached in a vehicle, exited, and fired at their patrol car, striking it with at least three bullets. Deputy Cole Eskein returned fire, hitting Jelks, who then ran into a subdivision. Deputies later found him on a porch with a firearm and magazine. Jelks was transported to Tampa General Hospital in stable condition. The investigation involved the Florida Department of Law Enforcement.
Charges: Two counts of attempted murder of a law enforcement officer; additional felony charges pending

Title: Seneca County Sheriff's Office releases portion of body cam from deputies' fatal shooting of man
description: Jeffrey R. Sergent, 43, was fatally shot by law enforcement deputies during an attempted arrest in Seneca County, Ohio. Deputies and a Bloomville police officer were attempting to take him into custody when authorities said Sergent reversed his vehicle into a guardrail and then drove toward officers, creating a threat. Officers fired their weapons, striking Sergent. The Seneca County Sheriff's Office released body camera footage and stated the shooting occurred after officers believed their lives were in danger. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is handling the investigation into the deputy-involved shooting.
Charges: Arrest attempt related to outstanding criminal history; prior charges included escape, assault, resisting arrest, failure to comply, vandalism, and assault of a police officer

Title: Ohio man in custody after Warren County pursuit ends in officer-involved shooting
description: A 36-year-old man from Trenton, Ohio, was taken into custody after an officer-involved shooting following a police pursuit in Warren County. Deputies responded to a suspicious U-Haul box truck reportedly containing an AR-15-style rifle. When deputies attempted a traffic stop, the vehicle fled and the suspect allegedly fired multiple rounds at law enforcement during the pursuit. Deputies deployed spike strips, stopping the vehicle on Highway 47. The suspect exited with the rifle and allegedly refused commands to drop the weapon before firing at deputies. Officers returned fire, striking the suspect, who was transported to a hospital.
Charges: assualting an officer

Title: Man fatally shot by officer after sexual assault reported in Pickaway County
description: A man was fatally shot by a law enforcement officer on January 20, 2026, in Ashville, Pickaway County. Deputies from the Pickaway County Sheriff’s Office, along with officers from Ashville and South Bloomfield Police, responded to a reported sexual assault in progress at the Ashville Country Estates mobile home park. Officers made contact with the man at a residence on Duvall Road, where a shooting occurred. The man was injured, taken to a Columbus-area hospital, and later pronounced dead. A juvenile victim was treated for non-life-threatening injuries. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is investigating.
Charges: Alleged sexual assault

Title: 2 police officers fatally shoot man while responding to domestic violence call in Columbus
description: Isawan Foster, 33, was fatally shot by two Columbus Division of Police officers while officers responded to a domestic violence call in Columbus, Ohio. Police were called to the 800 block of Wilson Avenue near East Livingston Avenue after reports that a man assaulted a female and said he was going to get a firearm. When officers arrived, they heard multiple gunshots and saw Foster discharging a firearm. Two officers fired their weapons, striking Foster. Officers provided medical aid before he was taken to Grant Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is investigating.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Suspect arrested in shooting that injured 2 at The Standard Restaurant in Boca Raton
description: On May 25, 2026, a shooting occurred at The Standard Restaurant in Boca Raton, Florida. Police said Christian J. Ippolito was involved in an argument with another person before firing two shots toward a victim. Two people were injured, including one with a leg wound and another with a chest gunshot wound who was hospitalized in critical but stable condition. Surveillance footage showed Ippolito leaving the scene, returning briefly to retrieve his eyeglasses, and later driving away. Investigators identified him through video evidence and witness statements. He was arrested on June 3, 2026.
Charges: Two counts of attempted second-degree murder with a firearm; one count of shooting into a dwelling

Title: Off-duty Cleveland Police officer involved in deadly shooting in Glenville neighborhood
description: An off-duty Cleveland police officer was involved in a deadly shooting at an apartment complex in Cleveland’s Glenville neighborhood on May 20, 2026. Police said a group of people were arguing at the Park Place Apartments when the situation escalated and multiple gunshots were fired. The 26-year-old man suffered gunshot wounds and was taken to University Hospitals, where he was pronounced dead. Investigators found a firearm believed to belong to the victim. The Cuyahoga County Sheriff’s Office is investigating, and police said multiple individuals, including the off-duty officer, fired shots.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Police identify man shot by officer in downtown Dayton
description: Reginald Thomas was fatally shot by a Dayton Police officer during an encounter in downtown Dayton, Ohio. The officer stopped Thomas while he was riding a bicycle near North St. Clair and East Third streets because he was reportedly riding on the sidewalk and did not have a bike light. During the interaction, Thomas ran from the officer. Police said Thomas took out a firearm during the chase, and a struggle followed. Authorities said Thomas moved toward the dropped handgun during another struggle, leading the officer to fire one shot. Thomas was taken to a hospital, where he died.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Man dies after being shot by Cleveland police officer during domestic violence call
description: Charles Motley Jr., 33, died after being shot by a Cleveland Police officer during a domestic violence-related incident in Cleveland, Ohio. Police responded to the 16500 block of Lipton Avenue after receiving reports that Motley had a firearm and was threatening “suicide by cop.” Officers found Motley inside a vehicle outside the home. Authorities said he exited the vehicle and raised a shotgun toward officers after repeated commands to drop the weapon. One officer fired and struck Motley. Officers provided first aid before Cleveland EMS transported him to University Hospital, where he later died from his injuries.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Hospital police officer fatally shoots person at St. Charles Hospital in Oregon
description: Christian Strassburg, 35, was fatally shot by a Mercy Health Police Department officer during an incident at St. Charles Hospital in Oregon, Ohio. Authorities said the officer discharged their weapon during a police intervention in the hospital parking lot. Oregon Police Department responded to reports of an active shooter but found that a hospital police officer had already fired their weapon. The Lucas County Coroner ruled Strassburg’s death a homicide and said he died from multiple gunshot wounds. The circumstances leading to the shooting have not been released, and the Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is investigating.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Deadly Rittman shooting: What we know about the suspect
description: On July 5, 2026, police officers responded to a 911 call reporting a break-in and gunshots at a home in Rittman, Ohio. Upon arrival, officers came under immediate gunfire. Rittman Police Sergeant Scott Ries, a 54-year-old officer with 10 years of service, was fatally shot. The suspect and two other people also died during the incident. Four additional officers and a police dog were injured. Authorities said the suspect’s former partner and her child were among those killed. The investigation is ongoing, and officials have not released the suspect’s identity or circumstances of death.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Clermont County officers involved in fatal shooting in Pierce Township
description: An armed male suspect was fatally shot by law enforcement officers in Pierce Township, Ohio, while deputies responded to a report of an intoxicated and suicidal person with a firearm. Clermont County Sheriff's Office deputies and Pierce Township Police officers arrived at the Eastgate Mobile Home Park on State Route 125. Authorities said the suspect refused repeated commands to drop his weapon. Two officers then discharged their firearms, striking the suspect. Emergency medical personnel transported him by helicopter to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead shortly after arrival. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is investigating.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: 1 of 2 suspects in deadly Canton shooting arrested
description: On July 14, 2026, Canton Police responded to a 911 call reporting a man’s body in a parking lot in the 900 block of Alan Page Drive SE. Officers and paramedics found 19-year-old Jordan A. Horton suffering from a gunshot wound to the lower back. Police identified two suspects connected to the shooting. Jason L. Singletary, 25, was arrested and charged in connection with the death. Savheon R. Monroe, 16, remained wanted by police. Authorities charged the suspects with offenses including complicity to commit murder, felonious assault, and firearm-related violations. The investigation remained ongoing.
Charges: Complicity to commit murder Felonious assault Discharge of a firearm on or near a prohibited premises

Title: Man found shot to death in Drew Park off Barnes Road South near University Boulevard, JSO says
description: On July 16, 2026, the Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office investigated a fatal shooting after a man was found dead in Drew Park near Barnes Road South and University Boulevard. Officers responded around 1:30 a.m. after a passerby reported finding a person in the park. Police located a man believed to be in his 20s suffering from gunshot wounds. He was pronounced dead at the scene. Investigators recovered shell casings and other evidence from the area. Detectives were conducting interviews with witnesses and searching for surveillance footage that could provide information about the circumstances surrounding the shooting. The victim’s identity was not released.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Man fatally shot in Walmart parking lot following dispute over parking space: Authorities
description: On June 30, 2026, a man was fatally shot in the parking lot of a Walmart in North Lauderdale, Florida, following a dispute over a parking space. According to the Broward County Sheriff’s Office, an adult female and the victim, identified as 62-year-old Bart Diguglielmo, were involved in a verbal altercation before the shooting. Investigators said the woman remained at the scene, cooperated with detectives, and claimed she acted in self-defense. Diguglielmo was transported to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The case was under investigation and would be reviewed for possible criminal charges.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Man with prior arrests shot after allegedly pointing air gun at PBSO deputies
description: On July 15, 2026, Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office deputies responded to a welfare check request at a residence near Delray Beach. Deputies said Alexander Bucspun, 23, acted erratically and allegedly pointed what appeared to be a rifle at three deputies and another person. A deputy fired, striking Bucspun, who was taken into custody and transported to Delray Medical Center. Investigators later determined the weapon was a black, long-barreled air gun that resembled a real firearm. Bucspun was arrested and charged with multiple counts of aggravated assault. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement investigated the officer-involved shooting.
Charges: Three counts of aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer One count of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon

Title: 2 Gainesville officers shot in 'ambush-style attack,' suspect dead, police say
description: Two Gainesville police officers were shot and wounded on January 14, 2026, after responding to a reported shooting near Waldo Road and East University Avenue. Police said the suspect, Justin D. Long, was attempting to leave the area in a red vehicle when officers followed him. The suspect stopped and opened fire on the officers in an ambush-style attack. Officers returned fire, killing Long. A man identified as Eduardo P. Rodriguez was also found dead from gunshot wounds at a nearby lumberyard connected to the investigation.
Charges: Not applicable (suspect died during the shooting)

Title: 2 Florida deputies airlifted after shooting
description: Two Hillsborough County deputies were shot on July 16, 2026, during an incident on West Shell Point Road in Ruskin, Florida. The deputies were airlifted to Tampa General Hospital for treatment after being wounded. The suspect was also shot during the incident and was transported to a hospital. The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office reported that law enforcement was on the scene and that there was no threat to public safety at the time of the report. Additional details about the suspect, motive, charges, and circumstances of the shooting were not released.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer

Title: Suspect charged with murder after man fatally shot in Hollywood, police say
description: A fatal shooting occurred in Hollywood after an altercation between two men, according to police. Officers responded around 12:52 a.m. to the 1900 block of Funston Street after reports of gunfire. Police found Jaydon Williams, 21, inside a home suffering from a gunshot wound. He was provided first aid and transported to Memorial Regional Hospital, where he later died. Investigators determined that Williams and Devian Blount had traveled from North Carolina to Hollywood with a group of friends. During the night, an argument occurred, and Williams was fatally shot. Blount was later located and arrested.
Charges: First-degree murder with a firearm

Title: Man shot by officer in Miami after becoming aggressive during argument, police say
description: Officers responded to a reported argument at the Eve Hotel on Biscayne Boulevard in downtown Miami. Police said the situation escalated when the suspect became aggressive toward officers. Officers attempted to control the suspect by deploying a taser and using pepper spray. During the confrontation, an officer fired a weapon at the suspect. The suspect suffered injuries described as non-life-threatening. One officer was also injured and transported to Jackson Memorial Hospital. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is handling the investigation, which is standard procedure for police-involved shootings.
Charges: assualting an officer

Title: Gainesville Police officers wounded in ambush while stopping shooting suspect: Chief
description: Gainesville Police officers responded to reports of shots fired at a business district near a lumber yard. Police said the suspect had fatally shot a person at the lumber yard and was attempting to leave the area when officers confronted him. The suspect ambushed the responding officers, leading to an exchange of gunfire. Officers shot and killed the suspect. Two officers were wounded, one in the arm and one in the leg, but their injuries were not considered life-threatening. Authorities continued investigating the motive behind the initial fatal shooting.
Charges: No charges filed (suspect deceased)

Title: Broward deputies fatally shoot man with machete; mom says ‘they could've tased him'
description: Broward Sheriff's Office deputies responded to a report of a suspicious person armed with a machete in the 300 block of Northeast 38th Street. Deputies encountered Deavon McGauley, who police said attacked them with the machete. Authorities said deputies gave commands for him to drop the weapon, but he continued the confrontation, leading deputies to open fire. McGauley was taken to a local hospital, where he died from his injuries. No deputies were injured. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the deputy-involved shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Video released from body cam that stopped bullet, saved Florida deputy’s life
description: A Volusia County deputy was shot while responding to a battery call in Deltona. According to the sheriff’s office, Deputy Jose Rivera and a newly graduated academy deputy attempted to speak with a suspect at a residence when the suspect engaged Rivera in a close-range gunfight. Body camera footage showed the suspect firing at the deputy, with one bullet striking Rivera’s body camera and preventing a more serious injury. The incident involved an armed confrontation between law enforcement and the suspect. Authorities released the video as part of the investigation into the deputy-involved shooting.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer

Title: Columbus Police officer shot, suspect killed in incident in Linden neighborhood
description: On April 29, 2026, Columbus Police officers attempted a traffic stop near Hamilton and Minnesota avenues in the Linden neighborhood. The driver failed to stop and fled. Officers later located the vehicle and the suspect nearby. When officers approached, the suspect allegedly opened fire, striking one officer twice in the legs. Police returned fire and struck the suspect. The suspect was taken to Grant Medical Center, where he later died. The injured officer underwent surgery and was expected to recover. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is leading the investigation into the shooting.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Cleveland officer shot, others hurt after suspect fires at police
description: On May 23, 2026, Cleveland Police officers responded to a shooting call involving a 33-year-old man at 5222 Fleet Avenue. During the investigation, officers identified a vehicle connected to a possible suspect. Police said the 24-year-old suspect fired at officers multiple times before fleeing. Officers located the vehicle and initiated a pursuit. The suspect allegedly continued shooting, striking police vehicles. One officer fired at the suspect. The pursuit ended when the suspect crashed into a building on Chagrin Boulevard and attempted to flee on foot. Police captured the suspect, who was not injured.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer

Title: Parents of teen killed in Toledo shooting speak out
description: On July 13, 2026, Toledo Police responded to a shooting at a vigil held at Weiler Homes. According to police, an individual attempted to rob someone in the crowd, leading a member of the group to draw a weapon. Both individuals exchanged gunfire, and 17-year-old Zayona Jackson was struck in the crossfire. Jackson was transported to St. Vincent’s Hospital, where she died from a gunshot wound to the chest. Police arrested 23-year-old Swayvone Morgan and charged him in connection with Jackson’s death. Investigators reported that Jackson was not the intended target.
Charges: First-degree murder with a firearm

Title: Columbus police video shows shootout where officer was struck, suspect was killed
description: On April 29, 2026, Columbus Police attempted a traffic stop near Hamilton and Minnesota avenues. The driver, identified as Chantez Loury, reportedly fled from officers. Police later located the vehicle and found Loury near East 16th and Hamilton avenues. Authorities said Loury opened fire on officers, striking one officer twice and causing severe blood loss from a femoral artery injury. Officers returned fire and fatally struck Loury. He was pronounced dead at the scene. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation reviewed the officer-involved shooting. The injured officer underwent emergency surgery and was expected to recover.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Man killed in New Carlisle road rage shooting identified, 2 suspects arrested
description: On July 15, 2026, the Clark County Sheriff’s Office responded to a reported road rage shooting near Ohio 235 and Gerlaugh Road in New Carlisle. Officers found 47-year-old Luke Hollifield suffering from a gunshot wound to the chest. Medical personnel attempted lifesaving measures, but Hollifield was pronounced dead at the scene. Investigators identified the suspect vehicle as an orange Jeep Renegade and used Flock cameras to track it. Dayton Police located and stopped the vehicle, arresting Semaj Mack. Damian Debose later turned himself in. Both suspects face murder charges.
Charges: murder with a firearm

Title: Man charged after argument led to fatal south Columbus shooting
description: Ricky Coleman, 47, was arrested and charged with murder following a fatal shooting in south Columbus. According to police, the incident occurred after an argument on the morning of July 11, 2026, in the 900 block of South 22nd Street in the Southern Orchards neighborhood. Officers responded around 9:50 a.m. and found 37-year-old Christopher Boyer suffering from a gunshot wound. Boyer was transported to a hospital in critical condition, where he died at approximately 11 a.m. Authorities issued a warrant for Coleman's arrest, and he was booked into the Franklin County Jail. An initial court appearance was pending.
Charges: Murder

Title: Pensacola police find shooting suspect dead during warrant service at apartment complex
description: Trevon Bradley, 20, was found dead by Pensacola police during an attempted warrant service at Truman Arms apartments in Pensacola, Florida. Officers, U.S. Marshals, and State Attorney’s Office personnel were serving a warrant related to a manslaughter case. Before officers entered the apartment, shots were heard from inside, and police confirmed no law enforcement officers fired their weapons. Bradley was found deceased inside the apartment and authorities said he died from an apparently self-inflicted gunshot wound. A female and child were inside the apartment but were safely removed. The investigation into the incident remains ongoing.
Charges: Manslaughter warrant

Title: Man fatally shot by Marion deputy after threatening them with firearm, sheriff's office says
description: James Cherry, 39, was fatally shot by a Marion County deputy during a domestic disturbance response on July 7, 2026. Deputies responded to a home on SW 35th Avenue Road after receiving a report of a disturbance. According to the sheriff’s office, Cherry allegedly threatened a deputy with a firearm during the encounter. The deputy fired shots to stop the threat and provided medical aid afterward. Cherry was transported to a hospital in critical condition but later died. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement was notified and is investigating the officer-involved shooting. No other individuals were reported injured in the incident.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Police: Delhi Township man arrested after shooting man during road rage dispute in Cleves
description: Robert Mason, a 68-year-old man from Delhi Township, was arrested after allegedly shooting another man during a road rage dispute in Cleves. According to police, the confrontation began after Mason nearly struck the victim with his vehicle as the victim crossed U.S. Route 50. The argument escalated, and Mason allegedly exited his vehicle and fired two rounds from a 9mm handgun, striking the victim in the hip with one bullet while the second missed. Police said Mason fled the scene and later attempted to hide the firearm before officers recovered it. He was arrested and formally charged.
Charges: Felonious assault (2 counts); Tampering with evidence

Title: 1 suspect at large, 7 arrested in connection with fatal shooting during Franklin County burglary
description: Roger Daugherty, 44, was arrested in connection with the fatal shooting of 72-year-old Harold Moore during a burglary in Prairie Township, Ohio. Deputies discovered Moore dead inside his residence on February 8, 2026, with a gunshot wound to the head. Investigators determined that several valuable items, including the victim's vehicle, had been stolen. The following day, deputies located the stolen vehicle on West Broad Street in Columbus and detained Daugherty. According to court documents, he admitted to shooting Moore, stealing property from the residence, and disposing of the firearm in the Scioto River. The investigation later led to additional arrests.
Charges: Murder; Burglary; Theft (property stolen from the residence)

Title: Florida man caught on video shooting fireworks from moving car on I-95, deputies say
description: A passenger in a vehicle was arrested after allegedly shooting fireworks from a moving car on Interstate 95 near St. Augustine, Florida, during the Fourth of July holiday. The St. John’s County Sheriff’s Office said helicopter footage showed fireworks being launched from the vehicle, with some landing in the median and traffic lanes. Deputies stopped the vehicle, and occupants initially denied involvement. After being shown evidence, authorities arrested the passenger responsible for allegedly firing the fireworks. Officials warned that fireworks should only be used safely and away from people, vehicles, and other hazards.
Charges: Shooting a Deadly Missile from a Moving Vehicle

Title: Florida man held in jail after allegedly shooting at fence, hurting neighbor, deputies say
description: Terrance Hawkins, a 40-year-old Orlando man, was arrested after deputies said he fired shots at a neighbor’s residential fence, causing debris to strike and injure another person. The incident occurred on Oak Grove Chase Drive in Orange County on June 21, 2026. Deputies responded to a shots-fired call shortly before 3 p.m. and determined that Hawkins had allegedly fired into a fence panel. The injured neighbor was transported to a hospital for treatment. Authorities arrested Hawkins at the scene, and he was booked into the Orange County Jail on multiple felony charges related to the shooting.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a firearm Shooting/throwing a missile into a dwelling or structure Aggravated battery with a firearm

Title: Florida man charged with murder in shooting after livestreaming crime scene on Facebook: deputies
description: Gedeonson Hyacinthe was arrested in Lee County, Florida, after investigators said he shot and killed a man during an altercation in April 2025. Deputies responded to Palm Drive in the Pine Minor community after receiving reports of a shooting and found Hyacinthe standing over the victim. Authorities said Hyacinthe admitted there had been a physical confrontation before the shooting. Investigators later determined that he livestreamed the active crime scene on Facebook while describing the incident to viewers. After further investigation, detectives obtained an arrest warrant, and Hyacinthe was taken into custody without incident on July 15, 2026.
Charges: Second-degree murder Two counts of possession of a controlled substance

Title: Florida man arrested after allegedly shooting at sheriff's office first responder drone
description: Elvin Antonio Callejas-Serrato was arrested in Lehigh Acres, Florida, after deputies said he fired at a sheriff’s office drone responding to an active incident. The Lee County Sheriff’s Office reported that its Drone As First Responder program was deployed on Todd Avenue S to assist deputies. During surveillance, the drone operator allegedly observed individuals carrying what appeared to be firearms. Authorities said Callejas-Serrato pointed a weapon at the drone and fired two rounds. Deputies detained the group and recovered a BB rifle loaded with steel projectiles. Officials stated the drone program helps improve response times and officer safety during emergencies.
Charges: Shooting or throwing deadly missiles into an aircraft

Title: Mother of man accused of killing Fort Pierce teacher arrested in connection to murder
description: Karen Moye was arrested in connection with the investigation into the fatal shooting of her brother, Andre Leonard Barnes, a 66-year-old Fort Pierce teacher. The St. Lucie County Sheriff’s Office accused Moye of providing false information to detectives during the homicide investigation. Authorities said digital evidence and video footage showed Moye was present at the Essex Drive home when Barnes was shot on July 7, 2026. Investigators said her son, Dale Andrew Mincey, is accused of killing Barnes with an AR-style rifle and faces a first-degree murder charge. Moye’s alleged actions reportedly interfered with the homicide investigation.
Charges: Providing false information during a homicide investigation

Title: Verbal altercation escalates into deadly shooting in Orlando, police say
description: Second-degree murder with a firearm
Charges: Second-degree murder with a firearm

Title: Man killed, grandson arrested after family dispute leads to quadruple shooting in PBC
description: Thomas Faferko-Schmedes, 29, was arrested after a family dispute led to a quadruple shooting at a home near Royal Palm Beach in Palm Beach County, Florida. Deputies responded to Coconut Boulevard after reports of gunfire and found four people injured, including Faferko-Schmedes’ grandfather, who later died from a gunshot wound. Authorities said three other victims, including family members and an acquaintance, were hospitalized with injuries. Investigators alleged Faferko-Schmedes opened fire during an argument and later found him outside the home holding a shotgun. He surrendered after following deputies’ commands and was taken into custody without incident.
Charges: First-degree premeditated murder Three counts of attempted first-degree murder

Title: Police arrest suspect in deadly Boca Raton parking lot shooting from April
description: Willie Byrd Jr. was arrested in connection with a deadly parking lot shooting in Boca Raton, Florida. Police said Byrd allegedly killed Arman Motiwalla, 37, on April 8, 2026. Motiwalla was found dead around 1:45 a.m. at a parking lot on Camino Gardens Boulevard with multiple gunshot wounds. The Boca Raton Police Services Department conducted an extensive investigation and obtained an arrest warrant before taking Byrd into custody. Authorities booked Byrd into the Palm Beach County Jail. The case remains under investigation, and police requested information from anyone who may have details related to the shooting.
Charges: First-degree murder with a firearm

Title: Florida man arrested for 'cold-blooded' triple murder of tourists in random shooting
description: Ahmad Jihad Bojeh, 29, was arrested after authorities accused him of carrying out a triple homicide in the Indian Point subdivision near Kissimmee, Florida. Deputies responded to a shooting report and found three vacationing men, Douglas Kraft, Robert Kraft, and James Puchon, dead from apparent gunshot wounds outside a home. Investigators said the victims were tourists renting the residence and that the attack appeared random and unprovoked. Deputies located Bojeh at a neighboring house and took him into custody. Authorities charged him with three counts of murder, and the investigation into the shooting remains active.
Charges: Three counts of murder

Title: BWC: Suspect ambushes, wounds 2 Fla. deputies before fatal OIS
description: On July 16, 2026, Hillsborough County sheriff’s deputies responded to a residence in Ruskin, Florida, after a woman reported that her former boyfriend had held her hostage at gunpoint overnight. As deputies arrived, the suspect ambushed them with gunfire, wounding Deputy Sopharmony Muon and Deputy Colton Daniels. A responding sergeant returned fire during the exchange, striking the suspect. The suspect was transported to a hospital, where he was later pronounced dead. The deputies received medical treatment and survived. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement is investigating the deputy-involved shooting. The incident followed a reported hostage situation involving the suspect.
Charges: None (suspect deceased)

Title: Florida deputies ‘doing extremely well’ after being shot, sheriff says
description: Chris Machowskei, 34, was identified as the suspect in a deputy-involved shooting in Ruskin, Florida. The incident followed a reported domestic violence case involving his ex-girlfriend, who said he restrained her with zip ties, held her at gunpoint, and threatened to kill her. Deputies located Machowskei and followed him to a parking lot. He allegedly opened fire on arriving deputies, shooting Deputy Sopharmony Muon in the face and hand and Deputy Colton Daniels in the neck. Sergeant Harrison Bashner returned fire and killed Machowskei. The suspect was pronounced dead after being transported to a hospital.
Charges: Attempted murder of law enforcement officers (alleged) Kidnapping (alleged) Aggravated assault with a firearm (alleged)

Title: Clearwater Beach 'teen takeover' shooting: Brandon teen faces gun charges; suspected shooter remains at large
description: A 17-year-old boy was shot during a large social media-organized gathering known as a “teen takeover” on Clearwater Beach. Police said hundreds of teenagers gathered in the area, and a fight between two groups led to gunfire near Coronado Drive and Devon Drive. The victim was hospitalized and expected to recover. Officers detained multiple individuals for investigation. A 17-year-old Brandon teen was arrested for firearm-related offenses and resisting an officer, but police said he was not the shooter. Detectives identified a suspected shooter but had not made an arrest related to the shooting. The investigation remained active.
Charges: Possession of a firearm by a minor under 18 Unlawful carry of a concealed firearm Resisting or obstructing an officer without violence

Title: Man targeted ex-girlfriend in Coral Springs shooting caught on camera, cops say
description: On April 17, 2026, Abdul Perez was arrested after police said he shot his ex-girlfriend, Mirtha Sanchez-Teran, in a domestic-related incident near a shopping plaza on West Sample Road in Coral Springs, Florida. Surveillance and witness videos captured the shooting, during which Perez allegedly approached the victim’s SUV and fired multiple shots. Police said Perez had intentionally collided with the victim’s vehicle before the shooting and fled the scene. Officers later located and arrested him. The victim was hospitalized in serious condition but later reported stable.
Charges: Attempted premeditated murder, aggravated battery, possession of firearm or ammunition subject to injunction, tampering with evidence
Comments: No bodycam footage and lack of story.

Title: Man arrested, accused of shooting at vehicle during argument on West Tharpe Street in Tallahassee
description: On July 16, 2026, Chaddrick Jones, 23, was arrested after police said he fired a gun at a vehicle during an argument on West Tharpe Street in Tallahassee, Florida. The incident occurred around 2:40 p.m. in the 2700 block of West Tharpe Street. According to police, an argument involving people inside a vehicle escalated, and one person fired a weapon, striking a nearby vehicle before fleeing. No injuries were reported. Officers later located the suspected shooter and vehicle at an apartment complex, where investigators recovered a firearm believed to have been used.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a firearm
Comments: Not enough story. Investigation still ongoing.

Title: Video shows arrest of man accused of multi-county Florida shooting spree
description: Dennard Barnes, 36, was arrested in Brevard County, Florida, after authorities accused him of a multi-county shooting spree involving incidents in Miami-Dade and Brevard counties. Police said Barnes was connected to two murders in Miami Gardens and North Miami and a shooting in Cocoa where a man was shot in the chest. Officers located him in a white van and alleged he attempted to ram police vehicles. During the arrest, body camera footage showed officers using a K-9 and tasers after Barnes resisted. He faces nearly 20 criminal charges.
Charges: Nearly 20 charges, including charges related to two murders, attempted murder-related offenses, and other shooting-related crimes

Title: WATCH: Shooting suspect flips Jeep after exchanging gunfire with Lee County deputies
description: Joe Christopher Simmons Jr., 32, was arrested after a series of shootings and a police pursuit in Lee County, Florida. Deputies responded to a domestic disturbance where Simmons allegedly fired a handgun inside a home while family members were present. Witnesses said he acted erratically and assaulted relatives before leaving in a Jeep Cherokee. Deputies attempted a traffic stop, leading to a pursuit during which Simmons allegedly fired at law enforcement officers. Deputies returned fire. The chase ended when Simmons crashed his vehicle and barricaded himself before being taken into custody. No injuries were reported.
Charges: Attempted homicide on a law enforcement officer Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer Possession of a firearm by a convicted felon Shooting into an occupied dwelling Two counts of misdemeanor domestic battery Shooting into an occupied conveyance

Title: Man arrested in Margate shopping plaza shooting that injured 2, cops say
description: Joan Ferrer Azuaje, 19, was arrested in connection with a shooting at a Margate shopping plaza on May 9, 2026. Police said Azuaje and three other people were involved in a confrontation that escalated into gunfire at a shopping plaza in the 300 block of South State Road 7. Two people were hospitalized after the shooting. A 10-year-old child was present during the incident but was not injured. Azuaje was arrested in Hillsborough County and later extradited to Broward County.
Charges: Attempted murder, child abuse, felony criminal mischief, discharging a firearm in public

Title: Florida man accused of firing into family’s SUV during miles-long road rage chase
description: Nicolas Totherow, 33, was arrested after deputies accused him of firing multiple rounds at a family’s SUV during a miles-long road rage pursuit. The incident began near Highway 92 and Wiggins Road, where Totherow allegedly followed the vehicle while a child was inside. Deputies said the suspect continued shooting as both vehicles traveled onto Interstate 4. The victims’ SUV was struck multiple times, damaging windows and the area near where the child was seated.
