Investigators said Totherow admitted firing at the vehicle and stated he intended to kill the driver.
Charges: Attempted murder in the first degree with a firearm, aggravated battery with firearm causing great bodily harm (4 counts), discharge firearm from a vehicle, shooting into a vehicle, armed possession of controlled substance, driving while license canceled/suspended/revoked

Title: Man arrested after deadly shooting in Leesburg; man tried to shoot attacking dog, but shot owner instead
description: Matthew Lee Pasco, 43, was arrested after a deadly shooting near a homeless camp in Leesburg. Authorities said a woman was being attacked by a large dog near Griffin Road and Tally Box Road when Pasco attempted to shoot the dog. Deputies said the gunfire instead struck the dog’s owner, who was transported to a hospital and later died. The woman injured in the dog attack was also taken for medical treatment. Pasco was identified as the suspect after fleeing the scene. Authorities said he was considered armed and dangerous before his arrest.
Charges: murder with a firearm
Comments: More of an accident rather than a crazy case.

Title: VIDEO: Man arrested, accused of attacking and shooting door-to-door salesman in Brandon neighborhood
description: Reginald McGee, 38, was arrested after authorities said he attacked and shot a door-to-door salesman in the Providence Townhomes community in Brandon, Florida. Deputies said McGee became verbally aggressive toward a female worker who was with the victim, then physically attacked both workers as they attempted to leave. Officials said McGee pulled out a firearm and repeatedly shot at the salesman while he ran away, continuing until he ran out of ammunition. The victim suffered multiple gunshot wounds to the lower body but survived with non-life-threatening injuries. McGee was taken into custody after leaving his home with a firearm.
Charges: Attempted second-degree murder; aggravated battery; discharging a firearm on residential property

Title: Man accused of shooting at cars driving past his Marion County home
description: Ryan Blumhardt was arrested after authorities accused him of firing a weapon at passing vehicles in Orange Lake, Marion County, Florida. Deputies said Blumhardt was shooting across Northwest Court Road before law enforcement responded. The Marion County Sheriff’s Office Aviation Unit located him in his yard following reports of gunfire. He was taken into custody and later processed through the jail before being released. No injuries or vehicle damage were reported in the incident. Blumhardt faces felony charges related to the alleged shooting activity and is scheduled for a future court appearance regarding the case.
Charges: Felony charges related to shooting at passing vehicles

Title: Florida man shoots, kills neighbor after refusing to turn down loud music, deputies say
description: Tony Deuser was arrested after deputies said he shot and killed his neighbor, Francis Biegaj, during a dispute over loud music in Spring Hill, Florida. According to authorities, Biegaj was found suffering from a gunshot wound and later died at a hospital. Investigators said witnesses heard several gunshots and saw a man leaving the area with a firearm. Deputies identified Deuser as the suspect and surrounded his home. After attempts to contact him, SWAT and crisis response teams helped convince him to leave the residence. Deuser allegedly told investigators the argument began after Biegaj refused to lower his music.
Charges: Second-degree murder
Comments: Not enough action. Need more police in action as opposed to arriving to the scene after the incident.

Title: 3 men, including 2 from Ohio, killed in shooting at Florida home; suspect arrested, sheriff says
description: Ahmad Bojeh was arrested after a shooting at a Florida home near Kissimmee that left three men dead. Authorities said Osceola County deputies responded around 12:15 p.m. after reports of gunfire and found Douglas Kraft, Robert Kraft, and James Puchan with apparent gunshot wounds. The victims were attending a car show in Kissimmee and were reportedly waiting for assistance with a rental car issue when they were killed. Deputies located and detained Bojeh at the scene. He was charged with three counts of murder and remains under investigation. Officials said there was no known interaction between the suspect and victims.
Charges: Three counts of murder

Title: Man charged after accidental firing in downtown Orlando
description: Justice S. Fletcher was arrested after an accidental gunfire incident in downtown Orlando, Florida. According to police, Fletcher was seen handling a firearm while appearing intoxicated in crowded areas. Officers responded on July 2 after a report of a gunshot near South Orange Avenue. Investigators said a firearm was placed in a trash can, later retrieved, and accidentally fired, striking a building. No injuries were reported. Fletcher allegedly fled from officers in a parking garage, and the stolen firearm was recovered nearby. He was later arrested and faces multiple firearm-related charges. The investigation remains ongoing.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a firearm; shooting into a public building; additional firearm-related charges
Comments: Just an accident, no crazy case here.

Title: Man arrested after argument leads to deadly shooting in Orlando, police say
description: Dancing Days Pacheco Santana was arrested after a deadly shooting in Orlando, Florida. According to the Orlando Police Department, Santana was charged in connection with the shooting death of Edwin Collazo. Police said the incident occurred around 10:37 p.m. on Bethune Drive after a verbal argument escalated. First responders found Collazo suffering from gunshot wounds and transported him to Orlando Regional Medical Center, where he later died. Investigators identified Santana as the suspect and arrested him. The case remains under investigation, and authorities are continuing to gather information about the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting.
Charges: First-degree murder; possession of a firearm by a convicted felon

Title: Orlando police arrest man in connection with Church Street shooting
description: Devan Cameron Upshaw, 25, was arrested in connection with a downtown Orlando shooting near Church Street and Orange Avenue. According to the Orlando Police Department, the incident occurred on June 28, 2026, and caused a public safety disturbance in the area. Authorities said Upshaw’s actions threatened public safety, but details about victims or injuries were not released. Police arrested Upshaw on July 1, 2026, and charged him with multiple firearm-related offenses. The investigation remains ongoing as detectives continue gathering information about the circumstances surrounding the shooting and alleged actions that led to the arrest.
Charges: Two counts of aggravated assault with a firearm; aggravated battery with a deadly weapon; culpable negligence

Title: Man arrested in Kissimmee shooting, charged with attempted murder, deputies say
description: Raul Perez was arrested in connection with a shooting at an Extended Stay Suites in Kissimmee, Florida. According to the Osceola County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded around 4:53 a.m. after receiving reports of gunfire. Investigators found a 26-year-old man suffering from a gunshot wound and transported him to Osceola Regional Hospital, where he remained in critical condition. Authorities identified Perez, 53, as the suspect and arrested him. Perez was booked into the Osceola County Jail without bond and faces an attempted murder charge. The shooting investigation remains ongoing as deputies continue reviewing the circumstances surrounding the incident.
Charges: Attempted murder

Title: Man arrested after attempted shooting at Central Florida gym, arrest records show
description: Winston Medley was arrested after authorities said he pointed a handgun at members of a gym in Altamonte Springs, Florida, and attempted to fire the weapon. Police responded to Crunch Fitness after witnesses reported seeing Medley remove a firearm, aim it at people, and appear to pull the trigger, although no shot was heard and no injuries occurred. Investigators identified Medley through gym membership records and surveillance footage. The Seminole County Sheriff’s Office assisted in locating his vehicle in Winter Springs. Medley was later arrested and faces charges related to the alleged attempted shooting.
Charges: Attempted shooting-related firearm charges

Title: Winter Park standoff ends, man arrested after reported gunshots
description: Charles Preston Wulff was arrested after a standoff with police in Winter Park, Florida. According to authorities, officers responded to a residence on North Orlando Avenue after receiving reports of a person in crisis and a possible gunshot inside the home. Police said Wulff was seen holding what appeared to be a rifle. Nearby residents were evacuated while the Winter Park Police Department, Hostage Negotiation Team, and Central Florida Metro SWAT worked to resolve the situation. After several hours of negotiations, Wulff surrendered peacefully without further incident. He was taken into custody and charged with shooting into an occupied dwelling.
Charges: Shooting into an occupied dwelling
Comments: A lot of negotiation without action.

Title: Man arrested after dog found shot dead in Orlando home
description: Miguel Angel Bonilla was arrested after Orlando police said a dog was found shot and killed inside its crate at a home on Lake Carlisle Boulevard. According to investigators, the shooting occurred about two hours after the dog had bitten a child. Police said the child had already been taken to a hospital for treatment before the incident. Officers responded around 10 p.m. and later identified Bonilla as the suspect. He was arrested and charged with aggravated animal cruelty, shooting at, within or into a building, tampering with or fabricating physical evidence, and criminal mischief. The investigation remains ongoing.
Charges: Aggravated animal cruelty; shooting at, within or into a building; tampering with or fabricating physical evidence; criminal mischief

Title: Surveillance video links suspect to deadly after-hours club murder
description: Rijkaard Florvil, 33, was arrested after deputies said surveillance footage and witnesses linked him to a deadly shooting outside an Orlando after-hours club. The shooting occurred on North Apopka Vineland Road, where Kendy Alexandre was found with a gunshot wound to the head. Deputies said Alexandre was transported to Orlando Regional Medical Center, where he later died. Investigators reported that Florvil was identified after witnesses and video evidence connected him to the incident. Deputies stopped his vehicle and recovered a handgun and ammunition. Florvil was charged after homicide detectives investigated the shooting, which remained under investigation.
Charges: First-degree murder

Title: Man accused of shooting at kids riding on ATVs in Longwood subdivision, police say
description: David Allen Mertle was arrested after Longwood police said he fired approximately six shots at two juveniles riding ATVs in the Bay Meadow Farms subdivision. Officers responded to reports of gunfire Saturday morning and initially received reports that witnesses thought the sounds were fireworks. Investigators said the juveniles reported that Mertle fired at them while they were riding on a power line easement. Police collected witness statements and physical evidence supporting the allegations. Mertle surrendered without incident and was taken into custody. He faces felony and misdemeanor firearm-related charges. The case remains under investigation.
Charges: Two counts of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon; one count of discharging a firearm in public or on residential property

Title: ‘My husband is dead’: 64-year-old man shot, killed while gardening in yard; suspect arrested
description: Harold Harper, 64, was shot and killed while gardening in his front yard in Ocala, Florida. Police said the shooting appeared to be a random act of violence. Officers found Harper dead from a single gunshot wound to the back of his head. The suspect, Isaac Toye, was found nearby carrying a loaded 9mm pistol and ammunition. Investigators said the weapon matched a shell casing recovered at the scene. Harper and Toye were not believed to know each other. Toye was arrested and charged with second-degree murder after the fatal shooting that occurred outside Harper's home during a gardening activity.
Charges: Second-degree murder

Title: Clermont man charged with first-degree murder after shooting roommate
description: On May 20, 2026, Clermont Police responded to reports of gunfire at a residence on Linton Court and found 47-year-old Michael Rodriguez suffering from multiple gunshot wounds. Rodriguez was pronounced dead at the scene. Police arrested his roommate, 33-year-old Kirby Smith, who allegedly called 911 and admitted he shot Rodriguez. Smith initially claimed self-defense, but investigators later determined there was probable cause for a premeditated first-degree murder charge. Authorities said the two men were friends, business partners, and roommates for about a month. Investigators believe the dispute may have involved money and relationship issues before the shooting.
Charges: First-degree murder
Comments: No action or story involving the cops and bodycams.

Title: Edgewater shooting: Man arrested for attempted murder after burglary
description: On March 15, 2026, Edgewater Police responded to a residential burglary and shooting on East Yelkca Terrace. Officers arrived shortly after 6:00 p.m. and found the victim injured. The victim was transported to a nearby hospital for treatment of injuries related to the burglary attempt. Investigators arrested 41-year-old Christopher Ryan Merritt, who was accused of shooting the victim during the incident. Merritt was charged with attempted murder, aggravated battery, and resisting arrest without violence. Body-worn camera footage from the incident was scheduled for release. The Edgewater Police Department continued investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting and burglary.
Charges: Attempted murder, aggravated battery, resisting arrest without violence

Title: Sanford Police arrest man in connection with weekend homicide
description: On June 7, 2026, Sanford Police investigated a homicide involving the fatal shooting of Deon Fields. According to investigators, 34-year-old Undray Allen and Fields, who knew each other, were involved in a verbal argument inside a vehicle. During the altercation, Allen allegedly shot and killed Fields. Police arrested Allen following their investigation and charged him with second-degree homicide, firearm possession by a felon, and resisting arrest without violence. Allen was transported to the Seminole County Jail. Investigators stated the case remained active and continued seeking additional witnesses and information about the circumstances surrounding the deadly shooting.
Charges: Second-degree homicide, firearm possession by a felon, resisting arrest without violence

Title: Caregiver arrested for attempted murder outside group home with autistic patients

Title: Woman stabs Clearwater officer while attacking sister’s ex: police
description: Police responded to a disturbance at a home off Wood Avenue in Clearwater. Officers found a group of people arguing, and during the confrontation, Shakenya Mone’ Batson allegedly attacked a 22-year-old woman and stabbed her. The victim was reportedly at the home to speak with Batson’s sister, her former girlfriend. While attempting to separate the individuals, Clearwater police officer Samantha Negron was also stabbed in the arm. The officer was treated at a hospital and released. Batson was taken into custody after the stabbing incident.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer

Title: Florida woman crashes truck into parked patrol vehicle, injures officer
description: Cate Kitay was arrested after she allegedly crashed her pickup truck into a marked Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office patrol vehicle on I-10 westbound near the Lane Avenue exit. The officer was inside the patrol SUV, which was parked with emergency lights activated near a lane closure. The impact pushed Kitay’s truck into an unoccupied utility truck. The officer suffered minor injuries and was taken to a hospital for treatment. Authorities charged Kitay with DUI-related offenses, property damage, personal injury, and careless driving.
Charges: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs; three counts of DUI with property damage and personal injury; careless driving
Comments: Lacking a story and action. A simple case of crashing due to a DUI.

Title: Winter Haven woman slips out of handcuffs, escapes police car during domestic violence investigation
description: Officers responded to an apartment complex in Winter Haven after a reported possible shooting. Police found blood, projectiles, and a man with arm lacerations who said he was involved in a violent encounter with his girlfriend, Unique Isaac. Isaac was detained but escaped from a patrol car after slipping out of handcuffs. Officers later subdued her after she allegedly resisted and attempted to remove an officer’s handgun. Investigators said Isaac had fired multiple shots during a domestic violence incident and threatened the victim with a firearm.
Charges: Four counts of resisting an officer without violence; two counts of resisting an officer with violence; two counts of battery on an officer; escape or attempted escape; aggravated assault with a weapon; domestic battery with a deadly weapon

Title: Bodycam likely saves Florida deputy’s life after bullet hits camera ‘dead center,’ sheriff says
description: Deputies responded to a battery call on Candler Drive in Deltona, Florida. During the investigation, deputies attempted to speak with suspect Luis Polonco at a residence. Police said Polonco engaged Deputy José Rivera in a close-range gunfight. Rivera was shot in the leg and shoulder, while a bullet struck his body camera and ricocheted into his shoulder. Other deputies removed Rivera from danger and transported him to a hospital. Polonco was detained at the scene. Investigators said he was expected to face attempted murder charges after the shooting involving law enforcement officers.
Charges: Attempted murder of a law enforcement officer

Suspect Name: Nikki Marie Green and Dylan Stiles
Title: 2 adults involved in 16-year-old girl’s shooting arrested on unrelated charges in Pasco County
description: Police investigated the shooting of a 16-year-old girl near Louisiana Avenue and Colonial Drive in New Port Richey, Florida. The victim was taken to a hospital and remained in stable condition. Two adults present at the scene were taken into custody. Nikki Marie Green was arrested on drug possession, probation violation, and resisting officer charges. Dylan Stiles was arrested on active felony warrants from a previous home invasion case involving armed suspects, assault victims, and stolen phones. Police confirmed both individuals were involved in the incident but did not identify either as a shooting suspect.
Charges: Nikki Marie Green: Two counts of possession of a controlled substance without a prescription, violating probation, resisting an officer without violence. Dylan Stiles: Multiple felony warrants related to a previous home invasion case.
Comments: Might need an incident report to see if the case is worth buying.

Title: Man shot by JSO charged with kidnapping, aggravated assault, domestic battery
description: Marcus Delay, 30, was arrested after an alleged domestic disturbance that led to an officer-involved shooting in Jacksonville. Police responded to a home on Eberly Drive after reports that Delay damaged property, threatened his fiancée and infant, and fired a rifle into the air. Officers said Delay later pointed a handgun at them and made threats to harm others. Two Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office officers fired their weapons, striking Delay. He was taken into custody and transported to a hospital for treatment. The woman and infant were found safe and were not physically injured.
Charges: First-degree kidnapping with intent to inflict bodily harm; aggravated assault with a deadly weapon; misdemeanor domestic battery

Title: Man who plowed truck into crowd at Palatka block party released from hospital, booked into Clay County jail
description: Lazayeus Bartley, 36, was arrested after police said he drove a pickup truck through a crowd at a block party in Palatka, striking multiple people and vehicles. Officers attempted to stop him, but police said Bartley drove away and later returned, crashing into a patrol vehicle and hitting more people and cars. Officers fired their weapons at the truck, causing it to crash. Bartley was taken into custody after receiving medical treatment at a hospital. Several bystanders were injured, including one person who suffered a broken leg. No law enforcement officers were injured.
Charges: Two counts of aggravated battery; aggravated fleeing and eluding with injuries

Title: Search for serial trespasser who battered Miami officer ends with arrest: Police
description: Ejiofor Onyechi, 36, was accused of trespassing inside a restricted residential area in Miami and refusing to identify himself or leave when officers arrived. Police said he allegedly struck a Miami officer in the neck and pushed the officer against a wall while resisting. After fleeing, he reportedly triggered several fire alarms and escaped a police search. The next day, officers located him riding an electric scooter and attempted a stop, but he allegedly fled again into a building. Tactical officers later found him hiding in a storage room and arrested him.
Charges: Battery on a police officer; resisting an officer with violence; loitering or prowling; false fire alarm

Title: Video shows K-9 biting suspect during PBSO arrest, raising excessive force questions
description: Michael Davis was arrested after Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office deputies pursued him following allegations that he battered the mother of his child with a gun, threatened her, and held her captive inside her Belle Glade home. Authorities said the woman escaped with her baby and sought help at a nearby church. Deputies later located Davis in Royal Palm Beach, where bystander video showed deputies struggling to handcuff him, with one deputy appearing to punch him and a K-9 biting his arm. The use of force is under review by the sheriff’s office.
Charges: Aggravated battery with a weapon; resisting law enforcement; additional charges related to alleged domestic violence incident

Title: Arrest made after man shot multiple times in Apopka driveway, deputies say
description: Keith Simmons, 19, was arrested after a shooting in Apopka, Florida. According to the Orange County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded to the 200 block of East 13th Street around 9:30 a.m. after a man in his 50s was shot multiple times in a driveway. Investigators said Simmons and the victim, Chester Keys, had a verbal confrontation that escalated into gunfire. Witnesses identified Simmons as the shooter. Keys was transported to a hospital in critical condition. Deputies said Simmons left the scene but was later arrested and charged in connection with the shooting.
Charges: Attempted murder with a firearm
Comments: Police again arriving after the incident.

Title: Florida man arrested after following girlfriend, shooting at her car, deputies say
description: On April 27, 2026, Geoffrey Moreno was arrested after deputies said he followed his estranged girlfriend, threatened her, and fired a shot at her vehicle in Palm Beach County. Investigators said the couple had a child together and had a history of domestic disputes. The victim reported being chased and drove to the Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office for help. Deputies reviewed surveillance footage and found evidence supporting her account. Detectives also discovered a bullet defect on the victim’s vehicle. Moreno was taken into custody after allegedly making additional threats against the victim and her family.
Charges: Attempted first-degree murder Missing in a dwelling or vehicle
Comments: Great story and a lot of action, but all the action is unfortunately alleged. Police involvement is not there either, as all they do is go to arrest the suspect.

Title: Tampa man arrested for shooting motorcyclist in Pinellas Park neighborhood: Police
description: On January 1, 2026, Barut Montijo was arrested after police said he shot a 22-year-old motorcyclist during an argument in a Pinellas Park neighborhood. The incident happened shortly after midnight in the 7100 block of 63rd Street while fireworks were occurring nearby. Investigators said Montijo attempted to grab the motorcyclist as he tried to leave, then pulled out a firearm and fired multiple shots, striking the victim. The injured motorcyclist was taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Montijo fled but later returned and surrendered to investigators.
Charges: Attempted second-degree murder

Title: Suspect arrested after man killed in Hialeah shooting, police say
description: Dairon Rosas Delgado was arrested after police said he fatally shot a man in Hialeah. Officers responded after receiving reports of multiple gunshots near West 19th Avenue and West 56th Street. Police found the victim deceased on a sidewalk near an apartment complex. Authorities initially searched for Delgado after reports indicated the shooter may have been inside an apartment. SWAT officers investigated the area, but police later determined the suspect had fled. Detectives located Delgado while he was driving near West Fourth Avenue and West 18th Street and took him into custody. The motive remains under investigation.
Charges: murder with a firearm
Comments: Could be interesting if the SWAT officers were required to have their bodycams equipped.

Title: Florida man shot friend while 'mishandling' gun, deputies say
description: Carlos Moises Garcia was arrested after deputies said he accidentally shot and killed his friend while mishandling a loaded firearm at a home in Kissimmee. According to the Osceola County Sheriff’s Office, Garcia was handling the gun when it discharged, striking 21-year-old Orlando Jose Canizales. Canizales was transported to a hospital but later died from his injuries. Deputies arrested Garcia and booked him into jail. Authorities charged him with manslaughter with a firearm. No additional details about the circumstances surrounding the shooting were released by investigators. The incident occurred at a residence on Chatham Circle.
Charges: Manslaughter with a firearm

Title: Man arrested on murder charge in fatal shooting at Florida City hotel
description: Jeffrey Joseph Dabdoub Jr. was arrested on a second-degree murder charge in connection with a fatal shooting at a Florida City hotel. According to the arrest report, the shooting occurred at the Belmont Inn on January 26, 2026. Investigators said Dabdoub was involved in a verbal altercation with the victim and armed himself with a firearm. Police allege that after the victim returned to collect property, Dabdoub pointed the gun and shot him twice. Dabdoub was initially interviewed and released while investigators continued examining evidence. Authorities later arrested him after finding evidence that contradicted his statements.
Charges: Second-degree murder

Suspect Name: Christopher Hankerson and Roderick Terrell Everett
Title: Pair arrested in fatal Florida City home invasion shooting caught on Facebook Live
description: Christopher Hankerson and Roderick Terrell Everett were arrested in connection with a fatal home invasion shooting in Florida City. Police said the suspects entered a home on December 30, 2025, while armed and wearing masks, demanding money from victims. During the incident, one suspect allegedly fired shots, killing 45-year-old Carl Melvin and injuring 34-year-old Quentavis Lejohn Smith. The shooting was partially captured on Facebook Live. Investigators said surveillance footage and cellphone data connected the suspects to the crime. Both men were arrested and charged in connection with the home invasion, murder, attempted murder, and firearm offenses.
Charges: First-degree murder-home invasion robbery, attempted first-degree murder with a deadly weapon, convicted felon in possession of a firearm

Title: Man arrested in homicide probe; bond set at $2M
description: Samuel Lovejoy, 31, was arrested in connection with a homicide investigation involving the shooting death of 48-year-old Maceo Ve Aundreas Burton in Columbus, Ohio. Police said Burton was shot while sitting inside a vehicle at the Eagle Fuel Gas Station parking lot on East Livingston Avenue. Investigators allege Lovejoy and another unidentified person approached Burton’s car during an attempted robbery and shot him. Burton was taken to Grant Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead. Security footage and cellphone records helped identify Lovejoy as a suspect. He was arrested and faces a murder charge.
Charges: murder with a firearm

Title: Man accused of killing 2 in Florida State University mass shooting to appear in court
description: Phoenix Ikner, 21, is accused of carrying out a mass shooting at Florida State University in Tallahassee, Florida. Authorities allege that he opened fire on campus, killing two people and injuring at least six others. Following the attack, Ikner was taken into custody and charged with multiple criminal offenses. He pleaded not guilty and has remained in jail awaiting trial. The case drew widespread attention because of the number of victims and the location of the shooting. Court proceedings continued with his first in-person appearance after the incident, while prosecutors prepared for a trial scheduled to begin later in the year.
Charges: Murder Attempted murder
Comments: Need more of a story and police intervention.

Title: Suspect in homicide investigation at gas station on MLK Blvd arrested
description: Rolbert Joachin, 40, was arrested in connection with a homicide at a Chevron gas station on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard and Highland Avenue in Fort Myers, Florida. Police said a female gas station clerk was killed during the incident. Surveillance footage reportedly showed Joachin damaging a vehicle windshield before approaching the victim and striking her in the head with a hammer. After the attack, Fort Myers Police officers located and detained Joachin on Mango Street near Dunbar Park. He was transported to the Lee County Jail and remained in custody while facing homicide-related charges.
Charges: Homicide Damaging property
Comments: Police arrive after the incident occured.

Suspect Name: Flora Norys Gonzalez, Jose Enrique Calafet Perez, Maykel Calafet Calderon
Title: Wife accused of helping orchestrate attack-turned-robbery at Hendry County home
description: Three suspects were arrested after authorities said they carried out an attack and robbery at a Hendry County home. Deputies said the victim was approached by two masked men, beaten with a handgun, restrained with zip ties, and forced to surrender money. Investigators alleged the victim’s wife, Flora Norys Gonzalez, helped coordinate the attack and knew one of the suspects. Deputies said Gonzalez’s statements contained inconsistencies during questioning, leading to the discovery of her alleged involvement. Authorities arrested Gonzalez, Jose Enrique Calafet Perez, and Maykel Calafet Calderon on multiple felony charges connected to the armed robbery and assault.
Charges: Flora Norys Gonzalez: aggravated battery causing bodily harm, armed robbery, armed burglary, false imprisonment Jose Enrique Calafet Perez: aggravated battery causing bodily harm, armed robbery, armed burglary, false imprisonment Maykel Calafet Calderon: aggravated battery causing bodily harm, armed robbery, armed burglary, false imprisonment, grand theft
Comments: Police again arrive after the incident.

Title: Man accused of pointing gun at FWC officer after response to wildlife complaint in Cape Coral
description: John Battista Quartapella, 87, was arrested after authorities said he pointed a handgun at a Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission officer during a response to a wildlife complaint at a home on Southwest 26th Avenue in Cape Coral. Officials said the officer attempted to contact Quartapella, who allegedly displayed the firearm and retreated inside the residence. The Florida Highway Patrol and Cape Coral Police Department assisted during the incident. Authorities said Quartapella later surrendered without further incident. He was taken into custody and charged with aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer. The investigation remains active.
Charges: Aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer
Comments: Might need a report for this case.

Title: Cape Coral police arrest man accused of forcing his way into a home, threatening occupants with gun
description: Isaias Jamon Garcia, 22, was arrested after Cape Coral police said he forced his way into a residence during a dispute and threatened occupants with a firearm. Officers responded to a disturbance call where threats of violence were heard. Police said Garcia pushed open the door after being denied entry, causing it to hit a victim. Inside the home, he allegedly pointed a 9mm handgun at one victim multiple times, shoved another victim, and prevented someone from leaving. Officers detained Garcia and recovered the handgun during a search. He was taken into custody and faces multiple felony charges.
Charges: Armed burglary, aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, battery, false imprisonment

Title: Fort Myers Beach man accused of DUI hit-and-run crash, punching deputy
description: Stephen Prenoveau, 66, a Fort Myers Beach man, was arrested after deputies said he was involved in a DUI hit-and-run crash and later assaulted a law enforcement officer. Deputies responded to Fiesta Lane in Cypress Lake after a silver pickup truck reportedly struck a parked vehicle and left the scene. Officers found Prenoveau showing signs of impairment, including difficulty standing, loss of balance, watery eyes, and the odor of alcohol. During the investigation, he allegedly became aggressive and punched a deputy multiple times in the chest. He was taken into custody and faces several criminal charges.
Charges: DUI, refusal to submit to BAL testing, leaving the scene of a crash with damage, DUI property damage, battery on a law enforcement officer

Title: Fort Myers man accused of grabbing officer's gun during nightclub arrest
description: Ever Saul Sanchez Soto, 31, was arrested after Fort Myers Police Department officers responded to disturbances outside a club on Palm Beach Boulevard. Officers found two men involved in an altercation near a white sedan. During the incident, Alex Daniel Corona Contreras was detained for disorderly behavior. Police said Sanchez Soto exited the vehicle while officers were handling Corona Contreras and grabbed an officer’s firearm, which was secured in a holster. The gun never left the holster. Sanchez Soto was immediately detained and arrested. He faces charges related to battery on specified personnel and obstruction during the arrest.
Charges: Battery on specified personnel, obstruction

Title: Man accused of leading Lee County deputies on high-speed chase, attempting to crash into deputy
description: Angel Gutierrez, 28, was arrested after Lee County deputies accused him of leading them on a dangerous high-speed chase. Deputies said they observed Gutierrez driving over 100 mph, running stop signs, forcing vehicles off the road, and creating hazards for other drivers and a bicyclist. During the pursuit, the vehicle reportedly reached high speeds in residential areas before stopping. Authorities said Gutierrez later drove directly toward a deputy’s vehicle, forcing the deputy to maneuver into a ditch to avoid a crash. Deputies later located Gutierrez at a camper in North Fort Myers and arrested him.
Charges: Aggravated assault on specified personnel, reckless driving, failing to register a motor vehicle

Title: Man arrested after abruptly stabbing a woman in the face in downtown Miami, officials say
description: Raydean Johnson, 49, was arrested after police said he randomly attacked and stabbed a woman in the face in downtown Miami. According to the arrest report, Johnson approached the victim while she was walking her dog, pushed her to the ground, punched her head, and stabbed her with a homemade shank. After the attack, Johnson remained in the area and had a standoff with police lasting several hours. Police said he threatened officers before being subdued with a taser and taken into custody. The victim was transported to a trauma center in stable condition.
Charges: Attempted murder; aggravated battery; armed criminal mischief; resisting an officer with violence
Comments: Lacking action. Police arrive after incident.

Title: Miami police arrest man they said shot another man multiple times after parking lot argument
description: Samuel Saint Remy, 32, was arrested after police said he shot another man multiple times during an argument in a parking lot in Miami. According to investigators, Saint Remy called 911 and claimed the victim attempted to hit him with a vehicle, leading him to open fire. Police responded after multiple ShotSpotter alerts and found the victim inside his vehicle with critical injuries. Surveillance video allegedly showed a verbal altercation before the victim drove away and Saint Remy approached the vehicle and fired multiple rounds. Investigators said the shooting did not appear to be self-defense.
Charges: Attempted second-degree murder; displaying or using a firearm while committing a felony; unlawful discharge of a firearm
Comments: Again, police arrive after the incident occurs.

Title: Agitator arrested on battery charge outside Trump's West Palm Beach golf course
description: Paul Messer was arrested after police said he struck a protester during a verbal dispute outside President Donald Trump’s West Palm Beach golf course. According to the Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office, Messer was interacting with protesters across from the golf club when an argument occurred with a woman. Investigators said he used a metal flagpole to strike her multiple times in the upper chest and neck area. The woman reportedly suffered visible redness on her neck. Messer was taken into custody and transported to the Palm Beach County Jail following the incident.
Charges: Aggravated battery

Title: Pinellas Park woman arrested for attempted murder after stabbing daughter’s boyfriend, police say
description: Sandra Kegley, a 54-year-old woman from Pinellas Park, Florida, was arrested after police said she attacked her daughter’s boyfriend, Eric Smith, with a knife. During the incident, Kegley’s daughter Kyrsten Bleattler reportedly intervened and was also injured. Police found both victims with various stab wounds and cuts when they arrived at the scene. The victims were transported to a hospital, and their injuries were reported as not life-threatening. The motive for the stabbing remains unknown, and authorities continued investigating the case. Kegley was taken into custody and faces serious violent crime charges related to the attack.
Charges: Attempted first-degree murder; aggravated battery with a deadly weapon
Comments: Police arrive after incident. Lacking story as well.

Title: Man, woman arrested after assaulting officers, prompting county-wide call for help at local motel
description: A man and a woman were arrested after an altercation at a motel in Vandalia, Ohio. Police responded to a disorderly conduct call at 7070 Poe Ave. Officers found a woman being asked to leave the property. During the incident, the woman assaulted an officer, and the man interfered and assaulted other officers. A crowd gathered, leading to a county-wide request for assistance. Both suspects were taken into custody and booked into Montgomery County Jail. Two additional men were charged with obstructing official business and released.
Charges: Assault on police officers; obstructing official business (two additional men)

Title: Woman accused of assaulting Children Services supervisor
description: Na’Shay Powell, 38, was arrested after allegedly assaulting a Children Services supervisor during a meeting related to an ongoing investigation. According to the Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office, Powell physically attacked the supervisor and then left the scene by vehicle. The supervisor suffered injuries and was treated at a local emergency room. Detectives later located the vehicle Powell had used, but she was not inside. Powell was found by detectives the following day, taken into custody, and booked into Montgomery County Jail. She was charged with assault and obstructing official business.
Charges: Assault; obstructing official business
Comments: Lacking story and police in action.

Title: Florida woman accused of shooting sleeping boyfriend, tried dismembering him and burying remains in yard: BCSO
description: Ashley Averett is accused of killing her boyfriend, Joseph Eiler, while he was sleeping at their home in Fountain, Florida. Investigators said Eiler was reported missing after failing to appear at work and being unseen for several days. Authorities allege Averett admitted to shooting Eiler with a .380 caliber handgun, attempting to dismember his body, and burying remains in multiple areas of the yard. Investigators found human remains during a search of the property. Evidence also included disturbed soil, cleaning supplies, and burned items. Averett has been charged in connection with the suspected murder.
Charges: Second-degree murder with a firearm
Comments: Could be good depending on the report.

Title: Florida to seek death penalty for St. Pete mom accused of killing 4-year-old son
description: Police in St. Petersburg, Florida, responded to a home on January 27, 2026, after a report of a person bleeding. Officers found four-year-old Finley Cullom dead inside the residence. Investigators said his 16-year-old sister discovered their mother holding him in bed after returning from school. Authorities initially believed the child had been stabbed, but the medical examiner later determined he died from suffocation with a plastic bag. Diana Cullom reportedly had self-inflicted stab wounds, and investigators found a note inside the home. She was arrested and charged with first-degree murder. Florida prosecutors later announced they would seek the death penalty.
Charges: First-degree murder
Comments: An interesting story but it lacks police intervention.

Title: Grieving mom demands justice after Leesburg shooting targeting dog takes the life of her son
description: Matthew Pasco was accused of fatally shooting Shawn Cyriacks at a homeless camp in Leesburg, Florida. Investigators said an argument occurred after Cyriacks’ dogs attacked Pasco’s wife. Witnesses stated Pasco threatened to kill the dogs, confronted Cyriacks with a firearm, and shot him in the chest during the confrontation. Cyriacks, 36, died from the shooting. Pasco was later arrested after a two-day manhunt and charged in connection with the killing. The victim’s mother requested justice, describing her grief and loss after her son’s death.
Charges: One count of murder
Comments: Only bodycam of the arrest, no action.

Title: Sarasota man pleads not guilty in deaths of girlfriend, 6-year-old son
description: Nicholas A. Novickis was accused of killing his girlfriend Allie Novickis and their 6-year-old son Phoenix in Sarasota, Florida. Authorities said Novickis used a shotgun to shoot both victims at his mother’s home in the Artistry neighborhood. Deputies also said he shot the family dog after the killings. The victims were found dead on the back porch when deputies arrived after receiving a shooting report. Novickis was taken into custody at the scene without incident. He later entered a written not guilty plea and faces charges related to the deaths and animal cruelty.
Charges: Two counts of second-degree murder and animal cruelty
Comments: Again, police arrive after the incident.

Title: Mom was holding 2-year-old son when her boyfriend fatally shot him during argument ‘about a phone’: arrest report
description: Steven Dodson Jr. was arrested after police said he shot and killed 2-year-old A’hmari Robinson during a domestic dispute at the Valencia Way Apartments in Jacksonville. According to investigators, Dodson was arguing with the child’s mother about a phone before entering a bedroom where children were present. Police said Dodson fired a gun while the mother was holding the child, causing the toddler’s death. Investigators said Dodson fled and discarded the firearm before being captured after a manhunt involving Jacksonville Sheriff’s Office, U.S. Marshals, and SWAT officers. He remains in custody.
Charges: Second-degree murder, attempted murder, child neglect, tampering with evidence, possession of a firearm by a felon
Comments: Could work but need a report to see for sure.

Title: Man accused of killing his mother in Sumter County
description: Derek Vaughn was arrested after authorities said he fatally stabbed and shot his mother, Jerry Lea Vaughn, at a home in the Wildwood area of Sumter County. Police responded to a 911 call from the victim, who reported that her son had stabbed her and was trying to kill her. Officers found Derek Vaughn at the home and took him into custody. According to the arrest report, Vaughn allegedly told police he stabbed his mother first and later used his father’s gun to shoot her after believing he was instructed by God to do so. The investigation was handled by the Sumter County Sheriff’s Office.
Charges: Murder (stabbing and shooting death)
Comments: Good story just lacking police in action.

Title: Video shows Florida teens laughing, making jokes about arrest for alleged school murder plot
description: Isabelle Valdez, 15, was arrested along with 14-year-old Lois Lippert after authorities said they planned to attack a fellow student at Lake Brantley High School in Seminole County, Florida. Police said investigators received a tip and discovered a planned attack involving a knife and other items. Authorities alleged Valdez discussed harming the student and had expressed an obsession with the intended victim. The planned attack was intercepted before anyone was physically injured. Valdez was charged as an adult and remained in custody after bond was denied. The Altamonte Springs Police Department investigated the case.
Charges: Premeditated murder (charged as an adult)

Title: Orlando delivery driver accused of hitting, dragging woman from car in road rage dispute, police say
description: Antoinette Evans, 24, was arrested in Orlando after an alleged road-rage incident near the Mall at Millenia. Police said Evans and another driver had a confrontation following a traffic dispute. Authorities alleged Evans followed the other vehicle, threw a soda bottle into the occupied vehicle, struck the driver, opened the car door, dragged the woman out, and punched her. A witness reportedly told officers they saw Evans attacking the driver. Evans was taken into custody and faced multiple charges related to the alleged assault, vehicle entry, and the object thrown into the occupied vehicle. The Orlando Police Department investigated the incident.
Charges: Vehicle burglary; battery (two counts); shooting or throwing a deadly missile into an occupied vehicle

Title: St. Petersburg city worker deadly shooting suspect identified after I-75 standoff: Police
description: Ladavion King, 43, was identified as the suspect in the fatal shooting of St. Petersburg sanitation technician Tasha Moses. Police said Moses was sitting inside a city work vehicle when she was shot and killed while on duty. Investigators described the incident as a targeted domestic-related attack, stating that King and Moses knew each other. After the shooting, King fled and was later located driving south on Interstate 75 in Lee County. A standoff followed, during which gunfire occurred between law enforcement and King. He was taken into custody with serious injuries and remained hospitalized under law enforcement custody.
Charges: Murder (suspected first-degree murder)

Title: Orlando couple accused of ax attack, robbery setup
description: Anne Aksell, 29, was arrested after deputies said she helped plan a robbery and violent attack against a man who came to her apartment in Orlando. Authorities said the victim was invited over by Aksell and was later attacked by three men who beat him with an ax and knife, stealing his wallet, phone, and keys. The victim suffered a stab wound to his back and a head laceration. Investigators said evidence, including surveillance footage and clothing, supported the victim’s account. Deputies said Aksell initially claimed fear but later admitted the attack was planned.
Charges: Robbery with a firearm, grand theft, aggravated battery
Comments: Police again arrive after the incident occurs.

Title: Florida man allegedly threw hot grease at girlfriend, stole her car after argument over phone charger
description: Jontrai Stephens, 23, was arrested after police said an argument with his girlfriend over a phone charger escalated into violence. Authorities alleged Stephens battered the woman, damaged her television, and threw a hot pan containing steak and potatoes at her. Police said he then took her car keys and drove away in her vehicle while she attempted to stop him. The victim reportedly climbed onto the trunk of the car, and investigators said Stephens drove erratically, causing her to fall off and suffer serious injuries. The vehicle was later located nearby, and Stephens was taken into custody.
Charges: Aggravated battery, aggravated assault with domestic violence, grand theft of a motor vehicle

Title: Broward woman accused of snorting cocaine in Uber before attacking driver, BSO says
description: Sancia Beckford, 27, was arrested after authorities said she attacked an Uber driver during a ride in Tamarac, Florida. According to investigators, Beckford entered the vehicle and allegedly used cocaine before arguing with the driver over the vehicle’s windows and being asked to leave. Police said she threatened the driver with a pen, punched him, spit on him, and damaged his Cadillac XT6, causing about $4,500 in damage. The driver exited the vehicle and called 911. Beckford was later located at her apartment, arrested, booked into jail, and released on bond.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, battery, criminal mischief

Title: Woman Arrested in Tampa Stabbing
description: Anijah Green, 24, was arrested in connection with a stabbing that occurred at an apartment complex on Rivergate Drive in Tampa. Deputies responded early on May 16, 2026, after receiving a report of a stabbing and found a 21-year-old woman suffering from at least one stab wound. Investigators determined that during an altercation between two groups, Green allegedly stabbed the victim. Detectives obtained an arrest warrant on May 18, and Green was taken into custody on May 19. The victim was transported to a hospital for treatment. The case remains under investigation by authorities.
Charges: Aggravated Battery Great Bodily Harm and Deadly Weapon Attempted Murder in the Second Degree With Weapon
Comments: Police again arrive after the incident occurs.

Title: Gainesville woman arrested for allegedly stabbing boyfriend and dumping a pot of collard greens on his head
description: Ieshia Chika Nakajsa Hawkins, 24, was arrested after an alleged domestic violence incident at Majestic Oaks Apartments in Gainesville, Florida. Deputies responded after Hawkins reported that her boyfriend had choked her. The boyfriend told investigators that during an argument, Hawkins damaged his clothes, stabbed him in the chest with a knife, dragged him by his hair, and poured hot collard greens on him. The victim suffered a small puncture wound, head injuries, and burns. Hawkins later allegedly admitted to dragging him and pouring the hot food on him. She was also accused of kicking the victim during arrest.
Charges: Aggravated Battery with a Deadly Weapon Battery with a Prior Battery Conviction Felony Property Damage Resisting an Officer Without Violence Misdemeanor Property Damage

Title: Woman accused of racist assault of Black mail carrier in Miami, police say
description: On April 14, 2026, Lourdes Portugues was accused of assaulting a U.S. Postal Service worker in Miami. Police said Portugues used racial remarks, sprayed the victim with a hose, attempted to strike her with an SUV multiple times, and threatened to shoot her. The victim avoided being hit and called authorities. Police found a pellet gun and ammunition inside Portugues’ home. Surveillance footage reportedly supported the victim’s account. Portugues was taken into custody and later placed on house arrest after a judge set her bond at $15,000.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon with prejudice
Comments: Might work might not. Good story and action, but lacking police intervention.

Title: Ohio woman accused of running over man repeatedly, hitting parked car
description: On March 23, 2026, Brianna Daye was accused of striking a man with her vehicle multiple times outside his home in Boardman, Ohio. Authorities said the victim was standing in his driveway when Daye allegedly hit him, causing him to fall partly underneath the vehicle. Police reported that Daye reversed the car and accelerated again toward the victim before hitting a parked vehicle while attempting another strike. The victim provided video evidence of the incident. Officers later found Daye hiding inside a barricaded closet and arrested her.
Charges: Driving under suspension, hit and run, felonious assault
Comments: Again good story but lacking police intervention.

Suspect Name: Arianna Del Valle Jasmine Randazzo Christion Williams Lyndell Hudson II
Title: 4 arrested in kidnapping, ‘targeted armed robbery’ include Hernando school paraprofessional
description: According to police, the incident occurred on February 4, 2026, at the Eagles Point at Tampa Palms Apartments in Tampa, Florida. Investigators said the four suspects allegedly targeted three men they knew, assaulted them, held them at gunpoint, stole their personal belongings, and ordered them to leave. One suspect, Lyndell Hudson II, was employed as a paraprofessional with the Hernando County School District and was placed on administrative leave following his arrest. Tampa Police stated the case remains an active and ongoing investigation, and all four suspects were taken into custody on multiple felony charges.
Charges: Armed robbery Kidnapping Aggravated battery with a deadly weapon

Title: Miami woman stabbed friend during argument over drinking beer in Uber, cops say
description: Lynn Marie Zamora, 32, was arrested after allegedly stabbing her friend with scissors during an argument inside an Uber ride in Miami. According to investigators, the dispute began when Zamora wanted to drink beer in the rideshare vehicle, but the victim repeatedly told her not to. Police said she then pulled scissors from her bag and stabbed the victim multiple times in the bicep and calf. The victim was taken to a hospital for treatment, and the Uber driver confirmed the events to investigators. Zamora was arrested, booked into jail, and later appeared before a judge, who set her bond at $7,500.
Charges: Aggravated battery with a deadly weapon

Title: Woman charged with aggravated battery after striking mother with hammer near Sebastian
description: Heather Lynn Wilson was arrested after deputies said she assaulted her mother with a hammer during a domestic dispute that began while they were driving and ended at a 7-Eleven near Sebastian. According to investigators, Wilson struck her mother multiple times with the hammer, threatened her, forced her to remain in the vehicle, drove recklessly, and bit her during the incident. When they stopped for gas, the victim escaped and sought help inside the store. Deputies recovered a blood-stained hammer from the vehicle. The victim was treated at a hospital and released, and Wilson was taken into custody after resisting deputies.
Charges: Aggravated battery Kidnapping

Title: Florida woman opens fire on vehicle with kids inside at park: deputies
description: Deputies said Lakeshia Taylor, 43, responded to Lake Betty Park after receiving a call from a juvenile involved in a fight. When she arrived, she saw several juveniles leaving in a vehicle while the caller remained on the ground. Investigators said Taylor drew a firearm and fired three rounds at the occupied vehicle as it attempted to leave the parking lot. Two bullets struck the vehicle, which had four occupants, including juveniles. No one inside was injured by the gunfire. Taylor admitted firing the shots, telling detectives she was trying to stop the vehicle from leaving. She was arrested at the scene.
Charges: Discharging a firearm into an occupied vehicle

Title: BSO sergeant arrested for second time in 2026, accused of battery, grand theft auto in Pompano Beach
description: Scott Nida, 55, a Broward Sheriff’s Office sergeant, was arrested after deputies accused him of assaulting his longtime significant other during a dispute. According to the arrest report, Nida allegedly forced the victim into her vehicle, questioned her about suspected infidelity, and repeatedly punched her face and head, causing bleeding. Authorities said the victim escaped and reported the incident. Nida was charged with domestic violence-related offenses, false imprisonment, robbery, and grand theft auto. He was placed on administrative leave with pay by the Broward Sheriff’s Office while the case proceeds.
Charges: False imprisonment; Robbery; Domestic violence touching or striking; Grand theft auto

Title: Sheriff’s been kidnapped’: Armed man fires from truck, sparks multi-city Florida chase
description: Mark Patrick Spero was arrested after police said he fired a 9mm pistol from his truck and led deputies on a multi-city chase. The incident began in Sebastian after reports of shots fired near Riverview Park. Witnesses reported seeing a truck speeding away after hearing gunshots. Spero allegedly told people that the sheriff had been kidnapped and that he fired his weapon to get law enforcement attention. Police located his vehicle and conducted a high-risk traffic stop. Deputies found spent 9mm shell casings inside the truck. Spero was taken into custody without incident and charged with firearm offenses.
Charges: Two counts of unlawful discharge of a firearm from a vehicle
Comments: Good story, but lacking police in action.

Title: Sebring police charge driver, 3 other suspects after video showed car driving into crowd outside bar
description: McKaeyla Hood, 20, was arrested after police said she drove a vehicle into a crowd outside Back Alley Bar & Grill following a dispute in the parking lot. According to investigators, a verbal argument between two groups escalated into a physical fight. Video showed Hood driving away while people followed the vehicle and threw objects at it. Police said Hood struck multiple people and a parked car before leaving the area. Officers later located her vehicle and conducted a traffic stop. After reviewing surveillance footage and witness statements, Sebring Police charged Hood with aggravated battery and aggravated assault offenses.
Charges: Three counts of aggravated battery; Two counts of aggravated assault

Title: Clearwater deputy-involved shooting, woman suspect hospitalized: PCSO
description: Meaghan Ratcliffe, 40, was involved in a deputy-involved shooting after Pinellas County deputies responded to a 911 call at a Clearwater residence. Investigators said Ratcliffe indicated she had a handgun and kept her hands concealed in her jacket. Deputies moved to a safe location and attempted negotiations. Police said she later approached deputies and quickly pulled her hand from her jacket after refusing commands to show her hands. Two deputies fired, striking her once. It was later determined she was holding a cordless drill instead of a firearm. Ratcliffe was taken to a hospital for emergency surgery.
Charges: Failure to comply with the order or signal of a police officer
