During the investigation, he also disclosed possession and distribution of illegal sexual material and other offenses.
Charges: Attempted second-degree murder; sexual performance by a child; engaging in sexual conduct with animals; possession of child sexual abuse material

Title: Man accused of shooting 3 people after fight at Lake County bonfire
description: Christian Cook, 26, is accused of shooting three people during a bonfire party in Lake County, Florida. Authorities said the incident began with an argument over a truck doing doughnuts and kicking up dirt. Investigators allege Cook was placed in a headlock during the fight, then pulled out a handgun and shot one person in the finger. Cook subsequently drove away and allegedly stopped on the road, retrieved a shotgun, and fired toward the party. Two additional people were struck, including a woman who suffered three gunshot wounds to the chest, arm, and hand. Investigators also said shotgun fire damaged a truck.
Charges: Multiple counts of aggravated battery with a deadly weapon

Title: Man charged with murder after stepfather’s dismembered remains found in luggage
description: A Florida man, Jose Proano, is accused of killing and dismembering his stepfather, Jorge Vazquez-Escutia, following family disputes. Investigators found the victim’s wallet, phone, and blood at the family home. Surveillance footage allegedly showed a man concealing his identity, setting traps, moving suitcases, and appearing to place an arm inside one. Detectives later found multiple pieces of luggage hidden behind a brick wall, containing the victim’s remains. Proano initially claimed he could not remember his whereabouts because of schizophrenia but was allegedly placed at the scene by cellphone evidence. He was arrested and remains jailed without bond while the investigation and court proceedings continue.
Charges: Murder

Title: Man arrested after stealing bear with child’s ashes, stalking Florida woman, deputies say
description: Justin Andrew Fountain, 31, was arrested after allegedly stalking a woman he met through a dating app, tracking her movements, breaking into her hotel room and stealing a memorial teddy bear containing her deceased son’s ashes. Investigators said Fountain accessed the victim’s phone and social media accounts and used location tracking without permission. He allegedly sent threatening messages, including threats to destroy or discard the teddy bear. Deputies located Fountain driving northbound on Interstate 95 and conducted a traffic stop near mile marker 294. The stolen memorial bear was found intact inside his rental car and returned to the victim. Fountain was taken into custody without incident.
Charges: Aggravated stalking, extortion, grand theft, tampering with a victim, unauthorized installation/use of a tracking device, and unauthorized access to an electronic device

Title: Osceola County man accused of reaching 135 mph during chase, authorities say
description: Stone Ivia Mwaki was arrested in Osceola County after deputies said he led law enforcement on a high-speed pursuit reaching approximately 135 mph. According to the Osceola County Sheriff's Office, the pursuit began along U.S. 192. A sheriff's helicopter tracked Mwaki as he allegedly weaved through traffic at triple-digit speeds. Deputies said Mwaki eventually abandoned his vehicle and attempted to escape on foot. He was quickly located and taken into custody with assistance from the sheriff's helicopter. The report does not describe any exchange of gunfire or injuries during the pursuit and does not provide the complete list of charges.
Charges: Fleeing and eludingReckless drivingSuper speedingDriving with a suspended licensePossession of cannabisPossession of drug paraphernaliaResisting an officer without violence

Title: Super speeder zooms past Flagler sheriff going 125 mph, gets arrested
description: Arul Nayak, 22, of Palm Coast, was arrested after Flagler County Sheriff Rick Staly said he observed Nayak driving a white 2016 Dodge Challenger at speeds between 115 and 125 mph on Interstate 95. The sheriff paced the vehicle for nearly six miles while Nayak allegedly weaved across all three lanes and passed within three to four feet of slower vehicles. Staly activated his lights and siren and stopped the vehicle on I-95 south of Old Dixie Highway in Volusia County. Nayak was arrested and taken to the Volusia County jail, where he was held on a $500 bond for violating Florida's super speeder law.
Charges: Violation of Florida's super speeder law

Title: FLOCK cameras help find kidnapped Florida kids: LCPD
description: Branch Stamper was arrested after police said he attacked a woman inside the Lake City Police Department lobby during a domestic violence incident. Surveillance footage allegedly showed Stamper chasing the woman, knocking her down, grabbing her neck, pulling her backward, and taking her phone. Police said Stamper then went to the parking lot, stole the woman's vehicle, and drove away with her two children inside. Officers used FLOCK license plate reader technology and cellular location data to locate the vehicle. The children were safely recovered and reunited with their mother. Stamper was taken to the Columbia County Detention Facility following the incident.
Charges: Two counts of kidnapping Domestic battery by strangulation Grand theft of a motor vehicle Tampering in a misdemeanor proceeding Resisting an officer without violence Domestic battery Driving with a suspended or revoked license with knowledge

Title: Orlando man arrested after deputies find drugs, alcohol, and 25-plus minors at house party: Affidavit
description: David Ramos was arrested after Orange County deputies responded to a loud party at his residence on Geranium Avenue on February 14, 2026. Deputies reportedly found 25 to 35 juveniles at the home, with some allegedly consuming alcohol and marijuana. During a protective sweep, deputies observed drug paraphernalia and alcohol in plain view, while one juvenile said they were high. Ramos initially resisted deputies. A later search warrant reportedly uncovered cocaine, cannabis, a Smith & Wesson 9mm firearm with ammunition, nicotine and THC vapes, alcohol, and paraphernalia. Parents were contacted, and deputies arranged for the minors to return home safely.
Charges: Battery on a law enforcement officer Resisting with violence Contributing to the delinquency of a minor Possession of cocaine Hosting an open house party

Title: Armed and dangerous' suspect sought after shooting, vehicle thefts in Marion County
description: Authorities in Marion County, Florida, are searching for 49-year-old Leroy Parks III following a shooting and the theft of two vehicles in Ocklawaha on August 13, 2026. Deputies said Parks left a residence on Southeast 192nd Court after a shooting at approximately 5:45 a.m. The victim was transported to a hospital with injuries that were not considered life-threatening. Investigators said Parks may be armed and dangerous and may be driving a stolen white 2016 Nissan Titan with Florida license plate 31DVBK. Authorities instructed the public not to approach him and to call 911 immediately if they see Parks or the vehicle.
Charges: shooting Two separate grand theft auto / stolen vehicle

Title: Tampa man chases 2 kids heading to school, exposes himself before witnesses step in: HCSO
description: Quaze Moore, 32, was arrested after allegedly approaching and chasing two children on their way to school in Tampa, Florida, on August 12, 2026. According to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded to a 911 call near 15th Street and College Park Drive at approximately 6:49 a.m. Moore allegedly chased the children to a nearby parking lot, exposed himself, performed explicit acts, and grabbed one of the children, reportedly ripping her clothing. Approximately 10 to 15 bystanders intervened and helped stop the encounter. Deputies arrested Moore, who was later held at Falkenburg Road Jail without bond.
Charges: Resisting an officer without violence; two counts of lewd or lascivious exhibition; lewd or lascivious molestation

Title: Man accused of hitting clerk while stealing beer from Florida convenience store
description: Johnny Lee Powers, 41, was arrested after allegedly assaulting a convenience store clerk while attempting to steal an 18-pack of beer from a Tom Thumb store near Mile Marker 88.5 in Islamorada, Florida. Monroe County deputies responded at approximately 10:10 p.m. and reportedly found the clerk holding his face while Powers attempted to conceal the beer in a backpack. Authorities said Powers hit the clerk in the face during the alleged theft. When deputies arrived, Powers reportedly refused commands, clenched his fists, and advanced aggressively toward them. A knife was visible in his pocket. Deputies used a taser before arresting him.
Charges: Battery; theft; resisting arrest

Title: Tampa man charged after deputies find 5 lbs. of cocaine in U-Haul
description: On April 1, 2026, Luis Pedroza was driving a U-Haul on Causeway Boulevard in Tampa shortly after 3 a.m. when Hillsborough County deputies observed multiple traffic violations and attempted to stop him. Pedroza continued driving for more than a mile and resisted officers' commands before eventually being taken into custody. A police K-9 detected narcotics inside the U-Haul, leading deputies to search the vehicle. They discovered approximately 5.5 pounds of cocaine concealed inside the truck. Pedroza was arrested and charged with cocaine trafficking and resisting an officer without violence. The incident involved a vehicle stop and drug investigation.
Charges: Cocaine trafficking; resisting an officer without violence

Title: WATCH: Florida man accused of stabbing victim following argument on Seffner road
description: On June 21, 2026, Drake Purcell, 19, was accused of stabbing a victim following an argument in the roadway at South Kingsway Road and Magnolia Avenue in Seffner, Florida. The victim suffered an injury that was not considered life-threatening and was transported to a hospital. After the stabbing, Purcell allegedly fled into a wooded area. The Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office aviation unit located him and guided deputies to his location. Deputies arrested Purcell the same day. Authorities said he also had several out-of-county warrants. He was subsequently charged with aggravated battery with a deadly weapon, possession of a controlled substance, and battery.
Charges: Aggravated battery with a deadly weapon; possession of a controlled substance; battery

Title: Florida man threatens teens with knife because go-kart was too loud: Deputies
description: Richard Carter was accused of threatening two teenagers with knives during a dispute over noise from a go-kart. According to deputies, Carter walked out of his home while the teens were working on a go-kart in an open garage and began yelling before throwing a lawn chair. He then grabbed a large chef-style knife and a meat cleaver. Carter eventually put down the chef’s knife but continued holding the meat cleaver while ordering one victim to leave the neighborhood. One victim dropped to his knees and begged Carter not to hurt them. Carter told deputies he was angry about the go-kart noise.
Charges: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon without intent to kill

Title: Roof escape fails: Longtime Florida fugitive captured after chase through neighborhood
description: On June 3, 2026, Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office fugitive warrants agents went to a home on Christine Lane in West Palm Beach to arrest 39-year-old Yusley Chavez Barreto, who had an active Polk County warrant for failure to appear on a marijuana trafficking charge. Authorities said Barreto fled from the home, jumped a fence, and climbed onto the roof of an outbuilding used as a residence. He reportedly broke through two sections of the roof while trying to escape. Deputies conducted a containment search and found him hiding between two fences. He was taken into custody and booked into Palm Beach County Jail.
Charges: Burglary of an occupied dwelling Criminal mischief causing property damage Resisting without violence

Title: From 1 charge to 4: Boca Raton man faces expanded charges in Lotus teen confrontation
description: Boca Raton, Florida
Charges: Two counts of battery, petit theft, and criminal mischief

Title: ‘Road rage’ attack erupts near Orlando International Airport, officer says
description: On April 12, 2026, a road-rage incident occurred on Jeff Fuqua Boulevard near Orlando International Airport. According to deputies, the suspect allegedly tried to force the victim’s vehicle off the road. After the victim pulled onto the shoulder, the suspect approached, pushed the victim’s driver door, reached into the vehicle, took sunglasses and a wallet, and threw them toward a retention pond. The suspect then allegedly punched the victim in the face, knocking him down. Investigators identified the suspect as Jerome Wilson. The victim reported displaced teeth, and a dentist reportedly had to shave the teeth because of the injury.
Charges: Burglary of an occupied conveyance, petit theft, battery, and aggravated battery with permanent disfigurement

Title: Feuding neighbor accused of bludgeoning father-son duo with pistol, flashlight
description: On February 20, 2026, deputies responded to the 1600 block of Shaker Circle in Wellington after a violent neighborhood dispute. According to the Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office, an argument involving Salas’s son and another child escalated. Luis Salas allegedly came outside carrying a flashlight and pistol and attacked the other child’s father and son. Deputies said Salas repeatedly struck the son in the head with a firearm. When the father attempted to intervene, Salas allegedly struck him repeatedly in the head with a flashlight. Both victims suffered significant injuries, and the son was transported to a hospital as a trauma alert. Salas was later identified in a photo lineup.
Charges: Aggravated battery causing bodily harm and aggravated battery with a firearm

Title: Man known as 'G-Dog' accused of alleged machete attack in Belle Glade
description: On June 25, 2026, deputies responded to Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard in Belle Glade after a reported stabbing. According to the Palm Beach County Sheriff’s Office, Ronnie Mincey, known as “G-Dog,” allegedly approached a man while holding a 12-inch machete. The suspect allegedly attempted to strike the victim in the face, punched him in the head, and then struck him with the machete in the back of the head. When the victim tried to restrain him, the suspect allegedly struck him again with the machete, injuring his hand. The victim suffered injuries to his head, hand, and ear. Surveillance footage reportedly corroborated the victim’s account.
Charges: Aggravated battery with a deadly weapon, resisting an officer without violence, and battery

Title: HCSO deputy arrested, victim hospitalized in domestic violence incident
description: Dayton Thomas, a Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office deputy, was arrested by the Pasco Sheriff’s Office following a domestic violence incident in Port Richey. The incident occurred at approximately 11:41 p.m. on March 24, 2026. According to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office, a victim sustained injuries during the incident and was hospitalized for treatment. Thomas, who had worked for the sheriff’s office for about 10 years and was assigned to patrol services, was charged with domestic aggravated battery involving serious injuries. He was suspended without pay while the criminal and administrative investigations continued.
Charges: Domestic aggravated battery involving serious injuries

Title: Florida man tries to steal medical helicopter waiting to transport patients after I-75 crash: FHP
description: Riley Ferrer was involved in a vehicle crash on I-75 in Hernando County shortly after midnight on June 19, 2026. According to the Florida Highway Patrol, Ferrer lost control of his pickup truck, struck another vehicle, and overturned into the woods. Two occupants of the other vehicle suffered serious injuries. While emergency crews prepared the injured people for air transport, Ferrer allegedly ran past first responders and attempted to take the medical helicopter that had landed at the scene. He was later taken to a hospital for medical clearance and then transported to the Hernando County Detention Center after continued resistance.
Charges: Three counts of resisting without violence; one count of burglary of an occupied conveyance

Title: Florida man arrested after deputies find dead, neglected dogs during welfare check: HCSO
description: John Hoover was arrested after Holmes County deputies conducted a welfare check at a residence on Highway 179-A. Deputies reportedly found a dead dog on the front porch and several other dogs in poor health showing signs of neglect. Hoover initially refused to come outside and communicated with his sister by telephone. An animal control investigator obtained an animal cruelty arrest warrant and a search warrant. When authorities returned, Hoover allegedly attempted to flee but was quickly taken into custody. During the search, deputies reported finding methamphetamine and drug paraphernalia. Animal control officers rescued the surviving dogs and transported them to a local shelter for care.
Charges: Animal cruelty; possession of methamphetamine; possession of drug paraphernalia; resisting an officer without violence

Title: Seffner man tries to run from deputies after choking woman unconscious: HCSO
description: Anthony Rodriguez Jr., 32, was arrested following a domestic violence investigation in Hillsborough County. Deputies responded shortly after 10:30 a.m. Wednesday after a woman arrived at an urgent care facility with bruises and lacerations and reported that she had been choked until she lost consciousness. Detectives identified Rodriguez and located him driving nearby. When deputies attempted a traffic stop, Rodriguez allegedly fled, crashed his vehicle into a ditch, abandoned the vehicle, and ran on foot. Deputies pursued him briefly and used a Taser to take him into custody. He faces multiple domestic violence, battery, fleeing, resisting, and property-related charges.
Charges: Five counts of domestic violence; three counts of domestic battery by strangulation; throwing a deadly missile at, within, or into a vehicle; leaving the scene of a crash with property damage; fleeing to elude at high speed; resisting an officer without violence; tampering with a witness; aggravated battery with a deadly weapon; criminal mischief

Title: Citrus Park man arrested on drug charges after police officer fires gunshot during chase: TPD
description: Marco Fragoso, 24, was arrested after a police chase in Tampa’s Hyde Park area. According to the Tampa Police Department, an officer encountered two people allegedly involved in narcotics activity in an alley on South Howard Avenue. Fragoso reportedly ran when officers attempted to make contact and dropped a small bag of suspected narcotics. Officers pursued him but briefly lost sight of him. Police later found Fragoso hiding near a vehicle on South Albany Avenue. Investigators said Fragoso motioned toward his waistband, prompting an officer to fire one round in his direction. Fragoso was not struck or injured and was subsequently taken into custody.
Charges: Possession of cocaine; possession of drug paraphernalia; tampering with physical evidence; resisting arrest without violence
